title: Data Analyst I NOCCO, Barebells & Vitamin Well
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on\-the\-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.*
 We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business, working across e\-commerce, data and AI.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join us in a new, global role. You will work from underlying data through to analysis – spanning data modelling, transformation and quality through to dashboards and insights – helping shape how we structure, connect and use data as our digital business grows. Working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead, you will join while much of our data capability is still being built.
   

  

**About the role**
 This is a hands\-on role that brings the technical and analytical sides of data together. You will work directly with data using SQL, build and transform datasets in a modern cloud data environment, and take that work through to analysis, visualisation and business decisions.
   

  

 Your work will connect you with Digital Sales, CRM, Performance Marketing, Social, Product and Engineering. One project could involve modelling customer and transaction data, another connecting a new marketing data source or improving how we measure retention or LTV. At other times, you might start with an open\-ended business question and work your way from the underlying data to an analysis that leads to action.
   

  

**What you will work on**
* Build and maintain reliable, reusable data models and transformations.
* Turn open\-ended business questions into structured analysis and actionable insights.
* Analyse customer behaviour and growth across areas such as acquisition, retention, attribution and customer lifetime value.
* Create dashboards and self\-serve analytics that enable teams to understand and act on their KPIs.
* Work with different data sources, contributing to ingestion, integrations and data quality.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation, schema design and data best practices.


**What you can expect**
* Plenty left to build. You are joining a growing data setup, with the opportunity to improve what exists and help shape what comes next.
* Problems that are not already solved. Multiple brands, markets and digital channels bring real complexity – and plenty for someone who likes figuring things out.
* High ownership from the start. You will be expected to bring your perspective, challenge existing approaches and drive your work forward, working closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead.
* A fast\-growing international business. Your work sits behind the digital growth of Barebells, Vitamin Well and NOCCO, with the pace and change that comes with it.


**Who you are**
 You have hands\-on experience working with data from source to insight. You have experience with data modelling and cloud data platforms, and know how to turn underlying data into analysis that supports business decisions.
   

  

 You move naturally between the technical and analytical sides of the work – understanding how data is structured and transformed while also investigating business questions, identifying what matters and communicating your findings clearly.
   

  

 You are curious, technically sharp and pragmatic. You enjoy getting into complex problems, finding your way forward when the answer is not obvious and taking ownership from question to solution.
   

  

**We believe you have:**
* Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience working directly with data from databases.
* Experience with analytical data modelling and transformation tools such as dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar.
* Experience working with cloud data platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake or Databricks.
* Experience turning data into analysis, dashboards and visualisations that support business decisions.
* A good understanding of ELT/ETL workflows and how data moves between sources and systems.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.


**Chances are, you have also worked with some of the following:**
* APIs, integrations or data pipelines.
* AI\-native coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar.
* Sales and marketing data from platforms such as Shopify, GA4, Meta or Google Ads.
* AI/LLM products, event instrumentation or experimentation.


 How to apply
   

  

*Application deadline: October 12th 2026*
 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
   

  

**Life at Vitamin Well Group**
 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
   

  

 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands\-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office\-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
   

  

 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.
   

  

*As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.*

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!** 




  





 Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
 


* We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190\+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 450\+ employees from 45\+ nationalities



  





 We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
 



  





**The role:** 




 As a Senior Data analyst, you’ll be responsible for the team's quantitative insights. From understanding our data, identifying problems, to working with product, tech, and design on hypothesizing solutions. You’ll be the driver of our experimentation and learning efforts and will collaborate with different teams.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Understanding Truecaller's data.
* Taking ownership of quantitative insights for your team, playing a crucial role in product development.
* Defining experiments, overseeing their setup, and analyzing their results to drive decision\-making.
* Developing and maintaining key performance indicators (KPIs) for the team, ensuring their tracking, reliability, and reporting.
* Creating data pipelines and dashboards to measure the team's KPIs and effectively communicate insights to both the team and leadership.
* Coaching and mentoring the team on experimentation and data\-driven product development processes, fostering a culture of data\-driven decision\-making.



  





**What you bring in**

* Experience in using SQL to extract, transform, and analyse data
* Experience in data visualisation tools like Looker (preferred), QlikSense, Tableau, or Power BI
* Experience in mentoring, coaching, and evangelizing about data in product development

**Sounds like a great opportunity?** 




  





 We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
 



  





 We only accept applications

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer \- Build the Data Foundation for a Fast\-Moving Nordic E\-commerce Business
 



  





 What if your next Data Engineering role gave you the chance to do much more than build pipelines?
 



  





 We’re working with a fast\-moving Nordic e\-commerce business that is transforming the way it works with data, AI and technology. Data sits at the heart of the organisation \- powering everything from business intelligence and operational decision\-making to automation and emerging AI use cases.
 



  





 The company is currently going through a major transformation of its data environment, and this is a particularly exciting time to join. The foundations are being rebuilt, new ways of working are being introduced, and there is a huge opportunity to shape how data is used across the business.
 



  





 They’re looking for a Data Engineer who is genuinely curious about technology, understands the bigger picture, and enjoys figuring out how to solve problems rather than simply completing tickets.
 



  






 The Role:
 




 You’ll join a small, highly collaborative data team and work across the full data landscape.
 



 The core of the role is data modelling and building a strong, scalable data foundation, but you’ll also have the freedom to step outside the traditional boundaries of Data Engineering.
 



  





 One day you could be building a robust data model in dbt and BigQuery. The next, you might be building a Python service, creating an API to expose data, automating a business process, or helping develop an interface that allows AI agents to interact with company data.
 



  





 They’re looking for someone who can look at a problem and think:
 



  





 'What do we actually need to build to solve this?'
 



  





 Rather than someone who only wants to work within one predefined part of the stack.
 



  






 What you’ll be working on:
 



* Build and maintain high\-quality data models using SQL and dbt
* Help develop and evolve the company's modern data warehouse
* Work with data coming from a range of different sources and systems
* Build Python\-based services, applications and integrations where needed
* Develop APIs and other interfaces for making data accessible to applications and AI agents
* Work with data ingestion and automation using tools such as Airbyte
* Contribute to infrastructure and deployments using GCP, Docker and Terraform
* Troubleshoot existing data flows and improve reliability and scalability
* Help create the technical foundations for new AI and automation use cases
* Work closely with stakeholders to understand the business problem behind a request and turn it into a sustainable technical solution
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, architecture and ways of working across the data team



  






 The Technology:
 




 The core data stack is built around:
 



  





 dbt · Google BigQuery · SQL · Python · GCP · Docker · Terraform · Airbyte
 



  





 Experience with every technology isn't expected. In fact, they’re deliberately open to people who have worked with different cloud environments or tools.
 



  





 What matters more is that you understand the underlying concepts and are someone who can pick up new technology quickly.
 



  






 Who are they looking for?
 




 This role would suit a full\-stack data\-minded engineer \- someone who is technically strong in data but also enjoys getting involved in the wider engineering challenge.
 



  





 You might be a Data Engineer who has:
 


* Strong SQL and data modelling experience
* Solid experience with dbt
* Used Python to build pipelines, services or applications
* Worked with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS
* Built APIs or other services around data
* Worked with infrastructure, deployment or automation
* Experience in a start\-up, scale\-up, innovation environment or consultancy
* Had to figure things out independently rather than working within a highly structured enterprise environment



  





 You don't need to have done everything listed above.
 



  





 They are much more interested in what you have actually built, how you approach problems, and how quickly you can understand something new.
 



  





 This isn't a role for someone who wants to spend all day exclusively focused on ingestion pipelines.
 



 Likewise, they're not looking for a Software Engineer who simply has an interest in data.
 



  





 The sweet spot is someone with data at their core, who can also move comfortably into engineering when the problem requires it.
 



  





 You might have built an API to serve data to another application.
 



 You might have created an internal tool with a light front end.
 



 You might have automated something that previously required manual work.
 



 You might have worked on an AI or ML\-related use case.
 



  





 Or you might simply have spent time in a smaller environment where you had to work things out and build whatever was needed.
 



  





 The common thread is curiosity, ownership and a willingness to solve the whole problem.
 



  





 There is already a modern technology foundation in place, but there is a lot left to build. That means you'll have genuine influence over architecture, technical decisions and how the team evolves.
 



  






 The environment:
 




 This is a relatively small and highly collaborative technology organisation where things move quickly.
 



  





 You'll work closely with people across the business, and the demand for data is high. Stakeholders have ambitious ideas and plenty of use cases they want to explore, so you'll need to be comfortable prioritising, communicating clearly and working as part of a team.
 



  





 The ideal person will enjoy an environment where:
 


* Things aren't always perfectly defined
* You have genuine ownership over your work
* You can challenge how things are currently done
* You need to figure things out rather than follow a rigid process
* You work closely with the business rather than operating in a technical silo
* There is plenty of opportunity to experiment with new technology
* People are ambitious, social and genuinely enjoy working together



  





 The culture is fast\-moving, informal and collaborative, with relatively little bureaucracy. You’ll know the people around you, understand what the wider business is trying to achieve and have the opportunity to see your work make a tangible difference.
 



  






 The practical details:
 



* Location: Stockholm
* Working model: Hybrid \- typically 3 days per week in the office
* Language: English is fully workable; Swedish is a plus
* Salary: Around 50\.000\-65\.000 SEK/month, dependent on experience \& with flexibility for an exceptional profile
* Team: Small, growing Data team with close collaboration across the wider technology organisation



  





 Interested?
 



 If you're a Data Engineer who wants to work somewhere you can build, experiment, solve real business problems and have a genuine say in how data and technology evolve, this could be a very interesting opportunity.
 



  





 The team is particularly interested in hearing about what you've actually built, the environments you've thrived in, and the times you've had to figure out a difficult technical problem without everything being handed to you.
 



  





 If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: PhD student in Machine Learning with a focus on mathematical and statistical methods for uncertainty quantification
description:
**Uppsala University, Department of Information Technology**
 Are you interested in probability theory, statistics, and mathematical modelling? Would you like to develop new methods for uncertainty quantification and apply these methods to large\-scale clinical cancer data? Are you looking for an employer that invests in sustainable employeeship and offers safe, favorable working conditions? We welcome you to apply for a PhD position at the Department of Information Technology, Uppsala University.
   

  

 The Department of Information Technology holds a leading position in both research and education at all levels. We are currently Uppsala University’s third largest department, have around 350 employees, including 120 teachers and 120 PhD students. Approximately 5,000 undergraduate students take one or more courses at the department each year. You can find more information about us on the Department of Information Technology website.
   

  

 At the Division of Systems and Control, we develop both theory and concrete tools to design systems that learn, reason, and act in the real world based on a seamless combination of data, mathematical models, and algorithms. Our research integrates expertise from machine learning, optimization, control theory, and applied mathematics, spanning diverse application domains such as medicine, energy systems, biomedical systems, neuroscience, and safety and security. The Division of Systems and Control enjoys a wide network of strong international collaborators all around the world, for example at the University of Oxford, the University of Melbourne, and the University of California, Los Angeles. We strive for all PhD students to get a solid international experience during their PhD.
   

  

**About The DDLS Fellows Program**
 The PhD position is part of the national research programme DDLS.
   

  

 Data\-driven life science (DDLS) uses data, computational methods and artificial intelligence to study biological systems and processes at all levels, from molecular structures and cellular processes to human health and global ecosystems. The SciLifeLab and Wallenberg National Program for Data\-Driven Life Science (DDLS) aims to recruit and train the next generation of data\-driven life scientists and to create globally leading computational and data science capabilities in Sweden. The program is funded with a total of 3\.3 billion SEK over 12 years from the Knut and Alice Wallenberg (KAW) Foundation.
   

  

 In 2026 the DDLS Research School will be expanded with the recruitment of 25 academic and 7 industrial PhD students. During the course of the DDLS program more than 260 PhD students and 200 postdocs will be part of the Research School. The DDLS program has four strategic research areas: cell and molecular biology, evolution and biodiversity, precision medicine and diagnostics, epidemiology and biology of infection. For more information, please see: https://www.scilifelab.se/data\-driven/ddls\-research\-school/
   

  

 The future of life science is data\-driven. Will you be part of that change? Then join us in this unique program!
   

  

 At Uppsala University, we are announcing the position as DDLS PhD student in data\-driven precision medicine and diagnostics.
   

  

 Data\-driven precision medicine and diagnostics covers data integration, analysis, visualization, and data interpretation for patient stratification, discovery of biomarkers for disease risks, diagnosis, drug response and monitoring of health. The precision medicine research is expected to make use of existing strong assets in Sweden and abroad, such as molecular data (e.g. omics), imaging, electronic health care records, longitudinal patient and population registries and biobanks.
   

  

 Project description
   

  

 Data\-driven mathematical and statistical models are increasingly used in life science research and healthcare. Quantifying the uncertainty associated with these models is crucial for understanding their reliability and for making informed decisions based on their predictions. This project aims to develop new methods for uncertainty quantification in mathematical and statistical models. The methods will be applied to large\-scale clinical cancer data. A central application will be quantifying uncertainty in information extracted from medical reports and propagating this uncertainty into downstream probabilistic time\-to\-event models.
   

  

 Duties
   

  

 The doctoral student will primarily devote their time to graduate education. Other departmental duties of at most 20%, including teaching and administration, may also be included in the employment.
   

  

**Requirements**
 To meet the general entry requirements for doctoral studies, you must:
   

  

* hold a Master’s (second\-cycle) degree in applied mathematics, applied statistics, engineering physics, physics, machine learning, or in a similar subject, or
* have completed at least 240 credits in higher education, with at least 60 credits at Master’s level including an independent project worth at least 15 credits, or
* have acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way.


 The University may permit an exemption from the general entry requirements for an individual applicant, if there are special grounds (Chapter 7,
   

  

* 39 of the Higher Education Ordinance). For special entry requirements, please see the subject’s general study plan.


**We Are Looking For Candidates With**
* strong foundations in linear algebra, probability theory, and calculus
* solid skills in programming
* interest in mathematical and statistical method development,
* good communication skills and sufficient proficiency in oral and written English,
* creativity, thoroughness, and a structured approach to problem\-solving


**Additional Qualifications**
 Experience with one or more of the following areas is meriting:
   

  

* Bayesian statistics,
* mathematical modelling,
* statistical machine learning.


 Rules governing PhD students are set out in the Higher Education Ordinance chapter 5,
   

  

* 
* 1\-7 and in Uppsala University’s rules and guidelines.

* a CV;
* degrees and transcript of records with grades (translated to English or Swedish);
* a Master’s thesis (or a draft thereof, and/or some other self\-produced technical or scientific text), publications, and other relevant documents;

title: Doktorand i maskininlärning med inriktning mot matematiska och statistiska metoder för osäkerhetskvantifiering
description:
Är du intresserad av sannolikhetsteori, statistik och matematisk modellering? Vill du utveckla nya metoder för osäkerhetskvantifiering och tillämpa dessa metoder på storskaliga kliniska cancerdata? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som doktorand på Institutionen för informationsteknologi vid Uppsala universitet.
   

  





 Institutionen för informationsteknologi har en ledande position inom såväl forskning som utbildning på alla nivåer. Vi är idag Uppsala universitets tredje största institution och har i dag drygt 350 anställda varav 120 lärare och 120 doktorander. C:a 5000 grundutbildningsstudenter läser en eller flera kurser vid institutionen varje år. Mer information om oss hittar du på institutionen för informationsteknologis webbplats.
   

  





 Vid avdelningen för Systemteknik utvecklar vi både teori och konkreta verktyg för att designa system som lär sig, resonerar och agerar i den verkliga världen baserat på en sömlös kombination av data, matematiska modeller och algoritmer. Vår forskning integrerar expertis från maskininlärning, optimering, reglerteori och tillämpad matematik, och spänner över olika tillämpningsområden som medicin, energisystem, biomedicinska system, neurovetenskap och säkerhet. Vid avdelningen har vi ett brett nätverk av starka internationella samarbetspartners över hela världen, till exempel vid the University of Oxford, the University of Melbourne, och the University of California, Los Angeles. Vi strävar efter att alla doktorander ska få en gedigen internationell erfarenhet under sin doktorandtid.
   

  





**Om forskningsprogrammet DDLS**




 Doktorandtjänsten är del av det nationella forskningsprogrammet DDLS.
   

  





 Datadriven livsvetenskap (Data\-driven life science, DDLS) använder data, beräkningsmetoder och artificiell intelligens för att studera biologiska system och processer på alla nivåer – från molekylära strukturer och cellulära processer till människors hälsa och globala ekosystem. SciLifeLab och Wallenberg National Program for Data\-Driven Life Science (DDLS) syftar till att rekrytera och utbilda nästa generation datadrivna livsvetenskapsforskare samt att skapa globalt ledande kompetens inom beräknings\- och datavetenskap i Sverige. Programmet finansieras med totalt 3,3 miljarder kronor över 12 år från Knut och Alice Wallenbergs Stiftelse (KAW).
   

  





 År 2026 kommer DDLS forskarskola att utökas genom rekrytering av 25 akademiska och 7 industridoktorander. Under programmets gång kommer mer än 260 doktorander och 200 postdoktorer att vara en del av forskarskolan. DDLS\-programmet har fyra strategiska forskningsområden: cell\- och molekylärbiologi, evolution och biologisk mångfald, precisionsmedicin och diagnostik samt epidemiologi och infektionsbiologi. För mer information, se: https://www.scilifelab.se/data\-driven/ddls\-research\-school/
   

  





 Livsvetenskapens framtid är datadriven. Vill du vara en del av den förändringen? Då är du välkommen att delta i detta unika program!
   

  





 Vid Uppsala universitet utlyser vi nu en doktorandtjänst inom DDLS med inriktning mot
 **datadriven precisionsmedicin och diagnostik** 
 .
   

  





 Datadriven precisionsmedicin och diagnostik omfattar dataintegration, analys, visualisering och tolkning av data för patientstratifiering, upptäckt av biomarkörer för sjukdomsrisk, diagnostik, läkemedelssvar och hälsouppföljning. Forskningen inom precisionsmedicin förväntas använda befintliga starka resurser i Sverige och internationellt, såsom molekylära data (t.ex. omikdata), bilddata, elektroniska patientjournaler, longitudinella patient\- och populationsregister samt biobanker.
   

  





**Projektbeskrivning**




 Datadrivna matematiska och statistiska modeller används i allt större utsträckning inom livsvetenskaplig forskning och hälso\- och sjukvård. Att kvantifiera osäkerheten i dessa modeller är avgörande för att förstå deras tillförlitlighet och för att kunna fatta välgrundade beslut baserat på deras prediktioner. Detta projekt syftar till att utveckla nya metoder för osäkerhetskvantifiering i matematiska och statistiska modeller. Metoderna kommer att tillämpas på storskaliga kliniska cancerdata. En central tillämpning kommer att vara att kvantifiera osäkerheten i information som extraheras från medicinska rapporter och att föra denna osäkerhet vidare till probabilistiska modeller som predicerar tid till händelse.
   

  





**Arbetsuppgifter**




 Doktoranden ska främst ägna sig åt den egna forskarutbildningen. Övrig tjänstgöring vid institutionen, som avser undervisning och administrativt arbete, kan ingå inom ramen för anställningen (max 20%).
   

  





**Kvalifikationskrav**




 Grundläggande behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå har den som:
 


* avlagt examen på avancerad nivå inom tillämpad matematik, tillämpad statistik, teknisk fysik, fysik, maskininlärning, eller inom ett liknande område, eller
* fullgjort minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå inklusive ett självständigt arbete om minst 15 högskolepoäng, eller
* på något annat sätt inom eller utom landet förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.



 Högskolan får för en enskild sökande medge undantag från kravet på grundläggande behörighet, om det finns särskilda skäl. (7 kap. 39 § HF). För särskild behörighet, se studieplanen för ämnet. 
   

  





 Vi söker kandidater med:
 


* starka kunskaper i linjär algebra, sannolikhetsteori och analys
* goda färdigheter i programmering
* intresse för metodutveckling inom applicerad matematik och statistik
* god kommunikationsförmåga och tillräckliga kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift
* kreativitet, noggrannhet och ett strukturerat arbetssätt i problemlösning



**Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt**




 Erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av följande områden är meriterande:
 


* Bayesiansk statistik,
* matematisk modellering,
* statistisk maskininlärning.



 Bestämmelser för doktorander återfinns i Högskoleförordningen 5 kap §§ 1\-7 samt i universitetets regler och riktlinjer.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Ansökan ska innehålla:
 


* ett personligt brev (högst 1 sida) där förklarar hur du uppfyller kvalifikationskraven, motiverar varför du söker denna tjänst, och ditt beräknade tidigaste startdatum;
* en meritförteckning (CV);
* examensbevis och registerutdrag med betyg (översatt till engelska eller svenska);
* examensrapport (eller utkast till sådan, och/eller annan egenproducerad teknisk eller vetenskaplig text), publikationer och andra relevanta dokument;
* referenser med kontaktinformation (namn, e\-post och telefonnummer) och upp till två rekommendationsbrev.



**Om anställningen**




 Anställningen är tidsbegränsad, enligt HF 5 kap § 7\. Omfattningen är heltid. Tillträde 15 november 2026 eller enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort: Uppsala.
   

  





**Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av:** 
 Biträdande universitetslektor Sara Hamis, e\-mail: sara.hamis@it.uu.se. 
   

  





**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 16 oktober 2026, UFV\-PA 2026/2836\.**




 Uppsala universitet är ett brett forskningsuniversitet med stark internationell ställning. Det yttersta målet är att bedriva utbildning och forskning av högsta kvalitet och relevans för att göra skillnad i samhället. Vår viktigaste tillgång är alla 7 500 anställda och 53 000 studenter som med nyfikenhet och engagemang gör Uppsala universitet till en av landets mest spännande arbetsplatser.
   

  





 Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba inom Uppsala universitet
   

  





 https://uu.se/om\-uu/jobba\-hos\-oss/
   

  





 Anställningen kan komma att säkerhetsprövas. Vid säkerhetsprövning är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd.
   

  





 Vi undanber oss erbjudanden om rekryterings\- och annonseringshjälp.
   

  





 Ansökan tas emot i Uppsala universitets rekryteringssystem.

title: Senior Customer Insights & Business Analyst
description:
**Bli en del av Coop – Tillsammans gör vi mat\-Sverige hållbart!**
**Om Tjänsten**
 Som Senior Customer Insights \& Business Analyst på Coop Sverige får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla Coops förståelse för kunder, beteenden och tillväxtmöjligheter. Detta är en helt ny roll med ett brett mandat att forma hur Coop arbetar med kundsegmentering, kundinsikter och tillväxtstrategi framåt. Rollen innebär ett tydligt strategiskt, analytiskt och rådgivande ansvar där du omsätter kunddata och marknadsinsikter till rekommendationer som stärker affären, varumärket och kunderbjudandet.
   

  

 Du blir en del av Varumärke \& Kommunikation och arbetar nära kollegor inom bland annat försäljning \& marknad, varumärke, sortiment, finans, DigIT och affärsutveckling. Coop befinner sig just nu i en spännande utvecklingsresa där kundfokus, datadrivna beslut och relevanta kunderbjudanden står högt på agendan. I den här rollen får du stor möjlighet att påverka både strategiska prioriteringar och hur kundinsikter används i verksamheten.
   

  

 Som Senior Customer Insights \& Business Analyst ansvarar du för att utveckla Coops strategiska kundsegment, shopper missions och kund\- och tillväxtstrategi. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt för att säkerställa att kundinsikter omsätts till konkreta affärsbeslut och långsiktig tillväxt.
   

  

**I Rollen Ingår Bland Annat Att**
* Ha ett övergripande ansvar för utvecklingen av Coops strategiska kundsegment och kund\- och tillväxtstrategi
* Utveckla och analysera kundsegment utifrån beteenden, värderingar och kunddata
* Utveckla och analysera shopper missions samt identifiera tillväxtmöjligheter i olika kundsegment
* Följa upp och analysera utvecklingen inom prioriterade segment och målgrupper
* Ta fram insikter och rekommendationer som stödjer affärsplanering och strategiska beslut
* Säkerställa att kundsegmenteringen används i viktiga processer som sortimentsutveckling, konceptutveckling och kommunikation
* Samordna kund\-, konsument\-, marknads\- och omvärldsinsikter till ett sammanhållet beslutsunderlag
* Presentera insikter och rekommendationer för ledningsgrupper och andra nyckelintressenter
* Bidra till att stärka det kunddrivna arbetssättet och sprida kundinsikter i organisationen


 Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar och du förväntas kunna driva arbetet självständigt samtidigt som du samarbetar nära med kollegor och andra funktioner inom organisationen. Rollen är en senior specialistroll utan formellt personalansvar men med stor påverkan på strategiska beslut och prioriteringar.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
***Vem är du?***
 Vi söker dig som är en strategisk, affärsdriven och analytisk person med god förståelse för kundbeteenden, segmentering och affärsfrågor. Du trivs i en roll där du både arbetar strategiskt och operativt och motiveras av att skapa resultat genom datadrivna insikter och tydliga rekommendationer.
   

  

***För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:***
* Minst 5\-8 års erfarenhet av kundanalys, kundsegmentering eller strategisk affärsanalys
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla kundsegment, målgruppsstrategier eller kund\- och tillväxtstrategier
* Mycket god analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av avancerad analys och metodutveckling
* Erfarenhet av att omsätta data och insikter till affärsmässiga rekommendationer och strategiska beslut
* Erfarenhet av att presentera komplexa analyser för ledningsgrupper och andra seniora intressenter
* Förmåga att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och skapa förtroende hos olika intressenter
* Civilekonom\-, civilingenjörsexamen eller motsvarande akademisk utbildning


 Erfarenhet från dagligvaruhandeln, retail eller annan konsumentnära verksamhet är meriterande. Vi ser även positivt på erfarenhet från insightsbyrå, analyskonsultverksamhet eller liknande miljö där du har arbetat med avancerad kund\-, marknads\- eller konsumentanalys.
   

  

 Det viktigaste är att du kombinerar affärsförståelse med en stark analytisk förmåga och kan omsätta insikter till beslut som skapar affärsvärde.
   

  

**Personliga Egenskaper Som Vi Värdesätter**
* Affärsdriven och resultatorienterad
* Analytisk och strukturerad
* Strategisk med god helhetssyn
* Kommunikativ och pedagogisk
* Självständig med ett starkt eget driv
* Relationsskapande och samarbetsinriktad


**Vårt Erbjudande Till Dig**
 Hos oss får du arbeta i en organisation med ett tydligt syfte, att bidra till en mer hållbar dagligvaruhandel. Coop befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsresa där vi stärker vårt kunderbjudande, utvecklar vårt varumärke och bygger en mer kunddriven verksamhet. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team där du får stort ansvar, möjlighet att påverka och vara med och bygga upp ett nytt strategiskt område med stor betydelse för Coops framtida tillväxt.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad på Coops huvudkontor i Solna.
   

  

**Så Ansöker Du**

 Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Nora Bernunger på e\-postadress: nora.bernunger@coop.se.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Start date: 03/11/2026**
**End date: 30/04/2027**
**Scope: 100 %, full\-time**
**Location: Stockholm, on\-site 2\-3 days a week**
 We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our insights team in Platform \& Partner Experiences to help us drive and support evidence\-based decisions throughout the company’s product development process. Our team is responsible for the company’s consumer experiences such as desktop, TV, speakers and smartwatches and for delivering work alongside some of our biggest tech partners. Together with us you will study user behaviour, evaluate critical initiatives and experiment with new features to drive decisions that influence the way the world experiences music, podcasts and audiobooks.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* You will collaborate with fellow Data Scientists and Data Engineers, and co\-operate with cross\-functional teams of product managers, engineers, designers and user researchers who are passionate about our consumer experience, to identify and answer key product questions via data.
* You will be a key partner in our work to build out and deliver innovative product features that create valuable and engaging listening moments in the daily lives of the company users.
* You will perform analysis on large sets of data to extract impactful insights about user behaviour and product usage that will help drive product decisions and guide our strategy.
* You will communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders within your team and across the company.


**Who You Are**
* You have relevant experience or a degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics or another quantitative subject area. Previous experience in working as a Data Scientist for consumer\-facing digital product development is strongly preferred.
* You have strong interpersonal skills and are a great stakeholder manager. You are expert in data visualisation and presentation, and can interpret information into clear actions and strategy.
* You can tackle loosely defined problems and come up with relevant analytical approach and impactful insights.
* You have proficiency with Python, or similar programming languages, experience with Google BigQuery \& expertise in SQL.
* You have hands\-on knowledge of A/B testing methodologies and experimentation at scale, including application of this knowledge to digital products
* You enjoy sharpening questions and developing hypotheses, and can collaborate with non\-Data Scientists to clarify assumptions and influence decisions.
* You have extensive experience using various analysis techniques, such as linear and logistic regression, significance testing, and statistical modeling.


**Where You’ll Be**
* This role will be located in Stockholm or London.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Why Doktor.se
   

  

 Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25\-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000\+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.
   

  

 We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows — and that footprint is growing fast. AI is a working tool here, not a buzzword. We use it daily, we expect you to as well, and we hire people who treat it as a force multiplier.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Our data platform works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We have data scattered across Postgres databases, Amplitude, S3 file dumps, and a tangle of Python jobs that move it around. The reports get built and the business runs on them. But trust is brittle, reconciliation is too manual, and the foundations need work before we can scale to where we're going.
   

  

 We need someone who can help us rebuild this — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where the warehouse is clean and the pipelines just run, this isn't it. If you want to redesign a data platform from foundations up, with real ownership and the leverage to make it good, here's what you'd own:
   

  

* Reshape the data foundations — multi\-tenancy, retention, and data contracts with backend services.
* Decide what the warehouse actually is: self\-hosted Postgres \+ dbt, managed Snowflake or BigQuery, or something else. You'll shape this.
* Unify three data sources that don't currently talk to each other: our operational databases, Amplitude product analytics, and a long tail of S3\-based partner integrations.
* Build observability into the platform — lineage, freshness, and alerting that actually means something.
* Own reporting that finance, operations, and the board rely on. Make those reports trustworthy by design, not by manual reconciliation.
* Work directly with backend, product, and finance teams. You're not a service desk — you're a peer who shapes how data gets produced upstream, not just consumed downstream.
* Use AI aggressively for pipeline boilerplate, schema generation, transformation logic, and exploratory analysis — the same discipline we hold ourselves to.


 You'll be part of a small data engineering team. That's a lot of ownership and not a lot of cover. The right person sees that as opportunity.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

* You've designed and run data platforms in production — not just written DAGs. You've thought about what to build vs buy, where transformations belong, and how to keep schemas honest as products evolve.
* You're fluent in Python and SQL, with strong opinions about how Postgres should be used as a warehouse (and when it shouldn't).
* You've used dbt or equivalent in a real environment and understand data modelling — staging, marts, tests.
* You have working knowledge of one or more managed warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and can evaluate them honestly against self\-hosted options.
* You're comfortable with orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, whichever — and know what an orchestrator is for.
* You think about data contracts as a product problem, not just a pipeline problem, and can make that case to backend engineers.
* You use AI in your daily work and can talk about how. If your answer is "I haven't really tried it yet," this isn't the role.
* Healthcare data experience is a plus. GDPR fluency is expected. Patientdatalagen familiarity is a bonus.
* You have a relevant university degree or equivalent experience.


 Tech stack
   

  

* Sources: Postgres (operational), Amplitude (events), S3 (integrations and dumps)
* Languages: Python, SQL
* Cloud: AWS, multi\-account
* Warehouse: Postgres today, open question for tomorrow
* Transformation: likely dbt going forward
* Orchestration: open question — you'll shape this
* AI: Claude and OpenAI in our daily workflow


 What we offer
   

  

* Real influence. The data platform is being rebuilt and you're at the centre of it.
* Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers — your work is visible, not lost in a machine.
* Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.
* Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.


 Practical details
   

  

* Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.
* Employment: Permanent, full\-time. Six month probation period.
* Location: On\-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.
* Language: You'll be working with our entire org so Swedish is a strong plus, but English is our working language within tech.
* Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.


 We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.
   

  

 På Doktor.Se vill vi göra saker annorlunda. Vi vill utmana och förändra en hel bransch. Allt började med en idé om att det måste gå att skapa en vårdlösning som är bättre anpassad till vår tid och våra behov. Att det måste gå att få moderna digitala verktyg och traditionell fysisk vård att samverka med utgångspunkt i patientens behov. Och att göra det så att det inte bara blir tillgängligt för våra patienter utan också bidrar till att utveckla det sätt som vård erbjuds på idag. För oss alla. Det här är faktiskt vad vi gör idag. Men vi är långt ifrån klara och är ute på en spännande förändringsresa. Där kan du få vara med och bidra.

title: Cloud Engineer with a passion for Data Engineering and AI-Data enablers | SEB, Solna
description:
Join our Data, Analytics and Reporting team to push us further working on or data platform.
   

  

 SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology\-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future\- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are a cloud engineering team responsible for a wide range of data deliveries for reporting and analytical purposes, often driven by legal and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 We continue to build on our data platform in gcp including identifying ways to improve our analytics and reporting capabilities be it ai agents or any other automation or efficiency enablers. We also enable other teams on the platform to build their business data products within our domain.
   

  

 In this position You will regularly communicate and collaborate with colleagues in and out of the team. You will work on the agile ceremonies in the team and drive the PI planning together with our PO. You will design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable cloud\-native data pipelines and platform capabilities on GCP. You will contribute to ingestion, orchestration, transformation, monitoring, and operational improvements across the platform, while helping ensure data quality, governance, and maintainability.
   

  

 The role also includes contributing to reusable engineering patterns, CI/CD and automation practices, observability improvements, and onboarding of new teams and consumers onto the platform.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, we believe you have
   

  

* Several years of experience in software or data engineering
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines
* Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms (preferably GCP)
* Experience with orchestration or workflow tools (e.g., Airflow or similar)
* Understanding of modern data architectures (e.g., Data Warehouse, Data Lake)
* Proven experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Git\-based development workflows
* A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams
* Experience using LLMs as part of your development workflow, either professionally or through personal projects.


 Nice\-to\-have skills:
   

  

* Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery and Pub/Sub
* Containerization (e.g., Docker)
* Event\-driven architectures and streaming data
* Advanced data modelling techniques (e.g., Dimensional Modelling, Data Vault)
* Data quality, monitoring, and observability practices
* IAM, secure access, and data governance principles
* Building robust and highly reliable data systems


 What we offer
   

  

* Working with skilled, caring, passionate and progressive team members
* Opportunities to help transform an industry
* Innovative company in forefront of technology
* Attractive compensation and benefits
* Access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits


 Do you want to be part of SEB?
   

  

 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than
 **04\-10\-2026\.** 
 We will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts. https://sebgroup.com/career

title: AI Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer – AI Engineering Team, Matas Group**
 Do you want to be a part of shaping the future of retail in the Nordics?
   

  

 At Matas Group’s AI Engineering team, we build advanced, forward\-looking AI systems that deliver real impact: smarter customer dialogues, automated content production, and personalized experiences – from the first prototype to robust production. You’ll join a small, skilled team of AI specialists and engineers working in an open, collaborative environment where experimentation and continuous learning are encouraged.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an AI Engineer with us, you play a key technical role. You work closely with the business, but your primary focus is developing, operating, and optimizing AI\-based systems and backend components that meet high technical standards and scale reliably.
   

  

 You collaborate with product owners, developers, and data engineers to understand needs and translate them into working, production\-grade solutions. The role requires you to be confident in technical areas, while also being able to provide clear technical direction and guidance across the organization.
   

  

**Examples of projects you may work on**
* Customer\-facing chatbot for our customers on web and app – millions of potential users
* Internal knowledge assistant for stores and support – thousands of potential users
* Automated content production that streamlines large parts of the business
* Internal Vibehub \- a platform for developing and deploying applications internally, similar to Lovable.


**You will, among other things,**
* Develop custom AI solutions or use AI frameworks to achieve business objectives
* Develop backend components and APIs in Python
* Build data processing pipelines (PySpark/SQL/Pandas)
* Create prototypes and demos to explore and demonstrate new solutions
* Drive technical decisions and ensure the quality and scalability of our AI implementations


**About you**
 We are looking for someone who has:
   

  

* At least one year of experience as a Data Scientist or another technically oriented role
* A master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or equivalent
* A strong interest in modern AI technology and generative AI, and the ambition to deepen your expertise further


**Key technical competencies:**
* AI/ML
* Backend development
* Data processing (Pandas / SQL / PySpark)


 A GitHub profile with relevant hobby projects is considered a plus.
   

  

**To succeed with us, we believe you**
* See technical solutions where others see obstacles
* Are a clear communicator who can explain complex technology in an understandable way
* Thrive in an environment where innovation, quality, and speed go hand in hand


**About Matas Group**
 Matas Group is a leading player in the Nordics with operations in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland. We run close to 500 stores and multiple websites and apps.
   

  

 With more than 5 million members in our customer clubs, we collect a huge amount of data on our platform, giving us the opportunity to build truly compelling use cases.

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Vill du vara med och bygga robusta dataflöden som möjliggör analys, maskininlärning och AI i praktiken? Nu söker vi på Länsförsäkringar AB en Data Engineer som vill utveckla skalbara och pålitliga lösningar i nära samarbete med data scientists, AI Engineers och arkitekter. Här får du en viktig roll i ett innovativt och prestigelöst team där ny teknik, samarbete och verklig verksamhetsnytta står i centrum.*
*OBS: Då denna rekrytering sker under semestertider kan återkoppling komma att dröja lite längre än vanligt.*
**Om jobbet**
 Som Data Engineer inom gruppen Data Science får du en central roll i att bygga och vidareutveckla den informationsförsörjning som krävs för analys, maskininlärning och AI. Rollen innebär att du arbetar med lösningar som behöver vara robusta, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara, med fokus på att göra rätt data tillgänglig med rätt kvalitet, i rätt format och vid rätt tidpunkt. Du blir en del av ett innovativt team på 16 personer där data scientists, AI Engineers, lösningsarkitekter och Data Engineers arbetar nära varandra, delar kunskap och tillsammans driver AI\-utvecklingen framåt inom Länsförsäkringar AB. Här får du möjlighet att bygga lösningar som används i praktiken och bidra till framtidens AI i en miljö präglad av samarbete, utveckling och hög teknisk ambition.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:**
* designa, bygga och underhålla skalbara, robusta och pålitliga datapipelines
* strukturera och modellera data så att den kan användas för analys, feature engineering och maskininlärning
* säkerställa stabil informationsförsörjning till ML\-modeller och AI\-tillämpningar i nära samarbete med data scientists och AI Engineers
* bygga integrationer och datatjänster som gör information tillgänglig på ett säkert, effektivt och återanvändbart sätt
* bidra till övervakning, loggning och kvalitetssäkring för att följa upp hälsa, prestanda och tillförlitlighet i datapipelines


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* högskole\- eller universitetsutbildning inom relevant tekniskt område, exempelvis datateknik, AI, teknisk fysik eller matematik
* några års arbetslivserfarenhet av data engineering, backendutveckling eller liknande roller där du har byggt dataflöden i produktion
* stark utvecklarbakgrund, gärna med Python, samt erfarenhet av att designa, bygga och underhålla datapipelines
* god förståelse för datamodellering, datatransformation och datakvalitet
* erfarenhet av databaser, datalagring, molnplattformar som Azure och containerbaserade lösningar
* grundläggande kunskaper i svenska
* möjlighet att jobba på plats på Gärdet i Stockholm, där vi har vårt kontor
* förmåga att samarbeta nära data scientists, utvecklare och andra intressenter för att omsätta databehov till fungerande lösningar


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* erfarenhet av dataflöden till ML\-modeller eller AI\-tillämpningar, exempelvis feature stores
* erfarenhet av vektor\- eller grafbaserad datahantering, exempelvis semantisk sökning eller kunskapsgrafer
* erfarenhet av ostrukturerad eller semistrukturerad data
* erfarenhet av strömmande dataarkitekturer
* erfarenhet av API\-utveckling och ramverk som FastAPI eller LangChain
* relevanta certifieringar inom exempelvis Azure, data engineering, DevOps, molnplattformar eller databaser


 Som person är du kommunikativ, självgående, strukturerad och ansvarstagande. Du har lätt för att samarbeta nära olika kompetenser och intressenter och trivs i en miljö där kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av arbetet. Du har ett problemlösande förhållningssätt, är nyfiken på att utvecklas inom data engineering och AI\-/ML\-nära dataflöden och känner ett starkt ägarskap för kvalitet, långsiktighet och användbarhet i det du bygger.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: Fredrik Urby, fredrik.urby@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Susanne Hirsch, susanne.hirsch2@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Maria Eriksson, maria.eriksson@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Affärsenhet Sak är länsförsäkringsgruppens drivkraft inom sakförsäkring. Vi utvecklar nya affärer, skapar smarta försäkringslösningar och ser till att kunderna alltid har trygghet i vardagen. Vi står bakom gemensamma koncept, digital försäljning och kundkommunikation – och vi kompletterar bolagens erbjudanden med specialprodukter som gör skillnad.
   

  

 Hos oss får du vara med och forma framtidens försäkring – där innovation möter samhällsnytta.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Are you passionate about how AI can shape the insurance market?**
 Join either
 **Data Discovery \& Experience** 
 or
 **API Platform** 
 , two teams within API \& Data Products Solutions.
   

  

 Our mission is to make APIs, MCPs and Data easy to discover, understand, and use. To support that journey, we are looking for an AI Engineer who is excited about building the next generation of AI\-powered experiences.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will help shape AI\-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.
   

  

 Working hands\-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.
   

  

 As part of a cross\-functional team of Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will turn emerging AI opportunities into practical solutions with measurable business impact.
   

  

* Help evolve our Data Discovery \& Experience or API Platform capabilities.
* Design and develop AI\-powered platform capabilities using AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products.
* Improve how APIs, MCPs, and Data Products are discovered, understood, and used across If.
* Help ensure secure access using open standards.
* Apply platform engineering and product thinking to solve real business problems.
* Contribute to AI literacy and AI\-enabled ways of working.


 We offer
   

  

**Benefits**
 In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:
   

  

* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit


**About The Team**
 Depending on your background, interests, and experience, you may join either the
 **Data Discovery \& Experience** 
 team or the
 **API Platform** 
 team.
   

  

 The
 **Data Discovery \& Experience** 
 team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.
   

  

 The
 **API Platform** 
 team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.
   

  

 Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.
   

  

 This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.
   

  

 Who are you?
   

  

 You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.
   

  

 You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.
   

  

 You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.
   

  

 You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.
   

  

 You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.
   

  

 You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* Relevant university degree, preferably within Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data \& Analytics, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
* Experience in the insurance industry or another regulated industry, such as banking, finance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.
* At least 3 years of experience in software engineering and modern application development.
* At least 1\-2 years of practical, hands\-on experience applying AI engineering practices in production or real\-world applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C\#, TypeScript, or Python.


 Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:
   

  

* AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Agent Frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar technologies.
* MCP (Model Context Protocol), including providing AI systems with context, tools, and access to enterprise capabilities.
* Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and model orchestration.
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
* APIs, API Platforms, integration technologies, and secure access using open standards, as well as Data Products, Data Discovery, Analytics Platforms, and Developer Experience capabilities.
* Cloud\-native application development using Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.


 Additional facts and the recruitment process
   

  

**Application deadline:** 
 Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 11, 2026\.
   

  

**To apply for the position:** 
 Please attach your CV and fill in the questionnaires
   

  

**Work location:** 
 Bergshamra, Stockholm
   

  

**Travelling:** 
 Some travel within the Nordics and Baltics is required
   

  

**Start:** 
 Upon agreement
   

  

 For more information, please contact Daniel Sahlin, Head of API and Data Product Solutions, \+46 (0\) 771 43 00 00
   

  

 Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

title: Senior AI Engineer - Center of Excellence
description:
**About This Role**
 Enterprise software is going through its biggest shift in decades. Applications are moving from deterministic workflows to intelligent, agentic systems that understand context, remember preferences, and act on behalf of users. This isn’t a future prediction — it’s happening now, and Columbus is building at the frontier of it.
   

  

**We’re hiring three senior engineers to form the core of our Group AI engineering team.** 
 Together, you’ll design and build the next generation of AI\-powered systems that will transform how thousands of people work — across the Nordics and beyond. You’ll work directly with the VP Group AI. No layers. No committees. You build, you ship, you learn.
   

  

 This is not a consulting engagement or a proof\-of\-concept. It’s production engineering at enterprise scale, on the Microsoft platform, using the most advanced AI models available today.
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 We are looking for someone who have/is
   

  

* Strong expertise in LLM application design, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks, and evaluation
* Good undetstanding of data as a foundation for AI driven Insights
* Experience building scalable, production\-grade AI systems, with focus on context management, cost optimization, and real\-world deployment
* Proven ability to design multi\-agent architectures where AI systems collaborate effectively
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Graph, Teams, SharePoint) and cloud\-native platforms like Azure
* Solid background in data and retrieval systems, including vector search, embeddings, document databases, and RAG architectures
* Skilled in building robust, event\-driven and API\-based systems with strong focus on reliability, security, and enterprise compliance


 If You Don't Match All These Qualification Above But Is An Expert In Either Of The Three, Don't Hesitate To Apply
   

  

**AI Application**
 You bring deep experience in LLM application architecture, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks, tool integration, and model evaluation. You have a strong understanding of context window management, cost optimisation, and model behaviour at scale, combined with expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance.
   

  

**AI Automation \& Integration**
 You have hands\-on experience with Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem. In addition, you possess expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance as they relate to automation, integrations, and enterprise\-scale AI solutions.
   

  

**AI Infrastructure**
 You bring extensive experience with document databases, vector search technologies, and embedding models. You understand RAG architectures, including chunking, reranking, hybrid search, and citation grounding, and can design data governance frameworks that meet enterprise compliance requirements such as DLP, auditing, and retention. You have experience building scalable knowledge retrieval systems, supported by expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance.
   

  

**Application**
 At our company, you can easily apply using your LinkedIn profile or your CV, without having to fill out long questionnaires. You do not need to submit a cover letter.
   

  

 In our recruitment process, we use logic and personality tests. We always check references and conduct a background check before an employment offer is made. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Daniel Sparrow. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 After the recruitment process has ended, we will ask you about your experience as a candidate. It only takes a few seconds to answer, and it helps us improve our recruitment process.
   

  

**Working at Columbus**
 People always come first at Columbus. We are a global consulting firm with local presence, helping companies with their digital transformation and to thrive through technology, data, and human insight. We are also a workplace where you, as an employee, can develop your career and get support through clear and structured career paths.
   

  

 Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to deliver value to our clients. Whether you’re experienced or just starting out in your career, you’ll find the freedom to explore ideas, challenge the familiar, and shape your own path with us.
   

  

 With more than 1,500 colleagues in over 10 countries, we combine global perspectives with local understanding. What unites us is our belief in creating meaningful impact – for our employees, our clients, and the journey ahead.
   

  

 Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together! ⭐
   

  

**What Others Say About Us**
 Interested in Columbus behind the scenes? Each week, we let a colleague take over our Instagram account.
   

  

 At Careereye, current and former employees can share their
 **unfiltered reviews about what it’s like to work with us** 
 . Click below to read their experiences.

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller oss som bolag är du välkommen att kontakta talent Acquisition Partner Svante Larsson på svante.larsson2@soprasteria.com

 The Opportunity
 



  





 We’re looking for
 **Senior Backend Engineers with an interest in Applied AI** 
 to help build the next generation of AI\-powered ecommerce capabilities.
 



  





 This is
 **not a research\-focused ML role** 
 and it isn’t simply about integrating an LLM API.
 



  





 You’ll be a strong backend engineer first, while helping design and build production AI capabilities across areas such as:
 


* Conversational and semantic search
* Recommendation engines
* Retrieval and RAG systems
* LLM\-powered product features
* Agentic workflows
* AI tooling and automation
* Machine\-learning applications in production



  





 You’ll have the opportunity to work across different teams and technical domains depending on business priorities, with significant ownership from architecture and development through to deployment and operation.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 You could work across a combination of:
 


* Designing and building scalable backend services and APIs
* Developing AI\-powered product functionality
* Building search, retrieval and recommendation capabilities
* Integrating and evaluating LLM\-based systems
* Designing distributed and event\-driven architectures
* Working with databases, caching and data services
* Deploying and operating services in cloud environments
* Monitoring, debugging and improving production systems
* Making technical decisions around performance, reliability and cost
* Working closely with product and engineering teams to turn business problems into technical solutions



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 You’ll ideally have strong experience in:
 


* Backend software engineering
* Designing and operating production systems
* Distributed systems
* Scalable APIs and services
* Database design and optimisation
* Cloud\-native development
* Production monitoring and reliability



  





 For the AI\-focused positions, experience in one or more of the following would be particularly
 



 valuable:
 


* LLM applications
* RAG
* Semantic search
* Information retrieval
* Recommendation systems
* Ranking / reranking
* Embeddings
* Conversational AI
* Agentic workflows
* ML systems in production
* AI tooling and automation



  





**Technology** 




 The environment includes technologies such as:
 


* **Python**
* **FastAPI**
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* Redis
* Kafka
* Kubernetes
* Cloud infrastructure
* LLM and AI technologies



  





 You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important than matching a particular technology checklist.
 



  





**What Makes This Role Interesting?** 




  





**Build AI that reaches real users** 




 You'll be working on AI\-powered capabilities inside established marketplace products rather than isolated experiments or proof\-of\-concepts.
 



  





**Backend engineering remains central** 




 The role combines modern AI with proper software engineering: architecture, APIs, databases, infrastructure, reliability and production ownership.
 



  





**Broad technical ownership** 




 You'll have the opportunity to work across teams and take ownership of problems from initial design through to production.
 



  





**Work at an important stage of AI adoption** 




 The business is actively building its AI engineering capability, giving you the opportunity to influence how AI is integrated into products and engineering practices.
 



  





**International engineering environment** 




 You'll work alongside a multicultural team where English is the primary working language.
 



 Working Model
 



  





 The role is
 **remote\-first** 
 , with approximately
 **two days per month on\-site in Stockholm** 
 .
 



 Candidates based in
 **Stockholm, Uppsala or Västerås** 
 may be particularly well suited.
 



  





 There is no regular business travel requirement.
 



  





**Who Would Succeed Here?** 




 This role is likely to suit someone who:
 


* Enjoys being hands\-on technically
* Wants to combine backend engineering with AI
* Has experience taking systems into production
* Enjoys solving ambiguous problems
* Likes working across traditional engineering and emerging AI technologies
* Wants meaningful ownership rather than a narrowly defined technical role
* Is interested in the intersection of technology, ecommerce and AI



  





 If you're a strong backend engineer who has already started working with AI — or an AI/ML engineer with unusually strong software engineering foundations — we'd be interested in hearing from you.

title: AI Engineer - Customer Operations
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We are building an agentic layer that works Vainu's own accounts, pipeline, support, and renewals in the background. You will build those agents and own them, across CS, Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you are a curious builder with a commercial mindset that has shipped real systems with real users, keep reading.
   

  

**Vainu’s AI thesis**
 We are headless\-first. We believe the primary user of our software will be an agent, not a person.
   

  

 Already now, every capability is reachable through APIs, CLI tools, and MCP servers. A GUI will be something for humans afterwards, if it earns its place.
   

  

**A Glimpse Of What Your Work Will Entail**
 You will contribute to building Vainu's agentic layer: the systems that let agents support our commercial work in the background, across multiple departments. It is a new layer with a small team, so you will have the opportunity to impact and shape the next big shift at Vainu. What you will do would include:
   

  

* Building autonomous customer processes. One knowledge layer that updates itself from customer conversations, product releases, and other events that change what is true about Vainu, and agents that use it to answer questions across email, phone, chat, Slack, and in\-product. You build the whole loop: the agent that answers, and the pipeline that keeps it right. Success is when our team can focus on conversations where human interaction creates most value.
* Orchestrating Growth agents. Agents that read customer usage, health, and signals against our offering, then flag expansion, risk, and timing with sources attached. They write CRM entries, create opportunities, send emails, and pull a human in when a human is the right move.
* Prove that it works. Every agent has to beat the process it replaces, and you have to show it. Named tests that can go red, monitoring in production, honest comparison against how the work was done before. We would rather kill an agent than run one that quietly performs worse than manual handling.


 Our goal is for agents to handle routine parts of customer processes, freeing us to do the work where we create most value.
   

  

**What We Need To See**
* You have built things people have used. A company you started, an automation that ran your team's workflow, a tool, an agent, a side project with users who were not you. No technical degree is required, only proof of what you have built.
* You operate comfortably with dev tools. LLMs, APIs, n8n, Git, GCP, and whatever the problem needs next. When the right tool is one you have never touched, you have something running in it by the end of the week.
* You are business\-curious. You want to know how a technical decision shows up in pipeline, retention, and revenue.
* You will be handed problems nobody here knows how to solve. No runbook, no spec. Take the problem regardless, work out what it is, find the tooling, come back with something running. Then tell us straight what it does and does not do yet.


**What You Get**
 Most people spend five years choosing between the commercial track and the technical one. This role is both from day one. You sit close enough to sales, CS, Marketing, and RevOps to see where money is won and lost, and you build the systems that change it.
   

  

 You will work independently on your projects but together with a small and ambitious team similar to your capabilities. You will work closely with your team and with consultation from the founders to build out Vainu’s agentic layer.
   

  

 We will not shield you from the hard problems, because the hard problems are the training. If you want to start a company one day, this is a place for you.
   

  

**About Vainu**
 The Nordics' leading company database: over 5\.1M companies and 10\.5M decision\-makers, collected by us and refreshed daily. Finnish\-born, offices in Stockholm and Helsinki, around 80 people. Founder\-owned and profitable, with more than 1,100 customers across the Nordics.
   

  

 The Vainu database can be accessed through three products:
   

  

* Reach. TAM and ICP. Filter millions of companies and decision\-makers down to the ones worth contacting.
* Data Sync. Customer 360\. One full picture of every customer, real time
* Discover. Vainu agents that tell companies when and why to reach out.


**Work setup and salary**
 Location: Helsinki or Stockholm office. Full\-time in the office for the first 6 months, then 2\-3 days per week in the office.
   

  

 Base salary: 4\.000 € \- 5\.500 € (monthly gross salary). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and what you've shipped.
   

  

 Questions: Contact Pauliina (pauliina@vainu.io or \+358 44 238 8007\)
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Send us three things:
   

  

* CV and Cover Letter
* Something you built, with a link. Repo, product, agent, automation, a company. Something real, not a demo reel.
* One paragraph on a Vainu workflow you would automate first, and why. Guess. We want to see how you think, not whether you know our stack.


 We read every application that includes all three, and we move fast.

title: Verksamhetsanalytiker med inriktning systemstöd för klientutbildning
description:

 I rollen som verksamhetsanalytiker kommer du att få förvalta och utveckla de system som stödjer klienternas utbildning (och ev. inom andra områden vid behov) och hjälpa de medarbetare som använder dessa systemstöd.  Tjänsten är placerad inom avdelningen för innehåll och utveckling vid Kriminalvårdens huvudkontor i Norrköping med möjlighet till placering även vid regionkontor i Malmö och Stockholm.

I ditt arbete har du lätt för att anpassa dig till ändrade omständigheter och kan snabbt ändra ditt synsätt och förhållningssätt.
