Du är noggrann och väl medveten om mål och kvalitetsstandard och arbetar bra med komplexa frågor. Du besitter förmågan att analysera och bryta ner problem för att sedan arbeta fokuserat för att hitta en lösning.
   

  

 För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**

* Minst ett års erfarenhet av pedagogiskt arbete inom Kriminalvårdens vuxenutbildning
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig väl i tal och skrift på svenska
* Goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office


**Det är även meriterande med:**
* Akademisk examen/högskoleutbildning inom pedagogik
* Utbildning i projektledning PPS
* Kriminalvårdens grundutbildning
* Erfarenhet av arbete med förvaltning/support av systemstöd
* Erfarenhet av kravställning för systemstöd
* Erfarenhet av att delta i projekt
* Erfarenhet av arbete med ett eller flera av Kriminalvårdens klientadministrativa systemstöd
* Mycket god förmåga att utbilda andra, individuellt och i grupp

title: Postdoktor i maskininlärning och dynamik i kvantmateria
description:
**Nordita, Nordiska institutet för teoretisk fysik,** 
 grundades 1957 i Köpenhamn och flyttades 2007 till Stockholm, där det har KTH och Stockholms universitet som värduniversitet. Forskning vid Nordita har en bred profil inom modern teoretisk fysik, med ämnen som astrofysik, biofysik, gravitation, kosmologi och astropartikelfysik, högenergifysik, kondenserade materiens teori, samt statistisk fysik och komplexa system. Den lokala forskningen kompletteras av vetenskapliga program som sammanför grupper av ledande experter för att arbeta inom specifika ämnen under en längre tid. Det ges även goda möjligheter till samarbete med forskare vid de närliggande universiteten. Mer information finns på: www.nordita.org
   

  





**Projektbeskrivning**




 Projektet fokuserar på maskininlärning och dynamisk kvantmateria under yttre påverkan. Arbetet omfattar även modellering av öppna kvantsystem och kvantbitar (qubits).
   

  





**Arbetsuppgifter**




 Anställningen innebär att bedriva forskning i enlighet med teman från projektbeskrivningen.
   

  





**Behörighetskrav**




 För att vara behörig för anställning som postdoktor krävs avlagd doktorsexamen eller utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara relevant doktorsexamen. Examen ska vara avlagd senast då anställningsbeslutet fattas.
   

  





**Bedömningsgrunder**




 Det är meriterande, om doktorsexamen eller motsvarande är avlagd högst tre år före sista ansökningsdag. Om det finns särskilda skäl, kan en tidigare avlagd examen också anses vara meriterande. Med särskilda skäl avses ledighet på grund av sjukdom, föräldraledighet, förtroendeuppdrag inom fackliga organisationer, tjänstgöring inom totalförsvaret, eller andra liknande omständigheter samt klinisk tjänstgöring eller för ämnesområdet relevant tjänstgöring/uppdrag.
   

  





 Vid tillsättningen kommer särskild vikt att fästas vid vetenskaplig skicklighet.
   

  





**Om anställningen**




 Anställningen avser heltid och gäller tills vidare, dock minst två år och högst tre år, med möjlighet till förlängning om det finns särskilda skäl. Tillträde 2026\-11\-01 eller enligt överenskommelse.
   

  





**Vi erbjuder**




 Hos oss får du dynamiken i samspelet mellan högre utbildning och forskning som gör Stockholms universitet till en spännande och kreativ miljö. Du arbetar i en internationell miljö och får förmånliga villkor. Universitetet ligger beläget i Nationalstadsparken med goda förbindelser till city.
   

  





 Stockholms universitet värnar om att vara en arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika rättigheter och möjligheter för alla.
   

  





**Kontakt**




 Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av administrativ chef, Elizabeth Yang, tfn 08\-553 784 73, elizabeth.yang@su.se.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Du söker anställningen via Stockholms universitets rekryteringssystem. Bifoga personligt brev och CV samt de bilagor som efterfrågas i ansökningsformuläret. Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett och att den är universitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag.
   

  





 Anvisningar för sökande finns på webbsidan: att söka en anställning.
   

  





 Stockholms universitet bidrar till det hållbara demokratiska samhällets utveckling genom kunskap, upplysning och sanningssökande.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Är du vår nästa Data Scientist?** 




  





*Vi utvecklar just nu hur vi arbetar med data och analys på ATG. Med nya verktyg och en modern dataplattform kommer vi kunna både fördjupa den analys vi redan gör och testa nya angreppssätt – från explorativ analys och prediktiva modeller till AI\-baserade analysverktyg.* 




  





 Som Data Scientist hos oss arbetar du nära verksamheten med kund\- och affärsfrågor. Det kan handla om att förstå kundbeteenden, mäta effekten av förändringar, utveckla modeller som skapar konkret nytta eller hitta helt nya sätt att använda vår data.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du bland annat:
 



  




* Driva analyser hela vägen – från att förstå och konkretisera ett affärsproblem, välja lämplig metod och bearbeta data till att presentera insikter som verksamheten kan förstå och agera på
* Analysera kundbeteenden och mäta effekten av olika förändringar och initiativ, exempelvis genom experiment och kontrollgruppsanalys
* Utveckla modeller och se till att de faktiskt går att använda och följa upp
* Arbeta mycket i SQL och Python/R
* Samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten – från affären och andra analytiker till andra kompetenser inom data
* Vara med och utforska hur vi kan använda AI på ett vettigt sätt – både i verksamheten och i vårt eget analysarbete



  





**Är det här du?** 




 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har ett starkt affärsintresse och är bekväm med statistik, machine learning och kvantitativ problemlösning. Du kan självständigt arbeta från rådata till slutsats eller produktionssatt lösning. SQL och Python/R är naturliga delar av ditt dagliga arbete, och erfarenhet av moderna molnbaserade dataplattformar, exempelvis Snowflake, är meriterande.
 



 Du har sannolikt en akademisk bakgrund inom ett kvantitativt område, till exempel teknik, statistik, matematik, datavetenskap eller nationalekonomi.
 



  





 Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, strukturerad och trivs med att jobba självständigt. Du behöver inte ha jobbat med spel tidigare, men vi tror att du har ett genuint intresse för spel och är nyfiken på att förstå våra kunder och hur våra produkter fungerar.
 



  





***”Som ledare vill jag skapa en välkomnande och tillåtande miljö, där vi har stort förtroende för varandras kompetens, tar eget ansvar och har nära till skratt.”***




 Jag har jobbat på ATG i snart elva år och det som fortfarande gör jobbet roligt är kombinationen av en spännande affär, mycket data och frågor där analys faktiskt kan göra skillnad. I teamet vill jag att vi ska vara nyfikna, testa nya angreppssätt och ha egna idéer om hur vi kan använda vår data bättre för att driva affären framåt. För mig är det viktigt med stort eget ansvar och frihet i hur man löser sina uppgifter
 



**\- Filip Dyrssen, Head of Customer Analytics** 




  





**We are the game** 




 I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.
 



  





**Join the game!** 




 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn\-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

title: Data Engineer till Saint-Gobain Distribution Sweden
description:
*Vill du arbeta med att bygga moderna dataplattformar och bidra till datadrivna beslut? Här får du en roll där du jobbar nära både teknik och verksamhet med fokus på att skapa struktur, kvalitet och tillgänglighet i data.* 




  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Den här tjänsten är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Bravura och du anställs direkt hos Saint\-Gobain Distribution Sweden.
 



  





**Om företaget** 




 Saint\-Gobain Distribution Sweden (SGDS) samlar ledande bolag inom bygghandel som Dahl, Kakelspecialisten, Konradssons Kakel och Optimera, tillsammans med specialiserade dotterbolag. Genom dessa bolag erbjuds produkter, lösningar och rådgivning som gör skillnad för Sveriges yrkeshantverkare inom VS, VA, ventilation, plåt, kakel och bygg. Med cirka 2 700 engagerade medarbetare, 180 butiker och etableringar över hela landet uppgår omsättningen till omkring 17 miljarder kronor. Saint\-Gobain Distribution Sweden är en del av Saint\-Gobain, en av världens äldsta industrikoncerner, börsnoterad i Paris, med verksamhet i över 70 länder.
 



  





 SGDS centrala IT‑avdelning ansvarar för att förvalta, drifta och vidareutveckla de digitala plattformar, affärssystem och infrastrukturlösningar som håller hela verksamheten i gång. Genom stabil drift, hög informationssäkerhet och ett kontinuerligt tekniskt förbättringsarbete säkerställs en robust IT‑miljö som stödjer allt från butikernas och logistikkedjans dagliga behov till säljfunktioner, kundnära system, ekonomiprocesser, hållbarhetsarbete, analysplattformar och andra centrala verksamhetsområden.
 



  





 IT‑avdelningen arbetar nära verksamheten med uppdraget att leverera skalbara, moderna lösningar som driver digitaliseringen framåt i hela organisationen, samtidigt som processer effektiviseras och förutsättningar skapas för en ännu starkare och mer sammanhängande kundupplevelse. IT\-avdelningen är även en del av Saint\-Gobain Distribution Nordic och en del uppdrag kan ske över landsgränserna.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




 Som Data Engineer hos SGDS ansvarar du för att designa, utveckla och förvalta datalösningar som används brett i organisationen. Du arbetar brett nära resterande kollegor och säkerställer att data är korrekt, tillgänglig och användbar.
 



  





 Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på att bygga och modernisera datalager samt analyticsplattformar, främst inom Azure\-miljöer. Du jobbar med både strukturering av data och utveckling av pipelines, där prestanda och kvalitet är centralt. I vardagen innebär det både nyutveckling och optimering av befintliga lösningar, samtidigt som du bidrar till tekniska beslut och utvecklingen av dataarkitekturen.
 



  





 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
 


* Designa och utveckla datalager samt dataplattformar i molnmiljö
* Bygga, optimera och förvalta ETL/ELT\-pipelines
* Modellera data enligt exempelvis Kimball och 3NF
* Arbeta med dbt för transformation, testning och dokumentation
* Utveckla och optimera SQL\-frågor i avancerade analysscenarier



  





**Utbildning, erfarenhet och personliga egenskaper** 



* Relevant högskole\- eller universitetsutbildning alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet
* Flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta med datalager och analyticsplattformar
* Goda kunskaper i SQL, inklusive query\-optimering och arbete med komplexa datamodeller
* Meriterande med praktisk erfarenhet av Snowflake (datalager, pipelines, Snowpipe, RBAC, prestandaoptimering)
* Meriterande med erfarenhet av dbt för transformering och datamodellering
* Meriterande med erfarenhet av Azure\-baserade datatjänster (t.ex. Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks)
* Meriterande mede erfarenhet av ETL/ELT och pipeline\-design
* Vana av versionshantering i Git och arbete med CI/CD



  





 För att passa i rollen arbetar du strukturerat och har en förmåga att bryta ner komplexa problem till konkreta lösningar. Du tar ansvar för din kod och säkerställer att det du bygger håller hög kvalitet över tid. Du är bekväm i samarbeten med olika delar i en organisation och kan anpassa ditt sätt att kommunicera beroende på mottagare. Samtidigt har du ett driv att förbättra befintliga lösningar och bidra till en mer effektiv och hållbar dataplattform
 



  





**Övrig information** 




 Start: Enligt överenskommelse
 



 Plats: Bromma, Stockholm
 



 Lön: Enligt överenskommelse
 



  





 Vi använder en kompetensbaserad metodik i alla rekryteringsprocesser för att säkerställa fördomsfria urval. Vi jobbar också med löpande urval, vilket innebär att vi tar ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har ansökt. Om du blir aktuell för tjänsten kommer vi att kontakta dig för en första telefonintervju. Oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte så kommer du att få återkoppling på din ansökan.
 



  





 Har du frågor? Hör gärna av dig!
 



 📧 info@bravura.se
 



 📞 010\-171 47 10
 



  





 Vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan omgående då vi gör ett löpande urval.
 



  





 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Data Engineer (Consultant)
description:

 It will vary a lot between Netlighters as we, around the right person, will design a role together with you. You will be starting somewhere familiar with your experience, and from there it is your call how your career at Netlight will look, ranging from which clients you will work with, what role you want to take (based on your personal experience, strengths, your personal interest) and how your relationship with your mentor/coach/EDGE networks/social networks will look like. As a consultant at Netlight, you will build the products, systems, and technical solutions of today and tomorrow. This means that our consultants get the opportunity to help build and scale existing and new products and companies and also continuously learn and master a variety of technical tools. At Netlight, we will challenge you. Our clients will challenge you. You will challenge our clients. You will challenge us. We will grow together and unleash the potential in each other.
 



  





 As a Data Engineer Consultant, you will help our clients in projects with roles in Data Engineering. It can be working within Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or project management in terms of working with data or utilizing data to make product decisions to mention a few examples.
 



  





**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Master Degree in Engineering or Technology
* Verbal and written fluency in English
* 0,5\-5 years of work experience within the data engineering field related to IT and software products in agile teams



  





**Application** 




 We are always looking for new Netlighters, so feel free to apply if you meet the qualifications. We will get in touch within two weeks if we find that your profile and experiences are a match beyond the qualifications at this time.
 



  





**About us** 




 Netlight provides a full range of premium IT\-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product\- and technology\-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. Netlight has been awarded several times as top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity and equality within the IT industry. Today we are growing all across Europe, currently with more than 15 active international offices.
 



  





**Come work with us** 




 Netlight strives to be a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive organization. Regardless of who you are, what personality, background, and experience you have, you enrich our culture through your values. Netlight’s purpose is to unleash full potential, realize great careers, and fulfill personal growth. The key to our continued success is trust and personal responsibility, diverse experiences, challenging opportunities and developing from personal values. title: Data Scientist & AI Consultant
description:
**AI \& Data Science\-konsult** 




 Vill du vara med och forma hur AI faktiskt kommer till nytta för slutkunderna hos ett globalt sensorteknikbolag, inte bara internt, utan i produkterna som når marknaden? Här får du jobba brett, från klassisk Data Science till moderna AI\-lösningar, med stor frihet att testa och driva lösningar hela vägen från idé till implementation.
 



  





 Är du någon som vill se dina modeller göra skillnad för riktiga kunder, snarare än att stanna i utredningsstadiet? Då kan det här vara din nästa utmaning.
 



  





**Information om företaget** 




 Vår kund är ett världsledande bolag inom sensorteknik, med särskilt fokus på termisk bildbehandling och avancerade sensorsystem. Deras produkter används inom allt från industri och säkerhet till fordon och konsumentmarknad. Du kommer in i ett team som utvecklar och förvaltar kundernas webb\- och mobilapplikationer samt ett SDK kopplat till bolagets kameror.
 



 Teamet består av ett 20\-tal personer – utvecklare, testare, UX:are och arkitekter – som nu tar nästa steg genom att integrera AI som en naturlig del av kundlösningarna.
 



  





**Information om tjänsten** 




 Professionals Nord söker för vår kunds räkning en AI \& Data Science\-konsult. Uppdraget är en del av vår personaluthyrning. Du kommer vara anställd av Professionals Nord och arbeta som konsult hos vår kund under 12 månader. Intentionen är att du på sikt ska kunna bli anställd direkt hos dem, förutsatt att alla parter är nöjda med samarbetet. Den här rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Professionals Nord och alla frågor kring tjänsten går till info@pn.se.
 



  





**Du erbjuds:** 



* En roll med stor frihet att själv utforska och driva AI\-lösningar end\-to\-end
* Möjlighet att jobba med verklighetsnära data, bland annat bildbaserad data
* Ett tydligt spår mot en eventuell direktanställning hos vår kund
* Att bli en del av ett kompetent team i en internationell koncern



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




 Du blir en del av kundens produktteam och jobbar nära utvecklare, testare och arkitekter för att identifiera och bygga AI\-lösningar som skapar värde för kundernas produkter. Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Identifiera och utvärdera möjligheter att applicera AI i kundnära applikationer
* Förbereda och analysera dataset, gärna bildbaserad data
* Utveckla, testa och driftsätta AI/ML\-lösningar från prototyp till produktion
* Sätta upp och nyttja molnbaserade AI\-tjänster, exempelvis i Azure



  





**Vi söker dig som:** 



* Har praktisk erfarenhet av Deep Learning, AI och Data Science
* Har erfarenhet av att träna och utvärdera egna AI/ML\-modeller



  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Computer Vision, särskilt bildbaserad data.
 



  





 Vi tror att dina personliga egenskaper är avgörande för hur väl du kommer trivas i rollen. Du är nyfiken och orädd – någon som hellre testar och tar reda på svaret själv än väntar på att få det serverat. Du är självgående och trygg i att driva ett arbete hela vägen från idé till färdig lösning, även när vägen dit inte alltid är given från start.
 



  





 START: Enligt överenskommelse
 



 OMFATTNING: Heltid
 



 STAD: Stockholm
 



 URVAL: Sker löpande

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 You will be joining a team focused on predicting the near\-future demand for our vehicles. Specifically, where and when they will be needed, and how to handle this at scale for a fleet of 150 thousand vehicles spread across over more than 100 cities. This is a complex and meaningful problem from both an analytical as well as an engineering perspective, and you'll be handed ambiguous, high\-leverage problems and are expected to reason from first principles about what to build — not a spec to implement.
   

  

 As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Voi, you'll work closely with a small, cross\-functional team to design, build and maintain machine learning models. You will work on problems where you will get to utilize your skills in such interrelated disciplines as machine learning, AI engineering, software engineering, data science, optimization as well as data engineering.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Own and contribute to end\-to\-end machine learning and AI projects, in close collaboration with business stakeholders, and the rest of your team
* Formulating solution hypotheses, defining data requirements, prototyping, implementing in production, and continuously monitoring model health and business impact
* Maintain and improve Voi's machine learning platform to ensure our machine learning products adhere to state\-of\-the\-art MLOps standards, with support from the team
* Work with colleagues to improve team processes and support mutual learning and knowledge sharing


**What You Need To Embark**
 We’re looking for a Machine Learning professional with experience from a fast\-paced environment. In addition to being fluent in English, we believe the right person has:
   

  

* A clear focus on business value and user impact
* A strong analytical mindset, and comfortable setting up simplified first\-principles models for complex problems, built on well\-thought\-through assumptions
* Forward\-leaning attitude towards LLM\-based and agentic approaches: you explore new AI tooling before it’s obviously the standard, and pair that curiosity with strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
* Experience contributing to projects from start to finish, from understanding business challenges to planning, building, launching and following up on results
* Hands\-on experience with real\-time inference and/or MLOps in one of the major cloud environments
* Experience writing production\-quality, maintainable software
* Higher education in one of the mathematical sciences such as computer science, mathematics, physics, bioinformatics or with a similar data\-centric degree


*Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.*
**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s \#1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest growing scale\-ups
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog\-friendly office
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000\+ vehicles in 130\+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8\+ million riders with over 500\+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way \- through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast\-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation \- and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more \- therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: AI Engineer with a passion for AI services | SEB, Stockholm
description:
Do you want to build AI services that solve real operational challenges at scale? Join SEB’s AIOps team and help shape the next generation of intelligent, reliable and secure services for a modern banking environment.
   

  

 At SEB, technology is at the heart of how we serve our customers and society. We combine the stability and responsibility of a leading bank with the curiosity, collaboration and engineering mindset of a modern tech organisation. From cloud and automation to AI and advanced analytics, you will work with an impressive technology landscape and contribute to solutions that matter. If you enjoy turning complex problems into practical, high\-impact services, this could be your next challenge.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 We build intelligent AI solutions for IT Operations that make our systems self‑healing, reliable and resilient.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an AI engineer in our AIOps team, you will help design, build, maintain and secure scalable AI services used across SEB. You will work close to real use cases, from ideas and experimentation to production\-ready services that support teams across the bank.
   

  

 The work is exploratory, practical and fast\-moving. Requirements are not always fully defined, so you should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking the right questions and turning uncertainty into progress.
   

  

 We believe in incremental progress, rapid learning and strong engineering discipline. You will contribute to a test\-and\-learn culture where small, well informed steps help us deliver robust solutions to complex problems.
   

  

 You will join a small, passionate team building custom AI services that already support many internal teams. Today, our AIOps platform helps detect anomalies, automates labor\-intensive tasks, intelligent agent driven operations and simplifying complex searches.
   

  

 Read more here: https://sebgroup.com/career/working\-at\-seb/work\-areas/tech\-and\-data/blog/2026/aiops\-\-ai\-for\-it\-operations
   

  

**To thrive in this role, we believe you bring** 
 :
   

  

* A curious, analytical mindset and the motivation to solve complex problems with practical, well\-engineered solutions
* Documented experience in backend development, preferably with Go and Python
* Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL
* Understanding of frontend technologies such as React.js and JavaScript
* Experience building data architectures for compute\-intensive services, from ingestion to inference
* Strong knowledge of software design patterns, architecture principles and operations for microservice applications
* Understanding of container technologies and modern cloud service architecture
* Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to contribute in a small, cross\-functional team
* Previous experience in AI or machine learning


**What We Offer**
* A collaborative team culture with openness, trust and room to influence
* Modern, agile ways of working with close connection to real business needs
* The opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI, automation and cloud\-related technologies in a large\-scale enterprise environment
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to grow your technical expertise and career


**Ready to help shape the future of AI\-powered operations?**
 Attach your CV and a personal letter telling us who you are, what motivates you and how you would like to contribute to our AI journey. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so you are welcome to apply today — and no later than 2026\-10\-05\.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment. Learn more about working at SEB at www.sebgroup.com/career

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At MedHelp Care, we’re shaping the future of workplace health management. As a leading Nordic B2B SaaS company, we build intelligent AI\-powered platforms that help organizations create healthier workplaces.
 



  





 Our platform uses advanced health data analytics and machine learning to detect early signals of health risk, enabling companies to take proactive, preventive action. Our mission is clear: to make workplaces healthier, more resilient, and better equipped to support both employees and organizations.
 



  





 We are on an exciting growth journey, and we’re now looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join us.
 



  





**About the role** 




 You’ll join our data team that develops InsightsHub and Statistics, our customer\-facing analytics products; Larix, our model for flagging who’s at risk of long\-term sick leave; and the data platform underneath.
 



  





 We use agentic coding tools heavily, and expect how we build to keep changing. We care less about which tools you use today than whether you’re willing to keep changing how you work.
 



  





 Larix, and how we run models in production generally, is at the centre of this role. We’re a small shop, so things move fast and what you build shapes the product rather than a corner of it.
 



  





**What we’re recruiting for** 



* Larix, our long\-term sick leave risk model: retraining, serving and monitoring it in production, plus features, evaluation, performance, and making it work in new markets.
* How we run models in production generally – serving, evaluation, and monitoring.



  





**What the team owns and you’ll work across** 



* InsightsHub, our LLM\-based analytics product: the data model and pipelines underneath, and the generation on top.
* The transformation layer: dbt, warehouse, orchestration.
* Product and usage data, with a focus on making it self\-serve.
* Proving what the product does to sickness absence, in a way that holds up with customers and leadership.



  





**Who we think you are** 



* You write Python and SQL that other people can maintain.
* You’ve looked after a model in production over time, not just built one and moved on.
* You’ve automated a training or deployment pipeline, or you’re keen to.
* You can design an evaluation that survives scrutiny, and you know the difference between correlation, prediction, and causal effect.
* You’ve worked with dbt or equivalent and an orchestrator like Airflow, Prefect or Dagster.
* You can explain what the numbers mean to someone who isn’t technical.
* We’re open to a few years of experience and up. The right person matters more than years of experience.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Taking a model to a new market or population.
* Evaluating LLM or AI output in production.
* Experience with privacy and sensitive personal data.
* Domain background in HR, occupational health, insurance, or healthcare.



  





**About MedHelp Care** 




 MedHelp Care AB is a leading SaaS company offering an AI\-powered, cloud\-based platform for data\-driven corporate health and expert medical advisory services. Used by around 500 companies in the Nordics and connecting up to 200,000 employees, our platform helps reduce sick leave, increase employee presence, and lower costs.
 



 Founded in 1999, we operate in Sweden, Finland, and Denmark with a team of around 45 employees.
 



  





 Our mission is to improve employee health through proactive, data\-driven initiatives and contribute to a healthier society by halving long\-term sick leave. At the heart of this mission is a machine learning model that helps us identify and address health risks proactively. If you’re motivated by applying machine learning to health, and you’d rather work across the whole lifecycle of a model at a small company than on one slice of it at a large one, this role is for you.
 



  





*In this recruitment, we are collaborating with Safemind, and all applications will be processed through them.*

title: Senior & Expert Data Scientists - Build the Future of AI in Operations
description:
**Job ID: 6430**
**Join us in scaling Generative AI across one of the largest Nordic organizations**
 We are looking for experienced Senior and Expert Data Scientists to help shape the next generation of AI\-powered solutions across Operations. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of Generative AI, transforming ambitious ideas into secure, scalable, and production\-grade applications that deliver tangible business value.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Our mission is to enable Operations to deliver on its 2030 strategic ambitions by creating clarity on priorities, driving data\-driven decision\-making, and ensuring optimal allocation of resources and investments. The team plays a key role in accelerating transformation across all Operations Service Lines through the practical application of Artificial Intelligence and Automation.
   

  

 You will join a growing team of specialists, engineers, and business experts who are passionate about solving complex problems and creating innovative solutions that improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

 As a Senior or Expert Data Scientist, you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI solutions from concept to production.
   

  

**You will:**
* Identify and shape high\-impact AI and Generative AI opportunities with business stakeholders
* Prototype, build, deploy, and monitor production\-grade AI applications
* Design and implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI, and LLM\-powered solutions
* Collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, architects, and business experts to deliver end\-to\-end solutions
* Drive experimentation, evaluation frameworks, and model quality assessments
* Contribute to AI architecture, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices
* Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, governance, and Responsible AI requirements
* Support the adoption of AI across Operations through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical leadership


**Who You Are**
 We believe you are curious, pragmatic, and passionate about turning cutting\-edge technology into real business outcomes.
   

  

**Required experience and skills:**
* MSc or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience is also highly valued.
* 3\+ years of experience delivering production\-grade AI, Machine Learning, or advanced analytics solutions
* Strong Python development skills and experience with modern AI/ML frameworks
* Hands\-on experience developing Generative AI applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic frameworks, MCP, A2A, or similar emerging technologies
* Proven ability to take ideas from prototype to scalable production solutions
* Experience with testing, evaluation, experimentation, and performance measurement of AI systems
* Strong understanding of software engineering, DevOps, observability, CI/CD, and production support
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


**Highly valued experience:**
* Experience working within AWS\-based AI and data environments, hands\-on experience with SageMaker, Bedrock, and cloud\-native AI development
* Experience integrating AI solutions through Kong API Gateway and enterprise API ecosystems
* Knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, model governance, and responsible AI practices
* Experience working in regulated industries such as banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, or telecommunications


**What We Offer**
 People join us when they want to make a real impact. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on strategic AI initiatives, solve meaningful business challenges, and help shape how AI is adopted at scale.
   

  

**We offer:**
* The opportunity to work on some of the most exciting AI and Generative AI initiatives in the Nordics
* A collaborative and highly skilled team with deep expertise across AI, engineering, operations, and transformation
* Significant opportunities for professional growth, learning, and career development
* A culture built on collaboration, ownership, passion, and courage
* Flexible hybrid working arrangements
* A strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities


**Ready to shape the future of AI?**
 If you are passionate about building impactful AI solutions and want to help drive one of the largest AI transformations in the Nordic region, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**We review applications continuously and will be hiring on an ongoing basis. Apply today and become part of our AI journey.**
 People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

 A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

 Our way of working \- We believe in bringing people together and want our offices to remain a cornerstone of the company. Our offices are where we connect, collaborate, learn from one another and build our culture. Therefore, as a principle, we work mostly from the office.
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 11/10/2026\.
   

  

 For more information, you’re welcome to contact Harit Fanish at harit.fanish@nordea.com.
   

  

**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**
**We build relationships** 
 . We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

**We learn and develop.** 
 We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

**We lead change** 
 . We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

**We are Nordea** 
 . We have a 200\-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. title: Machine Learning Engineer - Data, ML & Applied AI
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a
 **Machine Learning Engineer** 
 in our
 **Stockholm** 
 office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who wants to combine strong data and machine learning fundamentals with the opportunities created by modern AI.
   

  

 At Viaplay, you'll help build the models and data products that shape how millions of people discover and experience entertainment. You'll work across the ML lifecycle from understanding data and selecting the right algorithms to building pipelines, deploying models, and monitoring them in production.
   

  

 You'll also help us develop more effective ways of working with AI. This includes using AI\-assisted, spec\-driven workflows and building reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge\-based solutions. The goal is practical impact: delivering faster, reducing technical debt, improving access to knowledge, and creating reliable systems that are easier to develop and maintain.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who understands that AI can significantly improve how we work but that great solutions still depend on high\-quality data, sound ML principles, critical thinking, and thoughtful engineering.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models for recommendations, predictions, classification, and personalization
* Build and maintain scalable data and ML pipelines in a modern cloud environment
* Use AI\-assisted, spec\-driven workflows to turn clear requirements into tested, production\-ready solutions
* Build reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge\-based tools that support data, ML, and engineering teams
* Apply AI to improve existing systems, automate repetitive work, and reduce technical debt
* Collaborate with product, engineering, data science, content, commercial, and marketing teams
* Monitor models and pipelines to ensure they remain reliable, understandable, and effective.


**What We’re Looking For**
 We're seeking someone who combines technical depth with strategic thinking and a curious, problem\-solving mindset.
   

  

 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience applying machine learning or data science in production
* A solid understanding of data, statistics, and core ML algorithms \- including how to select and evaluate the right approach
* Experience taking ML projects from problem definition and experimentation through deployment and monitoring
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using Spark or similar data\-processing technologies
* Experience building data pipelines and using orchestration tools such as Airflow
* Practical experience with or strong curiosity about generative AI, AI agents, and AI\-assisted engineering
* The ability to review and validate AI\-generated output rather than treating it as automatically correct
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative, curious approach to problem\-solving


**It’s a bonus if you have:** 
  

  

* Experience with recommender systems, search, ranking, or personalization.
* Experience building AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation solutions, or internal knowledge tools
* Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, MLOps, CI/CD, and observability
* Experience in streaming, media, e\-commerce, or another digital product environment


**You don't need to meet every requirement to apply. We value different perspectives, a willingness to learn, and people who are excited to explore how strong ML foundations and modern AI can work together to create meaningful products.**
 What we offer you
   

  

* We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* A safe space to grow and up\-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week\-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier \& viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.


**Hit play today**
 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Flightradar24 is one of the most successful growth\-stage tech companies in Stockholm. Each month more than 50 million aviation enthusiasts visit Flightradar24 (app/website) and our Commercial services team has many of the biggest names in aviation on its customer list.
   

  

 The position requires that you are able to work from our office in Stockholm, Sweden. Relocation is not offered for this role.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 Your responsibilities include
   

  

* Designing and improving data ingestion, streaming, and event processing (batch and real\-time)
* Refactoring and enhancing existing services, pipelines, and infrastructure
* Implementing robust data collection, transformation, and storage solutions
* Operating and improving cloud\-based platforms (primarily AWS)
* Improving observability, reliability, and operational tooling for production systems
* Contributing to best practices around CI/CD, testing, code quality, and documentation
* Collaborating with software engineers, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reliable data products


 Current tech stack
   

  

* Cloud \& Data Platform: AWS (S3, Glue/Spark, Airflow/MWAA, Athena, MSK/Kafka, Lambda)
* Streaming \& Messaging: Kafka (or similar), RabbitMQ
* Databases \& Storage: SQL/NoSQL systems (e.g., MySQL/MariaDB/Postgres, Redis, DynamoDB, data lake/warehouse patterns)
* DevOps \& Platform: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform
* Engineering practices: Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, linting, unit tests, integration tests


**About You**
* Experience with data engineering architectures for ingestion and transformation
* Several years of hands\-on experience building and operating production systems
* Experience working with cloud\-based platforms, preferably AWS
* Solid understanding of databases (warehouses, OLTP/OLAP concepts, query performance)
* Experience with event\-driven or streaming architectures (Kafka or similar)
* Strong understanding of reliability, observability, and production operations


 We also see that you…
   

  

* Are self\-driven and comfortable making technical decisions independently
* Can quickly understand and work within an existing codebase and architecture
* Value clean code, testing, automation, and pragmatic engineering practices
* Communicate clearly and professionally in English


**About Flightradar24**
 With over 4 million daily users, Flightradar24 is the world’s most popular flight tracking service. Our app regularly tops the App Store and Google Play Travel charts. We also offer a wide range of commercial services and our customers include many of the biggest names in aviation.
   

  

 We're constantly adding new services and improving existing products. To help us meet those challenges, we're looking for creative, collaborative and tech\-savvy applicants to join us.
   

  

 Benefits of working at Flightradar24 include:
   

  

* Opportunity to impact a service with millions of end users from all around the world
* Flexible and social work environment with free beverages, fruit, and snacks
* Modern office in the heart of beautiful downtown Stockholm, Sweden
* Being part of a diverse team with \+30 nationalities and 6 continents represented with English being our main language


 Flightradar24 started as a hobby project in 2006 when two Swedish aviation geeks decided to build a network of ADS\-B receivers in Northern and Central Europe. In 2009 we opened up the network, and made it possible for anyone with an ADS\-B receiver to upload data to the network. Many parts of the world were quickly covered, but the quest to provide global ADS\-B coverage is still ongoing.
   

  

**Flightradar24 at a glance**
* Largest ADS\-B network in the world with over 55,000 connected receivers
* 5\+ million users per day
* 100\+ million app downloads

title: Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
description:
If you choose to apply, please read the job ad in full and include a short cover letter. We are most interested in hearing from the real you, so we encourage authentic applications written in your own words.
   

  

 The opportunity in a nutshell
   

  

 Interested in combining hands\-on data engineering with close collaboration across the business? This role could be a good fit for someone with
 **4\+ years** 
 of experience who enjoys building reliable data products and working with others to make them useful.
   

  

**Role** 
 : Join as a
 **Data Engineer** 
 in our Data Product Engineering team within Schibsted's Data \& AI organization, where we build reliable, well\-governed, and scalable data products used across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other parts of the business.
   

  

**Core tools and practices** 
 : Our everyday toolkit includes SQL and Python as core languages, together with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Terraform, and Git, supported by solid engineering practices around testing, documentation, CI/CD, and version control.
   

  

**Company** 
 : Schibsted is home to some of the most established and widely used media brands in the Nordics, including Aftenposten, VG, Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet, E24, Bergens Tidende, and Stavanger Aftenblad. Across our broader Data \& AI focus, data, analytics, and AI help us build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across those newsrooms and businesses.
   

  

**Location** 
 : This role is based in Oslo or Stockholm. We work in a hybrid setup, which means this is not a fully remote role, and candidates need to reside in Sweden or Norway and be able to work from one of our offices at least 2 days a week.
   

  

**Why this role** 
 : You will join a relatively new team with room to contribute, learn, and help shape how we work as we continue to build trusted data products across Schibsted.
   

  

 Sounds like your kind of role? Read on
   

  

 Who are you?
   

  

 We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering who is also excited by the opportunity to keep learning, deepen their craft, and grow together with the team.
   

  

* You have around 4\+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role, with a track record of building reliable data solutions in production environments.
* Strong SQL skills are important, along with a solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and how to design data products that are useful, trustworthy, and maintainable.
* You can write and debug SQL and Python yourself at a strong professional level. AI\-assisted tools are welcome, but this role requires solid enough fundamentals to solve everyday engineering problems without depending totally on them.
* On the Python side, we are looking for good software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to structure maintainable applications and apply object\-oriented design principles where appropriate.
* You have hands\-on experience with dbt in production environments and solid working knowledge of the wider toolkit we use, including Airflow, Snowflake, AWS, Terraform, Git, and Python and / or similar tools.
* You will likely enjoy this role if you are comfortable making pragmatic technical decisions in environments where requirements evolve and not everything is fully defined upfront.
* You care about engineering quality and can contribute to practices around testing, documentation, observability, governance, and cost\-efficient pipeline design.
* Clear communication matters just as much as technical strength. We value people who can work well with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, explain tradeoffs clearly, and contribute positively to team collaboration and knowledge sharing.


 What's the job like?
   

  

 As a
 **Data Engineer** 
 , your job is to help us build data as a product, not just pipelines that move data from one place to another. You will create robust data models, improve the reliability and scalability of our pipelines, and help shape the engineering practices that make our data products trusted and reusable across Schibsted Media.
   

  

 What you will be expected to do
   

  

* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into pragmatic, well\-scoped data solutions.
* Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and transformations in Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python.
* Develop scalable data models that support analytics, reporting, and future AI use cases.
* Improve technical quality through testing, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable engineering practices.
* Contribute to good architectural and implementation decisions across the team.
* Contribute through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Work closely with adjacent platform and Data \& AI teams to align on standards, dependencies, and shared ways of working.


 What success looks like
   

  

 Success in this role means growing into a
 **confident contributor** 
 who understands our data landscape, ways of working, and stakeholder needs. Over time, that includes contributing across a mix of smaller
 **support tasks** 
 through our
 **weekly rotation** 
 as well as
 **larger pieces of work** 
 , helping build reliable pipelines and data models, and developing the judgment to deliver pragmatic solutions together with the team. Depending on your experience and the needs of the work, that can mean contributing as part of a team or
 **taking the lead on a project** 
 .
   

  

 Why join us?
   

  

* You will join a team that is still shaping its ways of working, which means there is real room to contribute, learn, and grow.
* You will work on data products with visible impact across Schibsted, supporting both technical and non\-technical users in domains such as Product, Subscription, Finance, and HR.
* You will be part of a company whose work matters in everyday life across the Nordics, helping support trusted media brands through better data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* You will work in an international environment with strong trust, autonomy, and good opportunities for learning through engineering communities and collaboration across Data \& AI.
* You will join a team that enjoys solving challenging problems, wants to build high\-quality data products, and cares about the people they work with.


 Got your attention? Let us hear from you!
   

  

 The application period closes on
 **28 September 2026\.** 
 We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to millions of people of people in their everyday lives.
   

  

 Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.
   

  

 In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70\-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.
   

  

 By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology\-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.
   

  

 Our ambition is to continue our fast\-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision\-making close to our customers.
   

  

 If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Engineer in our Global Data \& BI team, you will build and operate the pipelines that power the Odevo Data Warehouse (ODW). Working within an established Microsoft Fabric architecture, you'll ingest data from the many source systems used across our operating companies, model it into trusted, reusable datasets, and keep it flowing reliably to the dashboards and data products our business depends on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines in Fabric Data Factory across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and file\-based feeds, including incremental and change data capture patterns.
* Develop and test transformation models across the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers (medallion architecture), following the team's modelling standards and naming conventions.
* Model data for analytical consumption — dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, and handling multi\-entity, multi\-currency and multi\-country data.
* Operate what you build: monitor pipeline health, investigate and fix failures, respond to source schema changes, and improve reliability and run cost.
* Implement data quality tests and validation rules in pipelines, working to the standards set by our Data Enablement squad.
* Prepare and document governed datasets for the Published layer, so that BI developers, semantic models and downstream applications can consume them with confidence.
* Work within our engineering workflow — version control and CI/CD in Azure DevOps, peer review, secrets management in Azure Key Vault, and clear documentation of pipelines and lineage.
* Work directly with BI developers and business stakeholders to understand what the data is for, and translate that into pipelines and models that answer the actual question.


**Who You Are**
 You're a pragmatic builder who gets things into production. You're comfortable with messy, undocumented source systems and enjoy the detective work of figuring out what the data actually means. You take ownership of the pipelines you build rather than handing them over, you ask what a dataset is for before you build it, and you can explain what you've done to someone who doesn't work in data. You want to work somewhere the data platform is still being built out, rather than somewhere it's already finished.
   

  

**Experience**
* 2–4 years' hands\-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
* Strong SQL, and Python for data manipulation, automation and API\-based ingestion.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Data Warehouse / Lakehouse, OneLake) — or with the Azure equivalents such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks, and the appetite to move onto Fabric quickly.
* Practical experience transformation framework and a solid grasp of modular, tested SQL modelling.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT and dimensional modelling.
* Comfortable working with Git\-based version control and CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps.
* Awareness of data protection and security practice — GDPR, handling of personal data, role\-based access — applied to the data you work with.
* Nice to have: experience integrating newly acquired businesses or consolidating data across multiple legal entities; exposure to Power BI as a consumer of your models.


**What Success Looks Like In Your First Six Months**
* You've independently onboarded a new source system into the Bronze and Silver layers, from first connection through to a tested, documented model.
* You're the go\-to person for two or three pipelines, including keeping them running.
* You've built at least one Gold\-layer dataset that a BI developer or stakeholder is actively using for reporting.
* You're contributing to code review and raising improvements to how the team works, not just consuming the standards.


**What We Offer**
* Professional growth \- to work with the most talented developers in the industry.
* Modern technology \- we invest in the latest technologies and tools and encourage our team members to share their ideas and take ownership of their work.
* Innovation \- to work on exciting projects that push the boundaries of our industry and make a real impact.
* Commitment to quality \- a dynamic and forward\-thinking company that values profitable and long\-term product development.


**Excited?**

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
We are super excited to announce that
 **Mattias Edler Wadström** 
 is looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Product \& Customer Insights to join our internal Data \& Analytics team.
 



  





 Our ambition is to better understand how customers use our products, what creates value for them, and how we can turn those signals into smarter decisions across Voyado. As part of this journey, we’re exploring not only
 *what* 
 we measure, but also new ways of making insights accessible and actionable – from self\-service analytics and operational intelligence to AI\-powered experiences.
 



  





**About the role** 




 This is not a traditional reporting or dashboarding role.
 



 As our Senior Data Analyst, you’ll work at the intersection of data, product, and business. You’ll explore how customers adopt and engage with Voyado’s products, identify patterns connected to customer success and value, and turn complex data into insights that people can actually act on.
 



  





 You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Customer Success, Account Management, Marketing, and our Data \& Analytics team. Sometimes that means diving into a business question and finding the story hidden in the data. Other times, it means defining a new KPI, testing an analytical concept, or prototyping a completely new way of delivering insights.
 



 An important part of the role will also be exploring what modern analytics can look like at Voyado. Rather than assuming that every question needs another dashboard, you’ll experiment with conversational analytics, automated insights, alerts, triggers, and AI\-assisted exploration.
 



  





**In this role, you will:** 



* Analyzing product adoption, engagement, feature usage, and customer behavior across Voyado’s product portfolio. Then turning it into clear insights and business recommendations.
* Helping Customer Success and Account Management better understand customer health, risks, and opportunities.
* Defining and validating KPIs, metrics, and measurement frameworks together with stakeholders
* Contributing to how Voyado measures and communicates customer value and value realization
* Prototyping analytical solutions that can later be operationalized and scaled together with the wider Data \& Analytics team
* Exploring AI\-powered and self\-service analytics, including conversational analytics, intelligent alerts, and automated insight delivery



  





**Who you are** 




 We’re looking for someone who combines analytical depth with business curiosity and a bias towards action.
 



  





 You enjoy digging into data, but the analysis itself isn’t the end goal for you. You want to understand
 *why something is happening, why it matters, and what we should do with that information.* 




  





 You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous questions where the answer – or sometimes even the right metric – hasn’t been defined yet. You know how to bring structure to those situations, test hypotheses, and communicate what you discover in a way that makes sense to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
 



  





 You also don’t need everything to be perfectly built before getting started. You enjoy experimenting, prototyping, and validating whether an idea creates value before turning it into something more scalable.
 



  





 And with analytics evolving quickly, you’re curious about how AI can change the way people or agents interact with data and insights – and excited to help us explore what that could look like at Voyado.
 


* Several years of experience within data analysis, product analytics, customer analytics, or a similar field
* Strong SQL skills and experience exploring and working with complex datasets
* A solid understanding of data modelling and analytical data structures
* Experience defining KPIs, metrics, or measurement frameworks
* Strong data visualization and storytelling skills
* Experience collaborating with multiple stakeholder groups and communicating with both technical and non\-technical audiences



  





**High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.** 




 You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.
 



 At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.
 



  





**Some of our benefits:** 



* 30 days of vacation
* Wellness allowance
* Personal development opportunities
* Summits and team activities
* Four days from the office and one day from home



  





**About Voyado** 




 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
 



 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e\-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail\-trained AI that acts on real\-time shopper intent.
 



  





 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in\-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
 



 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
 



  





**Ready to make an impact?** 




 Fantastic! 🎉
 



 Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
 



  





**Additional information** 




 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
 



  





**Making it personal with AI** 




 We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
 



 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over\-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist
   

 We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision\-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
   

 As the company continues to invest in its Data \& ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
   

 About the role:This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data\-driven solutions that create measurable value.
   

 The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business\-critical initiatives.
   

 This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
   

 What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
   

 About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real\-world business challenges.
   

 You'll likely have:3\+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
   

 Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
   

 Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
   

 You'll be joining a collaborative Data \& ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision\-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
   

 The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
   

 If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving \- and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact \- we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data Scientist, Pricing
description:
**TL;DR** 
 — You own the data behind how Lovable prices and packages. You turn usage, cost, and willingness\-to\-pay data into pricing and packaging bets, run the experiments to test them, and build the models that tell us what a change does to revenue and retention.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024\. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent\-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low\-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest\-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Commercially\-minded owner: A data scientist who owns pricing and packaging outcomes. You find the opportunity, model it, test it, and drive the change.
* Economics fluency: Deep understanding of unit economics including LTV, margin, token and infrastructure cost, willingness to pay, discounting, and subscription or credit models.
* Technical rigor: Strong SQL, Python, applied statistics, and experimentation skills. You are comfortable with causal questions where a clean A/B test is not always possible.
* Systems builder: You build the systems that price and package, such as discounting or packaging models that run on user records, rather than just delivering one\-off analyses.
* Strategic judgment: An instinct for the tradeoff between growth and monetization, and the judgment to know when to prioritize each.
* Entrepreneurial spirit: You thrive with autonomy and enjoy working closely with finance, product, and growth teams.


**What You'll Do**
* Own the analytics behind pricing and packaging: what we charge, how we package it, and the impact of changes on revenue, conversion, and retention.
* Build models for unit economics, willingness to pay, and price sensitivity, translating them into concrete pricing bets.
* Design and execute pricing and packaging experiments, and act decisively on the results.
* Build the systems that operationalize pricing decisions, such as personalized discounting based on user records.
* Collaborate with finance, product, and growth to sequence and ship pricing changes effectively.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Languages: SQL and Python
* Warehouse \& events: BigQuery, PubSub
* Analytics \& product: Hex, Lovable Apps
* Experimentation: A/B and growth testing
* Cloud: GCP


 And we are always on the lookout for what's next.
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
* A call with the hiring manager
* A take\-home case study
* A Most Impressive Project session
* Cross\-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
* A final conversation with leadership


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking it daily if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.
