title: Business Analyst
description:
**För En Hållbar Framtid Tillsammans**
 Coop är Sveriges största kooperation och en ledande aktör inom dagligvaruhandeln, med över 4 miljoner medlemmar. Vi har ett stort fokus på hållbarhet och arbetar för att skapa en mer grön och rättvis framtid genom att erbjuda hållbara produkter och tjänster.
   

  

 Vi tror på att en mångfald av perspektiv och erfarenheter är nyckeln till att skapa en mer inkluderande och framgångsrik arbetsplats. Därför välkomnar vi alla oavsett kön, ålder, bakgrund och etnisk tillhörighet.
   

  

**Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens kampanjupplevelse på Coop?**
 På Coop arbetar vi varje dag för att skapa en hållbar matkedja och göra det enklare för våra kunder och medlemmar att göra bra val. Våra digitala tjänster spelar en central roll i den resan. Nu söker vi en Business Analyst till Team Kampanj inom Digitala Konsumentprodukter.
   

  

 I rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan affär, produkt och teknik. Du blir en nyckelperson i arbetet med att utveckla Coops kampanjförmåga, från breda och riktade erbjudanden till digitala kampanjupplevelser som skapar värde för kunder, medlemmar och verksamhet. Vi söker nu en person som kan förstå affärsutmaningar, identifiera rotorsaker, skapa samsyn mellan intressenter och hjälpa teamet att leverera mätbart värde.
   

  

***Om rollen***
 Som Business Analyst i Team Kampanj arbetar du nära produktägare, utvecklare, arkitekter och verksamhetsrepresentanter för att förstå behov, analysera problem och säkerställa att teamet utvecklar lösningar som skapar konkret affärs\- och kundvärde.
   

  

 Produktägaren för Team Kampanj arbetsleder och prioriterar det dagliga arbetet i teamet. Du ansvarar för kvaliteten i analys\- och kravarbete samt bidrar med underlag till produktägarens prioriteringar. Du rapporterar till rekryterande chef, Product Area Lead för Engagement \& Loyalty.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar verksamhetsförståelse, strukturerad analys och nära samarbete med utvecklingsteamet. Du förväntas utmana otydliga behov, synliggöra beroenden och risker samt bidra till att teamet kan arbeta stegvis, hypotesdrivet och med tydliga effekter.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**
* Samla in, analysera och konkretisera verksamhets\-, kund\- och affärsbehov från olika intressenter.
* Identifiera bakomliggande problem och rotorsaker innan lösningar och krav formuleras, som kan kommuniceras till interna utvecklare såväl som externa utvecklare hos våra leverantörer
* Bryta ned komplexa behov till tydliga, genomförbara och testbara krav, user stories och acceptanskriterier.
* Leda workshops, intervjuer och kravdialoger som skapar samsyn mellan verksamhet, produkt och teknik.
* Ta fram analyser, konsekvensbedömningar och beslutsunderlag för produktägaren och andra intressenter.
* Säkerställa tydlighet och spårbarhet mellan behov, krav, lösning, leverans och önskad effekt.
* Arbeta nära utvecklare och testare genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från analys till implementering och uppföljning.
* Bidra till att definiera mätetal och följa upp om genomförda initiativ ger förväntat kund\- och affärsvärde.
* Koordinera analys\- och kravarbete i större initiativ som involverar flera team, system, leverantörer eller verksamhetsdelar.
* Bidra till kontinuerlig utveckling av arbetssätt inom affärsanalys, kravhantering och produktutveckling.


***Vem är du?***
 Du är analytisk, strukturerad och nyfiken. Du kan skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang, kommunicera med olika målgrupper och stå kvar i problemet tills teamet har en gemensam förståelse för vad som behöver lösas och varför.
   

  

 Du arbetar självständigt inom ditt ansvarsområde, samtidigt som du ser samarbete med produktägaren och övriga teammedlemmar som en förutsättning för bra resultat. Du vågar ställa frågor, utmana antaganden och föreslå vägar framåt.
   

  

**Vi tror att du har**
* Erfarenhet som Business Analyst, kravanalytiker eller i en liknande roll inom digital produkt\- eller systemutveckling.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT samt nära agila utvecklingsteam.
* Erfarenhet av att använda AI\-baserade verktyg och arbetssätt där det skapar tydligt värde i analys, dokumentation, kvalitetssäkring, processer eller digitala lösningar.
* Förmåga att omsätta komplexa affärsbehov till tydliga analyser, krav och beslutsunderlag.
* Erfarenhet av att formulera user stories, acceptanskriterier och testbara krav.
* Vana att självständigt facilitera workshops och dialoger med flera typer av intressenter.
* Förmåga att använda data och andra insikter för att underbygga beslut och följa upp effekt.
* God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har
   

  

* Erfarenhet från retail, dagligvaruhandel eller annan verksamhet med stora transaktions\- och kundvolymer.
* Erfarenhet av kampanjhantering, CRM, lojalitetsprogram, personalisering eller digital kundkommunikation.
* Erfarenhet av integrationer och komplexa systemlandskap med beroenden mellan flera team och leverantörer.
* Erfarenhet av hypotesdriven utveckling, effektmätning eller A/B\-testning.


**Vårt Erbjudande Till Dig**
 Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att växa och utvecklas i en inkluderande och inspirerande kultur. Hos oss på Coop blir du en del av ett engagerat team som bidrar till en mer hållbar framtid. Vi arbetar från kontoret tre dagar i veckan och erbjuder flexibilitet resterande dagar. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga förmåner och en god balans mellan arbete och fritid.
   

  

**Så ansöker du**
 Låter detta som din nästa utmaning? Skicka in din ansökan senast
 **27 september** 
 . Vi arbetar löpande med urval och intervjuer och tjänsten kan därför komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
   

  

 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi tester för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning av våra kandidater.
   

  

 Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef
 **Viktoria Fridlund** 
 (Viktoria.fridlund@coop.se).

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
 We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join our growing tech development team, building products for the financial industry. Much of the risk, compliance and regulatory work in financial services still runs on spreadsheets and manual reconciliation. We are building the intelligence platform that changes that, and we need engineers who can build it and put it into production for clients.
   

  

 We are hiring two Forward Deployed AI Engineers for our tech development team. Forward deployed means you own a module from design to a client running it: you develop on our platform, deploy it in live environments used by clients, connect their data, get the numbers right and hand over something their risk and finance teams use every day. Some weeks are pure product engineering/development; others are spent working downstream with client environments, client data and their stakeholders.
   

  

 Advisense is building the next generation intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists, the people who understand what the numbers are and the regulations mean. The work spans data ingestion and pipelines, backend logic, APIs and user interfaces, across areas such as credit risk, capital, AML, KYC and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. You are expected to use AI effectively and critically, while taking responsibility for understanding, validating, testing and maintaining everything you deliver.
   

  

**As Part Of Our Tech Development Team, You Will**
* Take modules from technical design through implementation, release, monitoring and iteration.
* Implement modules at clients, including data onboarding, integration, validation and go\-live.
* Build data pipelines, backend services, APIs and frontend applications.
* Turn complex financial and regulatory requirements into clear and useful product features.
* Build AI\-enabled workflows with appropriate evaluation, monitoring and human oversight.
* Work closely with product owners, senior engineers, regulatory consultants and client teams.


**Background And Experience**
* Professional proficiency in both Python and TypeScript.
* Experience building and maintaining production software.
* Experience building polished user interfaces together with product teams.
* Practical experience with APIs, data modelling, integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting applications in production.
* Hands\-on experience building applications with AI and an effective AI\-assisted development workflow.
* A strong approach to testing, maintainability, security and privacy.
* Comfortable working directly with clients and their data.
* Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.


 Experience with Palantir Foundry is a strong plus. Experience from financial services, GRC, AML, KYC, credit risk or another regulated environment is beneficial but not required.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are looking for a pragmatic and self\-driven engineer who enjoys taking ownership from idea to production. You do not need to be an expert in every layer – what matters is that you are comfortable working broadly, learn quickly and approach unfamiliar problems pragmatically.
   

  

 You use AI tools critically and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver. You also enjoy working close to the business and the client, understanding their needs and turning complex requirements into solutions that work in practice.
   

  

 You will join a small, collaborative development team where you will deliver modules and client implementations independently, with support from senior engineers, product owners and Advisense’s regulatory specialists.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.
   

  

 Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews, a technical case and reference checks. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.
   

  

 To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.
   

  

**Company Description**
 Advisense has grown to become a market\-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

title: Data Engineer
description:
ALTEN Sweden is looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Databricks, cloud platforms, and modern data engineering** 
 to join an exciting long\-term assignment. You will work with our Swedish and international clients to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud\-based solutions. Your expertise in Databricks, multi\-cloud platforms, and SQL will enable organizations to harness data for innovation, efficiency, and decision\-making. You’ll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver tailored data architectures that align with client needs in industries like automotive, engineering, banking, IT, and telecom.
 



  





**WHAT DO WE OFFER
 
 ?** 




 As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
 


* Technical challenges and development opportunities.
* An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
* Supportive and coaching leadership.
* The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
* A personal training budget for internal or external courses.



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE**




 This role focuses on designing, building, and managing data pipelines that efficiently collect, transform, and deliver data from various sources to cloud\-based or hybrid storage solutions. The professional ensures that data remains accessible, reliable, and optimized for analysis and business decision\-making. A significant aspect of the role involves working with large\-scale data processing frameworks to support analytics and machine learning initiatives. Strong SQL expertise is essential for writing and refining queries to guarantee high performance and data accuracy in client projects.
 



  





 The position also emphasizes collaboration, as the individual will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions that drive actionable insights. Additionally, the role includes implementing data governance practices to ensure compliance with Swedish and EU regulations, such as GDPR, while maintaining robust data security and metadata management.
 



  





**Required competencies** 




  




* Experience: 5\+ years as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
* SQL: Strong skills in advanced querying, optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Databricks: Hands\-on experience with Delta Lake, Spark, and cluster management.
* Multi\-Cloud: Proficiency in AWS, Azure, or GCP (certifications are a plus).
* Programming: Experience with Python, Scala, or PySpark for data processing.
* Big Data Technologies: Familiarity with Hadoop, Kafka, or Snowflake.
* Data Modeling: Knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schema, and warehouse design.



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Experience with MLOps or deploying machine learning models.
* Knowledge of data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik).
* Familiarity with Swedish business culture and regulations.



  





  





**ABOUT ALTEN**




 ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies, with over 57,000 employees across approximately 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the entire product development chain for leading companies in several industries including Automotive, Defense \& Security, Energy, Industrial Equipment, Public Sector, and Life Sciences.
 



 In Sweden, we are approximately 1,300 dedicated employees spread across 9 offices in cities ranging from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
 



 For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by
 *Karriärföretagen* 
 for five consecutive years — an award for companies offering unique career and development opportunities.
 



  





  





 Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

title: Senior Data Engineer (Cloud Lakehouse)
description:
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be at the forefront of designing and building innovative data solutions within a fast\-paced agile data engineering team. You will play a crucial role in modernizing our data platform to enhance product offerings, closely collaborating with stakeholders across the organization to maximize the value of data for reporting, analytics, and decision\-making processes.
 



  





 In this role, you'll help transform our cloud data landscape, working with streaming technologies, cloud data warehouses, and Lakehouse architectures to unlock new insights and capabilities for our business units. Additionally, you will leverage automation and generative AI to increase operational efficiency and enhance self\-service capabilities across the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Data Platform \& Architecture** 



* Develop and maintain robust and efficient data solutions and products including data transformation, data modelling, and reporting on both on\-premises and cloud environments
* Build modern data lake/lakehouse architectures that support scalable, flexible data processing
* Enhance platform integration by leveraging domain events to enable more efficient and real\-time data processing



**Self\-Service Analytics \& Enablement** 



* Champion the adoption of generative AI features such as Amazon Q and Copilot to deliver intuitive analytics experiences
* Build sophisticated solutions to deliver actionable insights, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and data accessibility



**Engineering Excellence \& Automation** 



* Enhance data engineering processes through automation, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and optimizing ETL/ELT flows to improve efficiency and maintainability
* Be a champion of best development practices on existing and new technologies
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, documenting them as GAPs and aligning them with Architects



**Data Governance \& Discovery** 



* Facilitate data discovery and enhance data management processes using platforms like Open Metadata
* Ensure KPIs and documentation remain accurate and up to date
* Support data quality and compliance standards across the organization



**Innovation \& Operations** 



* Initiate and experiment with new ideas and approaches that support the A\&I department's strategy
* Proactively support and maintain data products, including handling release management, troubleshooting incidents, and providing on\-call support as necessary



  





**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience** 




**Required** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, with demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing scalable, flexible modern data architectures
* Experience building modern data lake/lakehouse architectures (e.g., Apache Iceberg) in cloud environments
* Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, Redshift) or Azure data services
* Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion
* Proven expertise using transformation tools such as dbt
* Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools (such as Apache Airflow)
* Experience with best practices applied to data (e.g., testing, CI/CD)



**Advantageous** 



* Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Amazon QuickSight
* Experience with generative AI applications in data analytics
* Nice to have some JAVA experience

title: Senior Data Engineer to Sergel Group
description:
Sergel Group is one of the leading providers of credit management services in the Nordic region. We offer services within credit scoring, debt collection, debt purchasing, as well as messaging and payment solutions. Sergel is part of Marginalen Group and has just over 150 employees across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 Sergel is on an exciting journey to strengthen its in\-house capabilities, bringing more competence and ownership closer to the business. This means several ongoing development areas and new projects where data plays a central role, and the people who work with it are central to Sergel's ability to compete and grow across the Nordic market.
 



  





 In this role, you will drive the development of scalable, efficient and compliant data solutions, with a strong focus on operational excellence and exploring new opportunities for innovation. You will have significant autonomy and a broad mandate to influence technical direction, make key decisions and ensure they are executed with real impact.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. Over time, you are motivated by the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and a more leading position within the area.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include:
 



 • Defining and enforcing data modeling standards, best practices and governance policies.
 



 • Designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and optimizing ETL processes.
 



 • Building and maintaining applications and integrations for data ingestion, transformation and delivery.
 



 • Driving the shift from external\-dependent delivery toward strong in\-house capability.
 



 • Setting the technical direction and owning key architectural decisions.
 



 • Ensuring that BI is an integral part of the data platform, enabling trusted reporting, analytics and data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 




 You are someone who combines deep technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership. You communicate clearly across technical and non\-technical stakeholders and thrive in environments where you can shape and improve things rather than just maintain them.
 



 You enjoy working closely with others, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow through collaboration, curiosity and mutual respect. You are humble enough to listen and confident enough to challenge when needed.
 



  





 You also bring:
 



 • Solid experience as a Data Engineer and experience with designing, modeling and implementing data\-intensive systems.
 



 • Strong proficiency in SQL and C\# .NET/Python.
 



 • Experience with ETL tools, data pipeline frameworks and orchestration tools.
 



 • Understanding of CI/CD principles.
 



 • Knowledge of data governance, GDPR compliance and security best practices.
 



 • The ability to drive technical decisions and set standards.
 



 • Fluency in English.
 



 • Valid work permit.
 



  





 You don't need to be senior in every area listed above. If you bring strong fundamentals and the right mindset, there is room to develop and grow into the full scope of the role.
 



  





 Meriting experience:
 



 • Experience from financial services, credit or similar data\-intensive industries.
 



 • Knowledge of one of the Nordic languages.
 



 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
 



  





**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 In Sergel, we care about the people we meet. We are a company with a culture based on trust and learning, where we work towards strengthening individuals through competence, compassion and a high level of engagement.
 



 Together, we work with clear ownership and shared responsibility towards our stakeholders, which creates long\-term and loyal business relations. We always try to find new ways of working and challenging the market. We want our employees to develop with the company and have fun with their colleagues on the way.
 



  





**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** 




 • Start: By agreement
 



 • Location: Central Stockholm
 



 • Extent: Full\-time
 



 • Salary: By agreement
 



  





 We apply ongoing selection in this recruitment process, which means the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore recommend submitting your application as soon as possible.
 



 If you have any questions regarding Asta Agency's recruitment process, please do not hesitate to contact us at alice@astaagency.se.
 



  





 ABOUT ASTA AGENCY
 



 Asta Agency is a recruitment and staffing company helping businesses across Sweden find the right professionals, with a primary focus on Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Malmö.
 



 We recruit and provide consultants within sales, marketing, HR, customer service, finance, administration, IT, and tech – both specialists and generalists. With a strong focus on quality, long\-term partnerships, and smart solutions, we support both companies and candidates in taking the next step.
 



 Learn more about how we work with recruitment, staffing, and temp\-to\-perm solutions at astaagency.se.

title: Data Engineer med stark Pythonprofil - Futur pension
description:
Vill du kombinera avancerad Pythonutveckling med möjligheten att påverka hur moderna dataflöden byggs? På Futur Pension får du arbeta i en tekniskt ambitiös miljö med komplexa dataflöden, moderna tekniker och nära koppling mellan teknik och verksamhet. En roll för dig som vill arbeta nära tekniken, ta ansvar för dina lösningar och se dem skapa konkret värde för verksamheten.
 



  





**OM TJÄNSTEN:** 




 Som Data Engineer på Futur Pension blir du en viktig del av arbetet med att utveckla och modernisera bolagets analysplattform. Du bygger lösningar som hämtar data från försäkringssystemet, andra verksamhetssystem och externa API:er och förädlar den till kvalitetssäkrad och användbar information för analys, uppföljning och beslutsfattande.
 



 Rollen har ett starkt fokus på Python och innebär att du arbetar genom hela dataflödet, från datakälla och modellering till test, driftsättning och förvaltning. I takt med att plattformen utvecklas får du också bidra till hur Pythonkod, datamodeller och dataflöden struktureras och byggs för att skapa robusta och återanvändbara lösningar.
 



  





**ARBETSUPPGIFTER:** 



* Utveckla och underhålla ETL\-flöden i Python.
* Hämta och integrera data från SQL\-databaser, API:er och verksamhetssystem.
* Transformera, kvalitetssäkra och modellera data.
* Utveckla återanvändbara lösningar för nya datakällor.
* Paketera dataflöden med Docker och köra dem i Azure.
* Bygga in loggning, felhantering och tester.
* Vidareutveckla flöden för bygge och driftsättning i Azure DevOps.
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten och andra utvecklare.



  





**VI SÖKER DIG SOM:** 



* Har en civilingenjörsutbildning inom relevant område
* Har minst tre års arbetslivserfarenhet av professionell utveckling i Python.
* Har goda kunskaper i SQL och relationsdatabaser.
* Har erfarenhet av att utveckla ETL\- eller ELT\-flöden.
* Har förståelse för datamodellering, datakvalitet och spårbarhet.
* Är van vid att utveckla kod som ska testas, driftsättas och förvaltas.
* Har erfarenhet av Git, kodgranskning och CI/CD.
* Har god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska eller engelska.



 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure SQL, Azure Container Apps, Azure Key Vault, Pandas, SQLAlchemy eller PyODBC. Erfarenhet av Docker, infrastruktur som kod, gärna Bicep – testautomatisering, övervakning av dataflöden eller visualiseringsverktyg som Streamlit, Plotly och Power BI är också värdefullt.
 



  





 Du behöver inte ha tidigare erfarenhet av pension eller försäkring. Däremot ser vi gärna att du är nyfiken på verksamheten bakom datat och vill förstå hur informationen hänger ihop.
 



  





 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du tycker om att arbeta i en tekniskt ambitiös miljö där utvecklingen går snabbt och där du får ta stort eget ansvar. Du gillar att gå på djupet i tekniska problem, skriva välstrukturerad kod och samtidigt förstå vilket värde datan skapar för verksamheten. Eftersom du kommer att samarbeta nära både utvecklare och verksamheten är det också viktigt att du uppskattar kunskapsutbyte och nära samarbete.
 



  





**OM FUTUR PENSION:** 




 Futur Pension arbetar inom pension och långsiktigt sparande med fokus på tjänstepension, kapitalförsäkring och sparlösningar. Bolaget har en ambitiös techorganisation där mycket av systemen utvecklas inhouse. Du blir en del av ett prestigelöst team med korta beslutsvägar, stort förtroende och nära samarbete med verksamheten. Analysplattformen befinner sig i en omstöpning, vilket ger dig möjlighet att vara med och påverka hur lösningarna byggs och struktureras framåt.
 



  





**OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:**

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Coop Sverige – Together we make food\-Sweden sustainable** 



  


 At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!
 


  


 Within our AI \& Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a
 **Senior Data Analyst** 
 to help us turn even more of that data into action.
 


  


***Om tjänsten:***
 You will join our Analytics team within AI \& Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.
 


  


 As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.
 


  


 You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.
 


  


**What you will do** 



  

* Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
* Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
* Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
* Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”


  


***Who are you?***



  


 We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.
 


  


 You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.
 


  


**We believe that you** 



  

* Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
* Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
* Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
* Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.


  


**It’s meritorious if you** 



  

* Have experience from a modern cloud\-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
* Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code\-first analytical workflows.
* Have worked in a scale\-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
* Have experience from retail, e\-commerce or another data\-intensive consumer business.


  


***About us***



  


 The grocery trade is a stable, long\-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4\.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.
 


  


 If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Victor Kesten (victor.kesten@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)
 


  


*Welcome with your application!*

title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist (French speaking)
description:
**About the role** 




  






 This week CNN and Reuters reported on our work in DRC together with Vodacom, WHO, Congo government, African CDC and other where we are using mobile\-phone data to understand population movements and get ahead of the Ebola outbreak. This is part of Flowminder's work, and we need one more person on the team doing it.
 




  






 You'll turn mobile operator, survey and spatial data into population and mobility statistics that ministries of health, national statistics offices and UN agencies rely on for outbreak response, humanitarian planning and development decision\-making in DRC and beyond. About a third of the role is training and building capacity with our partner institutions, in French and English, including travel to the countries we work in. It's a job where what you produce on a Tuesday can shape decisions on the ground by Friday.
 




  






 We're looking for someone with a strong quantitative background, solid Python and time\-series skills, spatial data experience, and professional working French.
 





 Permanent, full\-time, based in Stockholm or Southampton (hybrid).
 





 Deadline: 30 September 2026\. We review on a rolling basis.
 




  






 Full details and how to apply:
 
 https://lnkd.in/d2eff96M
 



  





**About Flowminder** 




 Flowminder is a non\-profit foundation. We enable decision makers to access the data they need to transform the lives of vulnerable people, at scale.
 



 We analyse pseudonymised mobile operator data, satellite imagery and household survey data to measure where people are and how they move. Flowminder researchers were the first to use mobile operator data to track population movements after a large\-scale disaster and during a major infectious disease outbreak, following the 2010 Haiti earthquake and cholera outbreak. We work with national statistics offices, health ministries and disaster management agencies in low\- and middle\-income countries, alongside UN agencies, the World Bank and development banks.
 



 We are a small team, based mainly in Southampton and Stockholm, working in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti, Ghana and Pakistan. Our working language is English, but much of our work with partners is in French.

title: AI Engineer till Axfood IT, Stockholm
description:
**Ansökan**
 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Ants Tech Recruiters och du ansöker via deras hemsida, här:
 **AI Engineer till Axfood IT \- Ants.** 
 Notera att ansökningar via denna sida inte kommer att behandlas.
   

  

 Välkommen till Axfood IT, en av matbranschens största IT\-avdelningar med drygt 350 medarbetare. Det är vi som ser till att Axfood, och alla våra kedjor, kan ligga i framkant vad gäller digital utveckling. Vi jobbar med att utveckla och förbättra allt ifrån e\-handel till logistiklösningar och AI.
   

  

 Hos Axfood IT blir du del av ett sammanhang som utmanar och levererar lösningar som gör skillnad, både för våra kollegor och våra kunder. Här finns det alltid möjlighet att lära sig om ny teknik och växa, både som individ och tillsammans med kollegorna.
   

  

**Ditt nya team**
 I rollen blir du en del av vårt nystartade Data \& AI\-center, som har ett tydligt uppdrag: att driva och öka användningen av data och AI för att möjliggöra datadrivna beslut i alla Axfoods bolag och processer. Axfood har länge jobbat med båda AI och ML, men med den här gruppen skapar vi bättre förutsättningar att driva tekniken bredare i organisationen.
   

  

 Gruppen ansvarar för att utveckla och förvalta AI\-modeller och AI\-applikationer, från generativa AI\-lösningar som agenter och chatbots till klassiska ML\-modeller, och ser till att de fungerar i våra huvudprocesser. Här jobbar vi med moderna plattformar, spännande projekt och ett starkt fokus på innovation.
   

  

**Ett ax\-plock \- Kollegornas favoriter på jobbet**
* Möjligheten att påverka hur AI används i en av Sveriges största detaljhandelskoncern
* Bygga upp en funktion från grunden och forma hur vi jobbar
* Möjlighet att bygga och förvalta AI\-modeller som kommer göra faktisk skillnad för våra miljontals kunder varje vecka.


**Om rollen**
 Som AI Engineer kommer du att utveckla och förvalta egenutvecklade AI\-lösningar som blir en del av Axfoods IT\-system och applikationer. Du arbetar nära verksamheten för att förstå behov, omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar och bidra till att AI blir en naturlig del av våra processer.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kan inkludera:**
* Utveckla och förvalta AI\-modeller och applikationer (ML och GenAI) som en del av våra IT\-lösningar
* Arbeta med hela kedjan: från design och utveckling till produktionssättning och MLOps
* Bidra till att etablera best practices för AI\-utveckling och leverans
* Samarbeta med Data Engineers, Tech Product Owners och Delivery Leads för att skapa skalbara lösningar


 Vi söker flera personer till teamet och är därför öppna för olika senioritetsnivåer och specialistkompetenser. Exakt ansvar i rollen kommer därför anpassas till de vi anställer.
   

  

**Stämmer detta in på dig?**
 I den här rekryteringen kommer vi att anställa flera personer och vi är därför intresserade olika senioritetsnivåer. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du dock ha ett minst ett par års erfarenhet inom liknande områden, exempelvis Data Science eller maskininlärning. Du behöver också ha tidigare erfarenhet av att utveckla egna AI\-lösningar.
   

  

**Vidare behöver du ha:**
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera AI\-lösningar som en del av IT\-system
* Kunskap inom ML/AI, generativ AI och gärna erfarenhet av MLOps och DevOps
* Förmåga att arbeta med hela utvecklingskedjan – från design till drift
* Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av att leda backlog refinement eller designarbete för AI\-lösningar


 Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och gillar att samarbeta i en miljö där alla bitar inte är på plats än. Du är med och startar något nytt som formar framtidens Axfood.
   

  

**Ansökningsprocessen**
 Vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att söka jobb hos oss. Om du inte har ett CV redo räcker det med att du länkar en väl ifylld LinkedIn\-profil. I din ansökan får du svara på de frågor vi behöver svar på i den här delen av processen, och personligt brev är därför inte obligatoriskt.
   

  

 Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan därför tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vi kommer hantera både interna och externa kandidater. Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID\-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank\-id eller scanna någon QR\-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.
   

  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten, kontakta benjamin.karlsson@ants.se. Av GDPR\-skäl behandlar vi inga ansökningar eller annan personlig information via mail.

title: AI Engineer
description:
At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world \- giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI\-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy.
   

**About The Role**
 As an AI Engineer at Aceve, you will design, build, and deploy the internal AI solutions that power our digital transformation across the group’s portfolio companies. You’ll sit within the AI Transformation Team, reporting to the Head of AI, and work directly with business teams to ensure the solutions you build are genuinely adopted, iterated on, and making a difference. This is a hands\-on engineering role with real commercial impact — the kind of work that shapes how an entire organisation thinks about AI.
   

**What Will You Do**
 You’ll take ownership of the full lifecycle of internal AI products — from scoping with business stakeholders through to deployment and continuous improvement. You won’t just build in isolation; you’ll stay close to the teams using your solutions to make sure they stick.
   

* Design and build AI agents, automations, and LLM integrations that solve real operational challenges across ACEVE Group’s portfolio companies.
* Partner with business teams to understand their workflows, identify high\-impact AI opportunities, and translate them into working solutions.
* Iterate on deployed solutions based on real\-world usage and feedback, ensuring adoption and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to a shared engineering foundation — reusable components, patterns, and best practices that scale across the group.
* Evaluate and recommend new AI tools, models, and frameworks that could advance Aceve’s internal capabilities.
* Document your solutions clearly so business teams and colleagues can understand, maintain, and build on them.
* Support the AI Champions network with technical guidance and pair\-building sessions, helping colleagues across departments implement AI in their daily work.
* Run occasional hands\-on or remote workshops when deep technical expertise is needed, and gather user feedback directly across ACEVE’s multiple markets.


**We Believe You Have**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying AI or software engineering solutions in a professional environment.
* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Strong proficiency with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex) and the ability to build production\-ready integrations.
* Experience building automations or AI agents that interact with real business systems and data.
* The communication skills to work effectively with non\-technical stakeholders — you can scope problems, explain trade\-offs, and manage expectations.
* A bias for shipping — you care about solutions that actually get used, not just solutions that technically work.
* Comfort working remotely and collaborating across European and Nordic time zones, with occasional travel to Aceve offices.


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience building AI solutions within a SaaS, scale\-up, or multi\-product environment.
* Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), fine\-tuning, or AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience running workshops, training sessions, or developer enablement activities.


**Not ticking every box?** 
 No worries! We value potential and drive, so apply anyway or connect with us\- you might be just what we're looking for in our growing organisation! Join Aceve and take your expertise to the next level, together we are redefining what’s possible in craft and construction solutions!
   

*Aceve is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our selection process is conducted continuously and without discrimination, ensuring an equal opportunity for all candidates.*

**Kontakt**

title: Business Analyst till Innovationsteamet på CGM
description:
CompuGroup Medical (CGM) är en ledande aktör inom e\-hälsa med målsättningen att skapa skalbara och tillförlitliga lösningar för framtidens vård. CGMs vision “Synchronizing healthcare” är central i allt vårt arbete. Vi söker nu en Business Analyst till vårt Innovationsteam; en strukturerad och analytisk person som brinner för att omsätta behov och idéer till tydliga, väl underbyggda krav.
 



  





**Om rollen:** 




 Som Business Analyst ansvarar du för kravinsamling och kravanalys kopplat till nya produkter och lösningar inom e\-hälsa. Du säkerställer att krav är tydliga, spårbara och väl förankrade hos både utvecklingsteam och verksamhet, och du driver aktiviteter som workshops, intervjuer och kundträffar för att fånga upp rätt behov. Du arbetar nära en eller flera produktägare i Innovationsteamet och bidrar med djup kravkompetens genom hela produktresan, från tidigt koncept till lansering.
 



  





 Rollen innebär också ansvar för riskhantering kopplad till krav samt att hålla dig uppdaterad kring relevanta lagar, regler och standarder inom e\-hälsa, medicinteknik och informationssäkerhet. Du trivs med att arbeta strukturerat med dokumentation samtidigt som du är van att kommunicera med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära målgrupper, på svenska och engelska.
 



  





**Ansvarsområden:** 



* Ansvara för kravinsamling, kravanalys och att kravdokumentation hålls uppdaterad, tydlig och spårbar.
* Planera, kalla till och leda aktiviteter för kravinsamling, till exempel workshops, intervjuer och kundträffar.
* Skriva, strukturera och detaljera krav, till exempel användningsfall, user stories och acceptanskriterier.
* Driva riskhantering kopplad till krav, inklusive identifiering, bedömning och dokumentation av risker.
* Kalla till och hålla granskningsmöten för genomgång av krav med berörda intressenter.
* Ta fram processflöden och scenarier som beskriver hur systemet används i kundernas verksamhet.
* Samarbeta med QA, informationssäkerhet och andra funktioner för att säkerställa att regulatoriska krav uppfylls.
* Stödja skapandet av koncept och specifikationer i nära samarbete med produktägare i prioritering och planering.



  





**Din profil:** 




 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha:
 


* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemvetenskap, informatik, datateknik, medicinsk informatik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande kompetens genom erfarenhet.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet från IT\-branschen, varav minst ett par år i rollen som Business Analyst, kravanalytiker eller liknande.
* Mycket god kunskap inom kravhantering och kravskrivande, till exempel användningsfall, user stories och processmodellering.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i projekt och/eller agila team.
* God förståelse för systemutveckling och IT\-arkitektur på övergripande nivå.



  





 Meriterande:
 


* Erfarenhet från reglerad verksamhet, gärna inom e\-hälsa, medicinteknik eller offentlig vård.



  





 Som person är du:
 


* Strukturerad, noggrann och analytisk, med förmåga att bryta ned komplexa problem till tydliga krav.
* Resultatorienterad och drivande, med god kommunikativ förmåga på både svenska och engelska.



  





**Arbeta hos CGM** 




 Hos oss får du möjligheten att jobba tillsammans med ett engagerat och trevligt team som arbetar mot samma mål och med våra kunders bästa för ögonen. Vi lovar dig utmanande arbetsuppgifter och möjligheten att påverka.
 



  





 Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm\-Solna, med ett hybridupplägg som inkluderar minst tre dagar på kontoret och möjlighet till två dagar på distans per vecka.
 



  





 Vi erbjuder dig:
 


* En dynamisk och innovativ arbetsmiljö
* Arbetsplats i moderna lokaler i Solna
* Hybrid\-upplägg med möjlighet till distansarbete
* Generöst friskvårdsbidrag och en friskvårdstimme i veckan
* Tillsvidareanställning, heltid, som inleds med sex månaders provanställning
* Kollektivavtal



  





**Ansökan** 




 Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande, så vänligen skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Startdatum enligt överenskommelse. För frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterare Karin Bogren på karin.bogren@partner.cgm.com.
 



  





**Vår rekryteringsprocess** 




 Första steget är ett kortare videosamtal med vår rekryterare där vi berättar mer om tjänsten och lär känna dig bättre. Därefter följer intervjuer med din framtida chef och kollegor. Om du går vidare till slutskedet av processen kommer vi att be om referenser samt genomföra en bakgrundskontroll innan vi erbjuder dig en anställning.
 



  





 Om du är redo att ta din karriär till nästa nivå och göra verklig skillnad, skicka din ansökan till oss redan idag!
 



  





*CGMs vision ”Synchronizing healthcare” genomsyrar allt vårt arbete. Vi är marknadsledande leverantör av IT\-lösningar och kommunikationstjänster inom hälso\- och sjukvård, social omsorg, företagshälsovård, barn\- och elevhälsovård samt kliniska laboratorium i Sverige. Vår drivkraft är att göra nytta för patienten via våra e\-hälsolösningar. Behovet av nya lösningar är under ständig utveckling, vilket ställer höga krav på oss som leverantör. Tillsammans med våra kunder är vi starkt engagerade i att förverkliga Sveriges e\-hälsovision om att bli bäst i världen på att använda digitaliseringens och e\-hälsans möjligheter.*

title: Data Engineer

**Swedish\-speaking resource required**

* Python and Databricks are central to the data\-driven workflow

 The
 **Impact Forecasting** 
 product team is responsible for developing and maintaining power forecasts for both
 **local and regional electricity grids** 
 .
 



 These forecasts estimate additional power requirements across areas such as:
 


* Housing
* Electrification of transport
* Industry and business premises



 The forecasts support network dimensioning, network development planning, investments and reinvestments, and stakeholder/customer discussions.
 



 The Data Engineer / Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer will help automate forecasting processes, analyze customer and time\-series data, develop forecasting methodologies, build Power BI reporting solutions, and ensure data quality.

 **Python** 
 .

* Work within a
 **Databricks** 
 environment.

 2\. Data Analysis \& Methodology Development
 


* Analyze large datasets, particularly
 **customer data and time\-series data** 
 .
* Investigate opportunities to improve or change forecasting methodologies.
* Perform both structured and exploratory analysis.

 .

 .
* Professional experience with
 **Power BI** 
 or equivalent visualization tools.

 **electricity network industry or broader energy industry** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent ability to communicate and convey analytical messages clearly.
* **Swedish language proficiency.**
* **Must be based in Stockholm.**

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Craft:**
 Data, Analytics \& Strategy
   

  

**Job Description:**
 We are looking for a
 **Product Analyst** 
 to join the team working on game difficulty, progression, and economy in Candy Crush Saga. Together with product managers, game designers, engineers, and data scientists, you will help ensure that our 23,000\+ levels and game features combine into a balanced, engaging, and evolving player experience.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on analytics role close to the game: you will turn player data into clear answers, dashboards, and recommendations that shape day\-to\-day product decisions affecting millions of players.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

* Monitor and report on game difficulty, progression, and economy KPIs, keeping the team informed about how players experience the game
* Analyze player behavior across levels and features to identify friction points, trends, and opportunities
* Design, monitor, and analyze A/B tests related to difficulty, features, and economy
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports that make key metrics accessible and actionable for the team
* Investigate product questions and hypotheses with reliable analysis
* Define tracking specifications for new features so the data needed to understand player behavior is available and reliable
* Present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy


 Skills to create thrills
   

  

 Product \& Player Understanding
   

  

* Good product sense with genuine curiosity about player experience, engagement, and frustration
* Ability to translate product questions into concrete analyses and metrics


 Analytics
   

  

* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large\-scale behavioral or player data
* Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis
* Experience building dashboards and reports that drive decisions
* Solid understanding of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical inference


 Communication \& Collaboration
   

  

* Ability to communicate findings through clear visualization and storytelling
* Comfortable working iteratively and cross\-functionally with product managers, game designers, engineers, and data scientists
* Pragmatic and organized, able to balance multiple analyses and priorities


 Tasty bonus points
   

  

* Experience with game analytics, progression systems, or virtual economies
* Experience in the games industry or other large\-scale consumer products
* Familiarity with experimentation platforms and live\-operated products
* Experience defining event tracking or working with analytics instrumentation


**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world\-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Är du en erfaren Dataingenjör eller BI\-utvecklare/BI\-konsult som vill ta nästa steg i din karriär? Drömmer du om att arbeta med modern teknik och lösa komplexa problem tillsammans med ett nätverk av skickliga Data\- och Analysexperter? Då kan du vara den vi söker!** 




  





 Våra närmare 100 dataexperter i Sverige jobbar med datalösningar inom nästan alla teknologier. Ett vanligt projekt varierar i längd från en månad till några år, och situationen kan justeras baserat på dina önskemål. Våra kunder finns inom alla branscher, allt från produktutveckling, hälsa, industri och försäkring till kommunikation, bank och elförsörjning.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder:** 



* En företagskultur som präglas av autonomi, stöd och gemensam tillväxt.
* Spännande kundprojekt och erfarna kollegor som är omtänksamma och passionerade.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med en stor bredd av projekt och branscher.
* Partnerskap med ledande tech\-företag som GCP, AWS, dbt, Snowflake och Databricks.



  





**Känner du igen dig i följande?** 




 Som Data Engineer på Solita jobbar du brett; end\-to\-end från ingestion hela vägen till visualisering. Det är bra om du har erfarenhet inom; pipelines, ingestion, datawarehousing modellering, analys och visualisering. Exempel på tekniker vi arbetar med är Snowflake, Matillion, dbt, Databricks, Fabric, Data factory, Bigquery och mer! Vi jobbar även ofta i cloud och arbetar primärt i Python eller SQL. Som konsult på Solita är det viktigt att du kan kommunicera tekniska lösningar till kunder och hantera deras behov och problem. Du behärskar även svenska och engelska flytande.
 



  





**Dina ansvarsområden i rollen:** 



* Självständigt leverera komplexa uppdrag inom ditt expertområde och planera de bästa åtgärderna för att nå önskade resultat.
* Utveckla arbetsmetoder och processer samt vägleda och agera mentor till andra.
* Analysera nya problem, bedöma teknisk information och andra källor, samt utveckla nya lösningar.
* Optimera befintliga processer och delta i utvecklingen av nya processer av avdelningsövergripande betydelse.
* Leverera lösningar till kunder och samarbeta nära med dem för att förstå och möta deras behov.



  





 Det viktigaste för oss är ändå att du delar våra värderingar, du är omtänksam mot andra och delar gärna din kunskap och vågar stå för det du tror på. Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss, och vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete, och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech\-bloggar.
 



  





**En dag på Solita:** 
 Din dag kan börja med ett standup\-möte med kund och team\-medlemmar, följt av kodnära arbete som att bygga data pipelines och programmera i Python/SQL. Under dagen kan det dyka upp ad\-hoc möten med kund eller kollegor, eller interna utbildningsmöten. Dagen avslutas ofta med mer kodarbete, möten och inte minst – fika!

title: Senior Data Engineer, Agentic Systems
description:
When you join the Fountain team, you become part of the leading enterprise solution for frontline workforce management. Fountain’s automated, customizable platform provides a seamless applicant experience for workers, while ensuring organizations can scale and manage their frontline talent.
 




  






 We’ve helped hundreds of companies like UPS, CLEAR, Stitch Fix, GoPuff, Fetch, and sweetgreen to hire, onboard, and manage over 14 million workers in more than 75 countries.
 





 In 2022, we closed $185M in our Series C, led by SoftBank and B Capital.
 




  






 Join our growing team of highly collaborative, ambitious, and forward\-thinking Fountaineers as we empower our hundreds of customers and millions of frontline workers around the world.
 




  






 Let’s elevate frontline work together.
   







 Fountain sells agentic software. We intend to run on it too.
 





 Our data platform is healthy and owned. dbt and Dagster on Kubernetes, ClickHouse Cloud as the primary analytical store, CDC off Postgres and MongoDB source systems, a long tail of third\-party sources, and Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, and object\-store lakes around the edges. Engineers on the team own those models and pipelines today, and they’ll keep owning them.
 




  






 This role is different. You own the agentic buildout itself, in two halves.
 




****First, how our own team works.****

 We want the data team building agentically by default: agents that author and test models, extend pipelines, catch breakage and repair it, keep documentation and contracts honest. Someone has to design that system. The harnesses, the context and tooling agents work through, the review and CI workflows that make agent\-written code safe to merge, the evaluations that tell us whether the output can be trusted. Other engineers own the models. You own the machinery that changes how they get built, and that machinery reaches upstream into the product, where most data problems actually start.
 




  





****Second, how the rest of the company works.****

 The same capability, pointed outward. A CSM, a finance analyst, a PM, or a support lead should be able to ask a real question and get a trustworthy answer without waiting in a queue. That means semantic context, skills and MCP surfaces, access boundaries, evaluation, and a clear\-eyed view of what the agent should refuse to answer. It also means working closely with the people who’ll use it, because tooling nobody adopts is worth nothing.
 





 At its core this is still a data and analytics engineering job. You need enough depth in modeling, dbt, and orchestration to build credibly for engineers who do it all day, and to know when agent\-generated output is subtly wrong. The difference is what you’re accountable for: the leverage, not the DAG.
 





 Be aware that this is as much a change problem as an engineering problem. Building the capability is half of it. Getting a team, and then a company, to genuinely work differently is the other half, and it’s the half that decides whether this role succeeds.
 





 We’re moving quickly. This role is a bet that we can change how we work in weeks rather than quarters, and we’re staffing it accordingly.
 




  





****What you’ll do:****




  




* ****Design and build the agentic development workflow for the data team.****

 Agent\-authored models and pipeline changes, the context and tooling those agents operate through, PR and review patterns, CI that catches what agents get wrong, the guardrails that make it safe to run against production, and the standards that make any of it repeatable across a team.
* ****Push that reach upstream into the product.****

 Build the context and tooling that shape how features get conceived and built in the first place, and verify data architecture while changes are in development. Most data problems are cheapest to fix at the root, before a dev PR lands, which means working inside Engineering and Product rather than downstream of them.
* ****Build the evaluation layer.****

 Regression suites, correctness checks, lineage awareness, and observability on the agents themselves. Nobody adopts an agentic workflow they can’t verify, so this is foundational rather than a follow\-up.
* ****Build agentic analytics capability for the company.****

 Semantic context, skills, MCP surfaces, access controls, and query and cost guardrails that let non\-technical teams get answers they can act on, along with the honest scoping of what the system won’t answer.
* ****Drive adoption.****

 Work alongside the engineers on the data team and stakeholders across GTM, Finance, Product, and Support, teaching the patterns, watching where people get stuck, and closing the gap between what you built and how people actually work.
* ****Stay hands\-on in the platform.****

 You won’t own the models and pipelines, but you’ll work in that codebase constantly, and you should be able to fix what you find.



  





****What you should bring:****




  




* ****5\+ years****

 in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, or equivalent depth arrived at another way. What you’ve built and operated matters more to us than the number.
* ****Real depth in analytical data modeling and SQL.****

 You can read a normalized transactional schema, design something that answers business questions without falling over, and spot when a generated model is subtly wrong.
* ****Hands\-on production experience with dbt and an orchestrator.****

 Dagster is what we run; Airflow, Prefect, or Temporal transfers fine. You should know the operational reality of a large DAG, not just the syntax.
* ****Strong Python****

 and the software engineering habits that go with it: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD.
* ****You have shipped agentic or LLM\-powered systems to production.****

 Tool and function calling, context and retrieval design, orchestrating multi\-step workflows, and evaluating all of it. You should be able to walk through something you built, how you measured whether it worked, and where it failed. This is the requirement we care most about.
* ****Sound judgment about data governance and PII****

 in a multi\-tenant environment. We handle applicant and worker data across 75\+ countries, and exposing it through an LLM surface raises the stakes on getting access boundaries right.
* ****You can bring people with you.****

 This role changes how the data team, product engineers, and other departments do their work. That requires listening well, teaching patiently, and being persuasive without a title that makes anyone do anything.



  





****Nice to have:****




  




* Depth in a columnar or MPP warehouse, especially ClickHouse Cloud and ClickPipes; Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift also translates
* Building with Claude: the API, Claude Code, the Agent SDK, MCP servers, or subagent patterns
* AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code, enough to debug your own deployment
* Semantic layer and BI tooling (Omni, Looker, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube)
* LLM observability and evaluation tooling (Langfuse, Braintrust, or equivalent)
* Streaming and CDC internals (Debezium, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Having led a technical practice change on a team that was skeptical at the start
* HR tech, high\-volume hiring, workforce management, or another domain with heavy operational data



  





****What success looks like:****




  






 These are weeks, not quarters. That’s the point, and it’s possible because you won’t be carrying the platform while you do it. The models and pipelines have owners, so your time goes into building rather than inheriting.
 




****Week 1****

 — you’ve shipped. A small agent\-assisted change, merged to production. You learn our stack by building in it.
 




****Week 2****

 — the first agentic workflow is running against production. Agent\-authored changes moving through a review path you designed, with the CI and guardrails that make merging them safe.
 




****Week 4****

 — engineers other than you are using it daily, the evaluation layer is catching regressions before a human does, and the first agentic analytics capability is in front of real users outside the data team, rough edges and all.
 




****Week 8****

 — agent\-initiated is the default path for at least one entire class of data work, the patterns are documented well enough that adoption no longer depends on you being in the room, internal agentic analytics is live for at least one department with measurement behind it, and the rate at which we add trustworthy data capability is no longer bounded by the size of the data team.
   







 Even if you do not meet all the requirements above, we still encourage you to apply for this position. While we try to be thorough with our prerequisites, not everything about you as a candidate can be condensed into a list of bullet points. What do you have to lose?
 




  





****Fountain offers an incredibly unique work environment.****

 We employ a diverse team all over the world. Each Fountaineer is given the freedom to do their best work from wherever they choose. We also understand the importance of in\-person connections and hold in\-person meetings with your team and meet annually as an organization to build our relationships and focus on the future of moving Fountain Forward. 
 




  






 The benefits we offer in the United States include competitive health plans and a retirement plan. Some Fountain\-wide  perks offered to all employees across the globe include a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, monthly lunch stipends, annual allowances for ongoing education related to your profession and career advancement, along with home office, cell phone, and wellness reimbursements. Fountain is a global employer, so some benefit offerings will vary from country to country.
 




  






 Fountain is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, socioeconomic status, disability, and veteran status.
 




  





*By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read our* 
*Privacy Policy* 
*and agree that we may process and retain your personal data for the purpose of recruitment in accordance with applicable data protection laws.*

title: Data Engineer to Kreditz
description:
*As a Data Engineer at Kreditz, you will have a multifaceted and vital role. You will step into one of Europe’s fastest\-growing FinTech scaleups and take full ownership of the company’s Data Warehouse, pipelines, and reporting enablement. We believe this role is perfect for someone who loves building scalable data infrastructure and wants to work close to both product and real business impact. Here, you will become part of a driven organization with endless opportunities for growth!* 




  





**About the role** 




 You will be part of the Product team and play a crucial role in Kreditz’s continued growth journey. At Kreditz, data is not just a support function – it is the core of the entire product. The company turns raw bank transactions into real\-time insights that power credit and risk decisions across Europe.
 



  





 As a Data Engineer, your mission is to build, evolve, and maintain a scalable, reliable, and high\-performing data platform. You will work closely with the business to strengthen the data foundation and enable smart, cost\-efficient reporting and analytics for both internal and external stakeholders.
 



  





**What Kreditz Offers You** 



* **A unique growth journey:** 
 The chance to be part of a once\-in\-a\-lifetime journey from startup to global scaleup.
* **Real impact:** 
 A role where everyone in the team plays a crucial part in the company’s success, and where you get true ownership of the data infrastructure.
* **A strong company culture:** 
 A fun\-loving, driven, and passionate work environment that celebrates progress, humility, and teamwork – we win together.
* **Perks \& Benefits:** 
 24/7 access to a gym, sauna, and sports facilities at the office, plus a wellness allowance and a competitive base salary.



  





**Work tasks** 




 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end data lifecycle, from maintaining the DWH architecture to ensuring data quality for both analytical and operational needs across the company.
 



  




* Maintain and enhance the Data Warehouse architecture for scalability and cost\-efficiency
* Design and build robust ETL/ELT pipelines within the AWS ecosystem.
* Automate internal reporting and create self\-service data environments for stakeholders.
* Manage AWS services including Glue, Redshift, Athena, and Lambda.
* Implement monitoring and validation frameworks to ensure data integrity.
* Collaborate with DevOps and Backend teams to align infrastructure.
* Support AI and ML models by assisting with specialized data pipelines.



  





**We are looking for** 



* BSc / MSc in a quantitative subject, i.e., Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science or equivalent.
* Proven experience working as a Data Engineer or in a similar role focusing on data infrastructure.
* Strong practical engineering skills with a solid foundation in SQL and programming (e.g., Python).
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS (specifically services like Redshift/Snowflake, S3, Glue, and Lambda).
* Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts (e.g., Star Schema, Kimball) and modern data stack tools.
* Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and CI/CD workflows (i.e., GitHub Actions).
* Ability to translate complex technical data structures into clear insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as this is the company’s working language.



  





**It is meritorious if you have** 



* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
* Experience from FinTech, Open Banking, or working with highly regulated data.
* Familiarity with BI tools (e.g., AWS QuickSight, PowerBI...etc).



  





**To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:** 



* Orderly
* Stable
* Responsible
* Intellectually curious



  





**Our recruitment process** 




 This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
 



  





 Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
 



  





**Kreditz AB** 




 Kreditz is transforming how businesses assess credit and risk using real\-time data and NextGen Credit Scoring solutions. As one of Europe’s fastest\-growing FinTech scaleups, Kreditz has earned a place on the
 *Sifted 100: Nordics \& Benelux*

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Coop Sverige – Together we make food\-Sweden sustainable** 



  


 At Coop we are building the data backbone of a truly data\-driven company. We run stores for our 4\.2 million members, and our motto is “Relevance in every touchpoint.” Understanding our customers’ needs and behaviours is what fuels our innovation – from purchasing and logistics to personalised customer experiences.
 


  


 We are now strengthening our Data Platform team with a skilled Data Engineer to help us build scalable, cloud\-native data solutions on Azure, with Databricks at the core.
 


  


***About the role***



  


 You will be part of our Data Platform team, which sits within Coop’s AI \& Business Intelligence organisation – the team building the data foundation that powers analytics, reporting, operational intelligence and AI across the company.
 


  


 In this role you will design, build and optimise enterprise\-grade data platforms using Azure Data Services, Databricks, modern Data Lakehouse architectures, real\-time streaming and DevOps automation. You’ll turn data from across the business into trusted, high\-quality data products that the whole organisation can rely on.
 


  


**What you will do** 



  

* Design and implement scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines using Azure\-native technologies.
* Build and maintain robust data ingestion frameworks from multiple source systems, APIs and event streams.
* Develop and manage Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) within the enterprise Data Lake.
* Implement streaming solutions with Kafka, Event Hub and Service Bus for event\-driven processing.
* Develop transformation frameworks using Databricks, PySpark and Delta Lake.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data analysts and data scientists to deliver trusted, high\-quality data products.
* Enable CI/CD pipelines and automate deployments using Azure DevOps best practices.
* Drive platform optimization focused on performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, security, monitoring and operational excellence standards.


  


***Who are you?***



  


 To succeed in this role, we believe you have a genuine passion for getting value from massive datasets and love working with state\-of\-the\-art technologies that make completely new data\-driven solutions possible. You enjoy working with different tasks and stakeholders, you are result\-oriented, and you spark when given room to take initiative and create solutions. As a team, we believe in supporting and challenging each other and growing a positive, learning culture.
 


  


**We believe that you** 



  

* Have strong hands\-on experience with the Azure data platform – Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS), Azure Functions, Event Hub and Service Bus.
* Are highly skilled in Databricks and the Lakehouse – PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, Unity Catalog and performance tuning, applying Medallion and Lakehouse architecture in practice.
* Are strong in data architecture and modelling – Lakehouse and Medallion design, ETL/ELT frameworks, and data quality \& validation frameworks.
* Have experience with streaming and integration – Apache Kafka, event\-driven architecture, Service Bus, batch ingestion / Autoloader and REST APIs.
* Are a confident programmer in Python, PySpark and SQL.
* Work the DevOps way – Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipeline development and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).
* Are comfortable with monitoring and operations – Log Analytics, Application Insights, and performance tuning \& troubleshooting.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical specialists and non\-technical stakeholders.


  


**It’s meritorious if you** 



  

* Have 5\+ years of experience in data engineering.
* Have built enterprise\-scale Azure data platforms hands\-on.
* Have worked with retail, logistics or large\-scale operational data environments.
* Have supported machine learning and advanced analytics workloads.
* Have a strong understanding of distributed data processing and streaming architectures.


  


**About us** 



  


 The grocery trade is a stable, long\-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4\.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.
 


  


 If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Victor Kesten (victor.kesten@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)
 


  


*Welcome with your application!*
