title: LEAD DATA ENGINEER
description:
**Challenges You Will Work On**
 At SAS, data is the engine behind everything we build from AI models and personalized offers to real\-time operational intelligence. As Lead Data Engineer, you will strengthen the engineering foundation that makes all of it possible: reliable, scalable, well\-operated data products, pipelines, and integrations. You will work closely with the Data Architect to turn architectural direction into practical engineering standards, modern DataOps practices, and production\-ready solutions that create real business impact.
   

  

 We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer who will act as a senior engineering leader and close partner to the Data Architect, driving the development of scalable and reliable data solutions across SAS. You will lead the implementation of engineering standards for data testing, observability, monitoring, , SLAs, version control, and DataOps practices, while supporting teams in adopting modern software engineering practices.
   

  

 You will work at the technical frontier of our data stack, leading implementation choices, code reviews, technical standards, and engineering quality across data products, pipelines, and integrations. In close collaboration with the Data Architect, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will bring modern perspectives on data products, DataOps, and software engineering craft, while ensuring solutions are aligned with the broader enterprise architecture and stakeholder priorities.
   

  

 As Lead Data Engineer you will bring deep engineering expertise and hands\-on DataOps leadership, helping transform architectural intent into robust, maintainable, and production\-ready solutions.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include**
* Lead the design, development, and operation of scalable data pipelines, data products, and integrations.
* Establish and drive engineering standards for testing, documentation, observability, monitoring, , SLAs, version control, and DataOps.
* Partner with the Data Architect to translate architectural direction into practical implementation patterns and reusable engineering standards.
* Lead code reviews and drive continuous improvement of engineering practices across the team.
* Mentor and support data engineers and DataOps engineers in modern tools, standards, and software engineering practices.
* Collaborate with architecture, data stewardship, IT, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet quality, security, governance and operational requirements.


 The Team
   

  

 The Analytics \& Data team develops and manages the data infrastructure that powers AI, analytics, and business operations at SAS. We build and maintain data pipelines, data products, and enterprise integrations on a modern cloud platform.
   

  

 Working closely with the AI \& Automation team, analysts, and business units across SAS we ensure that trusted and accessible data is available where it is needed. Our work spans batch and near\-real\-time pipelines, data product development, and integration with core operational systems.
   

  

 As SAS continues to expand its AI and analytics capabilities — including a new Customer Data Platform, agentic AI pilots, and an expanding BI estate — the demand for high\-quality and well\-engineered data infrastructure continues to grow. We are looking for a lead who can drive this forward.
   

  

 To be successful we believe you have
   

  

* A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of hands\-on data engineering experience, including experience in a senior or lead role.
* Strong skills in SQL and Python, with experience in Spark or similar distributed processing frameworks.
* Experience building and operating cloud\-based data pipelines, preferably in Azure using services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse, or equivalent.
* Solid understanding of data modelling, data warehouse design, data lake architecture, and enterprise data solutions.
* Practical experience with DataOps, version control, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and operational SLAs.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, Prefect, Lakeflow, or dbt.
* Strong mentoring skills and an passion for helping others grow through clear standards, documentation, and practical guidance.
* A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bring practical engineering perspectives into architectural discussions.


 Why SAS?
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast\-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health \& Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand\-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non\-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


 Our Culture at SAS
   

  

 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Come and fly with us!
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

* Apply by: 11/09/2026\. We review applications continuously, so please send us your CV as soon as you can. The role may be filled before the deadline.
* Start and scope: Full\-time role, starting with a 6\-month probation period.
* Location: You’ll be based at our office in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. This is mainly an onsite role, with some flexibility for remote work depending on the agreement with your manager.
* Security: As this role is security classified, a background check will be part of the final stage of the recruitment process.


 If you have any questions about the role, please contact Jonas Blomqvist, Head of Analytics \& Data, at jonas.blomqvist@sas.se. Please note that, due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications by email.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About WPP Media**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

**Role Summary And Impact**
 At Choreograph, part of WPP Media, we’re leading the way in data\-driven marketing solutions. We collaborate with the world’s most ambitious brands to solve complex challenges in media and marketing through data and technology. From econometrics and media buying algorithms to dashboards and strategic consulting, our work has an impact.
   

  

 WPP Media Sweden is building a local data engineering capability to support the entire Swedish organisation. The team will create scalable data foundations for data, automation, measurement, Open Intelligence and AI, while turning Nordic and global technology investments into concrete value for the Swedish business.
   

  

 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help design, build and operate cloud\-based data solutions that make client data accessible to media teams, automate reporting and enable advanced analytics. You will combine hands\-on engineering with close collaboration across media, business intelligence and data science, and you will help establish practical standards for how WPP Media Sweden works with data.
   

  

 If you’re passionate about building reliable data products, enjoy translating business needs into scalable technical solutions and want to have a visible impact across WPP Media Sweden, this could be the perfect role for you!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud\-based data infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Develop data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python, SQL and Dataform, with a focus on reliability, maintainability and reuse.
* Use Terraform and modern engineering practices to create consistent, version\-controlled infrastructure and deployment workflows.
* Partner with media, business intelligence, data science and other internal teams to gather requirements and deliver data products that support reporting, measurement, analytics and AI.
* Implement monitoring, testing and data quality controls, and troubleshoot pipeline or infrastructure issues when they occur.
* Contribute to technical design decisions, documentation, coding standards and best practices for the new Swedish data engineering capability.
* Support knowledge sharing and the development of more junior colleagues, while collaborating with Nordic and global engineering teams where relevant.


**Skills And Experience**
 We’re looking for someone with relevant experience and a proven track record of designing and building scalable data solutions.
   

  

* Practical experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with a cloud platform, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and services used for data storage, processing and orchestration.
* Experience with data modelling, transformation patterns and integrating data from databases, files, APIs or other source systems.
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices, including code review, testing and deployment workflows.
* An understanding of infrastructure as code and modern data engineering practices. We use Terraform and Dataform.
* A structured approach to data quality, monitoring, security, documentation and operational reliability.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear technical solutions.
* You have a valid work permit in Sweden.


**Nice to have**
* Deeper hands\-on experience with GCP, Terraform, Dataform, dbt or similar transformation and infrastructure tools.
* Experience with CI/CD, workflow orchestration, containerisation or automated testing for data pipelines.
* Experience supporting analytics, measurement, marketing or media use cases.
* Experience with Power BI or another business intelligence tool, and experience mentoring junior colleagues or sharing technical knowledge.
* You are fluent in both English and Swedish.


**Life At WPP Media \& Benefits**
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.
   

  

 In Sweden, our benefits include a SEK 3,000 wellness allowance, a 37,5\-hour workweek, half\-days and “klämdagar" off, 30 days of vacation, and two paid volunteer days per year. WPP Media Sweden is a member of Almega, and all employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (kollektivavtal), which ensures occupational pension, insurance, and other negotiated terms. We host regular team activities, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and wellness initiatives throughout the year.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

**Application**
 This is a full\-time permanent position with a start date as soon as possible. We apply a six\-month probationary period.
   

  

 In addition to reviewing your CV and conducting interviews, our recruitment process includes a testing phase. Selection and interviews are ongoing, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger and encourage applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.
   

  

**Contact**
 If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Viktor Åhlen (viktor.ahlen@wppmedia.com) or Martin Söderhäll (martin.soderhall@wppmedia.com). Due to GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Business Analyst inom  inom Bank
description:
Business Analyst inom inom Bank
   

  

 Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 På CGI ligger vi i framkant när det kommer till digitalisering och tillämpning av nya teknologier. Just nu söker vi medarbetare som delar vår passion och som har en erfarenhet inom produktutveckling.
   

  

 Vi söker en engagerad och erfaren Business Analyst med teknisk bakgrund inom Bank och/eller försäkring som kommer att fortsätta leda framgångsrika projekt för våra kunder, samtidigt som du stärker vårt team med dina erfarenheter och insikter.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 I rollen som Business Analyst kommer du att ha en central roll i att stödja och utveckla våra IT projekt och verksamhetsprojekt inom Bank och försäkring. Din roll kommer att vara starkt kundinriktad, där du analyserar affärsbehov och formar skräddarsydda lösningar för att uppfylla deras krav.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Du är en initiativtagande person som trivs i en snabbväxande miljö. Som en del av vårt team förväntas du vara självgående men samtidigt en lagspelare. Du har utmärkta kommunikationsfärdigheter och en naturlig fallenhet för problemlösning. Du är bra på att hålla i workshops både fysiska och online, samt har analytisk förmåga.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har en examen inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande kunskaper. Du bör ha minst 5 års erfarenhet som Business Analyst inom Bank. Vidare har du god kännedom kring något eller flera av regelverken som styr bankernas verksamhet tex DORA, GDPR, AMLD/AMLR, PSD2/PSD3\.
   

  

 Det är extra meriterande om du har kunskap eller erfarenhet av följande:
   

  

* Generative AI /automation
* DataManagement / strategy
* Payments


 Om du söker dig till en arbetsplats som utmanar, utvecklar och hjälper dig vidare i din professionella karriär så är CGI rätt plats för dig. Ansök nu för att utforska möjligheten att vara en del av vårt spännande team inom Bank och Försäkring!
   

  

 Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Pernilla Sällvin, pernilla.guthammarsallvin@cgi.com
   

  

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch\- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT\- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well\-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience,
 **digital yet personal** 
 .
 



  





 Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and have grown to over 240 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user\-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud\-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.
 



  





 Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!
 



  





**About our tech stack:** 



* Dagster
* Snowflake
* DBT
* Amazon Quick
* AWS (Lambda, S3, ECR)



  





**About the role** 




 We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic and cross\-functional team. As a Senior Data Scientist at Northmill, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, fellow Data Scientists, Analysts, and key business stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities and leverage data\-driven insights that will drive our business forward. Your primary focus will be on leading data science initiatives across various areas of the bank.
 



  





 In this holistic role, you will be a part of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection and preparation to implementation. You will work closely with Data Engineers to ensure the availability of high\-quality data, as well as with Analysts and business leaders to ensure that your models are effectively applied and communicated across the business. Your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of our fintech bank, and your work will have a direct impact on our success.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Take proactive ownership of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection, through modeling and analysis, to model deployment and implementation.
* Work closely with Data Engineers to acquire and transform data.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and advise stakeholders to proactively anticipate business needs and translate them into data science solutions.
* Create and present actionable insights and data visualizations that drive decision\-making processes across the bank.
* Continuously monitor and optimize models to proactively drive model refinement and communicate performance findings to stakeholders.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in data science, proactively proposing new initiatives where applicable.



  





**Qualifications** 




 The ideal fit should have experience in statistical modeling and machine learning, from the financial sector, combined with strong problem\-solving skills, analytical abilities, excellent stakeholder communication, and a prestigeless, collaborative spirit. We value individuals who are passionate about utilizing data to solve practical challenges and drive business outcomes.
 



  




* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics)
* \+5 years of experience in data science or related roles.
* Proficiency in SQL/Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.
* Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis and machine learning, including hands\-on experience using common ML libraries.
* Proficiency with Git and version control in collaborative settings.



  





**What we offer** 



* A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views
* An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact
* Great opportunities for professional development
* Health \- 5 000 kr wellness allowance
* Conference abroad every other year
* Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday
* Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office



  





**Apply today and be a part of Northmill!**

*På Signific brinner vi för att använda data för att göra skillnad. Vi hjälper organisationer att samla, strukturera och agera på insikter från stora datamängder för att skapa nytta och hållbar förändring. Tillsammans bygger vi lösningar som driver innovation och samhällsnytta.* 




  





 Som Machine learning\-konsult på Signific hjälper du våra uppdragsgivare att ta sin data till nya, datadrivna nivåer. Din förståelse för både affärs\- och datamodeller kombinerat med analys och kod är superviktig för ett datadrivet, lärande arbetssätt.
 



  





 Vi samarbetar med produkt\- och techbolag som arbetar med analytics, machine learning och datadrivna lösningar, i en miljö där teamarbete och flexibilitet står i centrum.
 



  





 Du blir en del av ett litet, inkluderande bolag med stora ambitioner. Hos oss formar du både kundprojekt och vår kultur, med stöd från engagerade kollegor.
 



  





**Vad du kommer få göra** 




  





 Vi tror på att lösa kundernas problem tillsammans, med lösningar som passar deras behov och dina styrkor. Din roll som ML Engineer är flexibel och formas av dina intressen och kundernas mål.
 



  





*Som ML Engineer\-konsult hos oss ser vi dig troligen göra några av följande saker:* 




  




* Först och främst hjälpa företag skapa mer nytta av sin data
* Ta komplex data till modeller och analyser som löser viktiga verksamhets\- och samhällsproblem
* Designa, bygga och förfina machine learning och agentiska lösningar i produktion för spännande kunder
* Ta fram modeller för stora mängder användardata för att driva produkt\- och designbeslut
* Ha en nyckelroll att förflytta team och organisationer mot ett datadrivet arbetssätt.
* Få ta del av och bidra till kunskapsdelning och nyskapande kultur ihop med dina kollegor
* Utveckla lösningar för meningsfulla projekt, som etisk AI eller hållbarhetsinitiativ.
* Växa i den riktning du vill, med stöd från kollegor och mentorskap.



  





**Vem vi tror du är** 




  





 Vi bygger ett team av
 **olika talanger** 
 som tillsammans skapar en snäll och inkluderande kultur. För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du delar flera av dessa egenskaper:
 



  





**Som person** 




  




* Trivs med att samarbeta och bidra med idéer i ett team.
* Är nyfiken och vill lära dig nya teknologier och sätt att lösa problem.
* Värdesätter en kultur där vi stöttar varandra och växer tillsammans.



  





**I din roll** 




  




* Är genuint intresserad av att lösa kunders verksamhetsproblem
* Har minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom rollen eller liknande roller
* Känner dig riktigt bekväm inom minst ett programmeringsspråk (t.ex. Python, Go, Java)
* Har erfarenhet och intresse för att produktionsätta ML\-algoritmer
* Förstår vilka mått och mätetal som är viktiga för digitala produkter
* Gillar och förstår statistik (som t.ex. A/B\-tester, signfikanstester och regressionsmodellering)
* Noggrann men också lösningsorienterad
* Trivs att jobba i agila team och kanske också i en mer ledande roll.
* Har stort intresse för Data Engineering/Science/Analytics i allmänhet
* Högskoleutbildning är inget krav, men konkret arbetslivserfarenhet är det.



  





**En meningsfull resa där du gör skillnad** 




  





 Signific är ett växande bolag där du får vara med och forma framtiden. Vi bygger en kultur av samarbete, inkludering och kunskap, med fokus på att skapa impact.
 



  





**Hos oss:** 




  




* **Tillsammans växer vi:** 
 Du lär dig av engagerade kollegor som delar sin expertis och stöttar din utveckling.
* **Meningsfulla projekt:** 
 Du bidrar till spännande uppdrag inom data och AI som formar framtidens lösningar.
* **En balanserad arbetsmiljö:** 
 Vi erbjuder flexibilitet, nolltolerans mot kränkningar och en kultur som anpassas till din livssituation.
* **Spetskompetens i fokus:** 
 Din expertis inom data och AI är kärnan – vi bygger team som levererar kvalitet, inte generiska lösningar.
* **Forma framtiden:** 
 Du spelar en nyckelroll i att utveckla vår kultur, värderingar och hållbara erbjudanden.



  





 Signific strävar efter mångfald för att stärka vår innovationsförmåga och kultur. Du kommer bidra med just din unika kompetens.
 



  





 Och en sak till: erfarenhet är toppen, men har du en nyfikenhet och vilja att växa så räknas det också – tveka inte, ansök nu.

title: Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer\-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission\-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 Software only matters when it is actively being used and making a difference. As a Deployed AI Engineer, you will be at the heart of this \- taking state\-of\-the\-art software and integrating it into complex systems. You will be defining and executing against the end\-to\-end outcome and all steps on the way to delivering novel capabilities in some of the most challenging environments around.
   

  

 For example: you collaborate directly with customer avionics engineers to understand the data structures and APIs used in aircraft mission control systems. Instead of being scared, you embrace the complexity of unfamiliar databases, APIs, or network protocols; you dig into the specification and use your creativity and ingenuity to implement adapters for integrating them with Helsing’s cloud infrastructure. By working closely with our partners and customers (both metaphorically and quite literally), you continuously evolve, improve, and operate Helsing software. You own the outcome end\-to\-end.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
 In close collaboration with our product teams, you will discover and formalise customer requirements, identify bugs, and ship the latest features directly to our users. Technology demonstrations are our chance to shine \- you will coordinate between customers, partners, and Helsing engineers to showcase Helsing’s software and AI capabilities in simulations or with real systems.
   

  

**You should apply if you**
* Have a degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant fields.
* Have a broad understanding and creative use of computer systems; this is the Swiss army knife in Helsing’s toolbox of world\-class talent.
* Prefer asking questions over stipulating answers.
* Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work.
* Are not afraid of legacy systems and would rather make them work than give up and try to rewrite it all.
* Are comfortable with scripting languages such as Bash or Python and have experience with software engineering in C\+\+, Java, Rust, or similar.
* Can navigate and configure Linux systems and have an understanding of network stacks and database systems.
* If applying for Germany\- it is a requirement that you are able to speak business level or fluent German


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* 
*under\-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Experience with Rust and Python.
* Experience with container\-based, cloud\-native and edge application architectures.
* Experience with maintaining and operating production systems using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming database systems.
* Experience with production ML systems.
* Bonus points: you have professional experience working in a defence context.


**Join Helsing and work with world\-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order\-of\-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**
* A focus on outcomes, not time\-tracking
* Competitive compensation and VSOP options
* Relocation support
* Social and education allowances
* Regular company events and all\-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
* A hands\-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done \- all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one


*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: Lead Data Engineer till techbolag
description:
**Om företaget** 




 Vår kund är ett större och väletablerat techbolag som arbetar med omfattande digitaliseringsinitiativ för verksamheter inom både privat och offentlig sektor. Här erbjuds en komplex och affärsnära miljö där senior specialistkompetens värdesätts högt, med verksamhet inom bland annat cloud, data och mjukvaruutveckling. Bolaget befinner sig i ständig teknisk utveckling och arbetar med moderna lösningar för att skapa långsiktigt värde för sina kunder.
 



  





 I det här uppdraget går du in som konsult via Asta Agency och arbetar operativt hos företaget. Uppdraget sträcker sig initialt till årets slut, med goda möjligheter till förlängning.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Som Lead Data Engineer får du en central teknisk roll i ett omfattande moderniseringsinitiativ inom BI och Data Warehouse. Du kommer in tidigt i projektet och arbetar från discovery och analys till tekniska vägval och den första implementationen.
 



  





 En viktig del av uppdraget är att skapa en djup förståelse för befintligt datalager, dataflöden, integrationer och beroenden. Utifrån detta bidrar du till att forma den framtida lösningen och modernisera dagens datamiljö mot en mer skalbar och långsiktigt hållbar plattform.
 



  





 Det här är en roll för dig som kombinerar tekniskt djup med förmågan att se helheten. Du är fortsatt hands\-on i utvecklingen, men fungerar samtidigt som teknisk ledare och kvalificerat bollplank i frågor som rör arkitektur, datamodellering och plattformsval.
 



  





 Du arbetar nära arkitekt, BI\-utvecklare, verksamhetsexperter och andra Data Engineers. I rollen ingår även att skapa struktur i det tekniska arbetet samt stötta och vägleda mindre erfarna kollegor.
 



  





**Kvalifikationer och egenskaper** 




 Vi söker en senior Data Engineer som har arbetat i komplexa datamiljöer och är van att ta ett tekniskt helhetsansvar. Du kan snabbt sätta dig in i befintliga lösningar, identifiera risker och beroenden samt omsätta analysen i genomförbara tekniska beslut.
 



  





 Du är trygg i en rådgivande och ledande roll, samtidigt som du trivs nära tekniken och aktivt bidrar i implementationen.
 



  





 Därtill har du:
 


* Djup kompetens inom SQL Server, T\-SQL och SSIS
* Erfarenhet av att analysera och modernisera komplexa datalager och dataflöden
* Erfarenhet av minst en modern dataplattform, exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks eller Snowflake
* Mycket god förståelse för datamodellering, arkitektur och tekniska beroenden
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, Git och strukturerad teknisk dokumentation
* Förmåga att driva tekniska vägval och omsätta dem i praktisk implementation
* Erfarenhet av att vägleda och stötta andra Data Engineers
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska



  





 Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:
 


* dbt, SSAS, SSRS eller Power BI
* Purview, Unity Catalog eller DataHub
* Data governance, metadatahantering och informationssäkerhet
* Datamiljöer inom exempelvis retail, supply chain, finance eller HR



  





**Övrig information** 



* Start: Omgående
* Plats: Solna, med möjlighet till hybridarbete
* Omfattning: Heltid
* Lön: Enligt överenskommelse



  





 Vi tillämpar löpande urval i denna process vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vi rekommenderar dig därför att ansöka så snart som möjligt!
 



 Har du frågor eller funderingar kring Asta Agencys rekryteringsprocess, tveka inte att höra av dig till maja@astaagency.se.
 



  





**Om Asta Agency** 




 Asta Agency är ett rekryterings\- och bemanningsföretag som hjälper företag att hitta rätt tjänstemän i hela Sverige med fokus på Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi rekryterar och hyr ut specialister och generalister inom försäljning, marknad, HR, kundservice, ekonomi, administration, IT och tech. Med fokus på kvalitet, långsiktighet och smarta lösningar stöttar vi både företag och kandidater i nästa steg.
 



  





 Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med rekrytering, bemanning och hyrrekrytering på
 **astaagency.se** 
 .

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
**Join Readly!**
 Readly was built on a simple but powerful idea: that curious people should never have to choose between the publications they love and the ones they haven't discovered yet. One subscription. Thousands of titles. Journalism, culture, lifestyle, science, sport, and ideas from around the world, available on any screen, at any moment.
   

  

 Readly is now part of Cafeyn Group. With the acquisition of Readly's non\-Nordic operations, Cafeyn further strengthens its position as the European leader in access to information – combining scale, technology, and deep local market expertise.
   

  

 Together, the Group now operates across 15 markets, serves 2\.5 million users, and provides access to more than 5,200 publications from 1,100 partner publishers.
   

  

 Our mission?
   

  

 To empower individuals with access to trusted, high\-quality content that fosters personal growth and discovery. Whether it's through the comprehensive collection of news and features on Cafeyn \& Readly, the digital publishing solutions of Milibris, the fun and educative content for children on Kidjo, or the collections for manga lovers by Mangas.io, Cafeyn Group stands at the forefront of digital content experiences.
   

  

 We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join our team and sit at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.
   

  

 In this role, you will own and analyse our key B2C marketing data, helping Marketing teams better understand performance, identify growth opportunities and make data\-driven decisions. You’ll go beyond reporting: from analysing the acquisition funnel and running advanced measurement studies to improving attribution, tracking and marketing performance.
   

  

 You’ll also play a key role in making our Marketing teams more autonomous by building self\-serve reporting and AI\-powered data products, while ensuring that our tracking and data infrastructure remain accurate, compliant and up to date.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical skills in SQL and Python with a genuine understanding of B2C marketing, strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Product and Data stakeholders, making this a highly cross\-functional role with a direct impact on our growth strategy.
   

  

**Missions**
* Own B2C marketing KPIs from a data perspective, ensuring that key performance indicators and supporting data points are accurate, reliable and available within a reasonable timeframe for weekly and monthly business reviews.
* Support Marketing teams with reporting, helping them define relevant dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance indicators to answer their business questions.
* Analyse the acquisition funnel, from awareness through to conversion, to identify growth levers and provide actionable recommendations to Marketing teams.
* Run advanced marketing analyses to support strategic decision\-making, including initiatives such as Geo\-Lift studies, attribution analyses and other measurement approaches. Translate findings into concrete recommendations around budgets, channels and acquisition strategy.
* Implement algorithms and analytical solutions to support Marketing Operations, particularly around attribution and marketing measurement.
* Improve Marketing team autonomy through self\-serve data products, enabling stakeholders to answer their day\-to\-day data questions without relying systematically on an analyst.
* Develop and deploy AI\-powered data products and insights, using AI to make marketing stakeholders more autonomous and accelerate access to actionable insights.
* Own and maintain marketing tracking, ensuring that implementation remains compliant with regulations and aligned with changes across advertising platforms and the wider tracking ecosystem.
* Act as a bridge between Marketing and Product to ensure tracking remains up to date, follows best practices and provides the data and signals required for effective acquisition.
* Activate relevant data points within marketing platforms to improve acquisition performance and maximise the value of available customer and behavioural data.


**Requirements**
 We are looking for a data\-driven and commercially minded Data Analyst who sits at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.
   

  

 You are naturally curious and enjoy going beyond reporting to understand why performance is changing, identify growth opportunities and turn data into concrete business decisions. You are comfortable owning B2C marketing KPIs and ensuring that the underlying data is accurate, reliable and available when stakeholders need it.
   

  

**Must\-have**
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to independently query, analyse and manipulate data.
* Experience working with B2C marketing data, ideally within a subscription\-based business, with a strong understanding of metrics such as acquisition, conversion, trials and churn.
* Proven experience in marketing analytics and reporting, including the ability to translate business questions into relevant analyses and actionable insights.
* Experience with marketing tracking and measurement, including familiarity with GDPR, SKAN, DMA and the broader digital tracking ecosystem.
* Strong analytical storytelling skills, with the ability to identify meaningful insights and clearly communicate recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Marketing, Product and Data teams.


**Nice\-to\-have**
* Experience with Snowflake, Airflow, Segment, GTM and Amplitude
* Experience with advanced B2C marketing analytics methodologies such as Geo\-Lift studies, Multi\-Touch Attribution or Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM).
* Experience optimising acquisition strategies through A/B testing, particularly across the upper funnel.
* Experience activating and sharing data points with advertising platforms to improve acquisition performance.
* Experience developing self\-serve reporting tools or AI\-powered data products that enable business stakeholders to work more independently.


 Hiring process
   

  

* HR Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Manager (30’)
* Hiring manager Interview with our Head of Acquisition \& Marketing Measurement
* Case study that you will present to our Head of Acquisition \& Marketing Measurement and Data Analyst Product \& Growth
* Last Interview with our Chief of Staff and Head of Marketing


 Perks \& benefits of working at Cafeyn
   

  

* 🏥 Private health insurance – Euro Accident coverage with a SEK 750 deductible per claim
* 💰 Pension plan – 4\.5% employer contribution on base salary up to 7\.5 income base amounts, plus 30% on salary above this threshold
* 🛡️ Life insurance – Coverage of up to SEK 355,200 (2026\)
* ⚕️ Disability insurance – Coverage of up to 30 Price Base Amounts (SEK 1,776,000 in 2026\)
* 🌍 Easy access – All benefits and work contract are provided through Globalization Partners


***You don’t have to match all the requirements, if you feel this offer could be a great opportunity for you, reach out anyways! We hire based on talent and we promote inclusivity inside Cafeyn and strongly believe that our culture is strongest when it is the most diverse.***
* Founded in 2006
* Co\-workers 120
* Index de l’égalité professionnelle : 93/100

title: Senior Data Engineer & AI/ML-specialist (Data/AI)
description:
**Senior Data Engineer \& AI/ML\-specialist – Konsultuppdrag inom Data \& AI**
 Vi på WeQuel söker nu en Senior Data Engineer / AI/ML\-specialist med minst 8 års erfarenhet där du blir en nyckelperson i att utforma och skala vår dataplattform samt driva strategisk implementation av GenAI\-lösningar. Du sätter riktning för arkitektur, standarder och best practices inom data\- och AI\-domänen, samtidigt som du är hands\-on i den tekniska leveransen.
   

  

 Som konsult hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta hos någon av våra kunder som är ledande företag inom data engineering och AI/ML, där du bidrar till att optimera dataplattformar, implementera avancerad GenAI\-teknik och skapa hållbara, skalbara lösningar.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter:**
* Äganderskap och drift av övergripande dataarkitektur och teknisk vision för dataplattformen
* Design och implementation av skalbara, kostnadseffektiva dataplattformar och pipelines (batch och realtid) i produktion
* Ledning av design och driftsättning av avancerade ML\-modeller och GenAI\-lösningar (LLM:er, RAG, agentbaserade system)
* Fastställande av standarder för datakvalitet, dataflöden, säkerhet och governance
* Teknisk rådgivning gentemot ledning, produktägare och verksamhet
* Ledning av arkitektoniska beslut kring MLOps/DataOps, CI/CD för data\- och ML\-arbetsflöden samt infrastruktur som kod
* Mentorskap och coachning av juniora och mellansenior kollegor
* Utvärdering, pilottestning och införande av nya verktyg, ramverk och metoder inom AI/ML och dataengineering
* Identifiering och drivande av initiativ för optimering av prestanda, kostnad och säkerhet i molnbaserade datamiljöer
* Ansvar för teknisk dokumentation, arkitekturbeslut (ADR) och styrning av tekniska processer


 Du arbetar i en dynamisk miljö där du självständigt driver ditt flöde framåt och samtidigt samarbetar med flera gränssnitt inom organisationen.
   

  

**Krav:**
* Minst 8 års relevant erfarenhet av data engineering och/eller ML\-utveckling, varav flera år i senior eller ledande teknisk roll
* Djup expertis i Python och SQL samt erfarenhet av att designa system i stor skala
* Gedigen erfarenhet av molnplattformar (AWS, Azure eller GCP) inklusive kostnadsoptimering och säkerhetsarkitektur
* Bred erfarenhet av moderna dataverktyg som Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka eller motsvarande
* Djup förståelse för hela ML\-livscykeln (träning, utvärdering, deployment, monitorering, retraining)
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda tekniska projekt eller team, inklusive mentorskap
* Utmärkt kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift


**Meriterande:**
* Gedigen erfarenhet av LLM\-integration, RAG\-arkitekturer, agentbaserade system eller avancerad prompt engineering i produktion
* Djup kunskap inom MLOps\-verktyg (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker etc.)
* Erfarenhet av containerisering och orkestrering (Docker, Kubernetes) i produktionsskala
* Stark bakgrund inom dataarkitektur, datamodellering eller data mesh\-koncept
* Erfarenhet av att bygga eller leda dataplattformsteam
* Bidrag till open source, publikationer eller föredrag inom data/AI\-området
* Relevant akademisk examen (master/doktorsnivå) inom data science, datateknik eller motsvarande


**Uppdragsdetaljer**
* Start\- och slutdatum: ej specificerat i originalbeskrivningen
* Arbetsplats: 100% ONSITE (ingen remote\-möjlighet angiven i originalbeskrivningen)


**Vi erbjuder:**
 Hos WeQuel blir du en del av ett konsultteam som värdesätter people first – vi tror på att framgång skapas genom engagemang, samarbete och utveckling. Vi erbjuder en platt organisation med korta beslutsvägar, stark gemenskap och möjlighet att påverka din egen utveckling. Utöver detta erbjuds en strategisk roll med stort inflytande över teknikval, arkitektur och riktning för AI/data\-satsningar, möjlighet att arbeta i framkant med GenAI och moderna dataplattformar, konkurrenskraftig lön i linje med senioritetsnivån, kompetensutveckling, konferenser och möjlighet att bygga extern synlighet, flexibel arbetsplats och goda anställningsvillkor, samt möjlighet att forma och leda teamets tekniska kultur.
   

  

 Skapa en arbets beskrivning för denna rollen (Sneior 8\+ År) : Elektroingenjörer – kraftsystem, elektrifiering (kopplat till klimatomställning, batterifabriker som Northvolt\-relaterade projekt)
   

  

**Elektroingenjör – Kraftsystem \& Elektrifiering – Konsultuppdrag inom Energi \& Industri**
 Vi på WeQuel söker nu en Senior Elektroingenjör med minst 8 års erfarenhet inom kraftsystem och elektrifiering i Västra Sverige där du blir en viktig del av vårt team med fokus på storskaliga elektrifieringsprojekt kopplade till klimatomställningen, bland annat batterifabriker likt Northvolt\-relaterade projekt. Du tar en ledande teknisk roll i design, dimensionering och driftsättning av kraftsystem för industriella anläggningar i framkant av den gröna omställningen.
   

  

 Som konsult hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta hos någon av våra kunder som är ledande företag inom energi, industri och tillverkning, där du bidrar till att elektrifiera produktionsanläggningar, optimera kraftförsörjning och skapa hållbara, robusta elsystemlösningar.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter:**
* Design och dimensionering av kraftsystem för industriella anläggningar och batterifabriker
* Framtagning av elscheman, enlinjescheman och teknisk dokumentation
* Ledning av elektrifieringsprojekt från koncept till driftsättning
* Dimensionering av transformatorer, ställverk, kablage och skyddsutrustning
* Riskbedömningar och säkerhetsanalyser enligt gällande elstandarder
* Samordning med leverantörer, entreprenörer och myndigheter
* Kravställning och uppföljning av underentreprenörer inom elteknik
* Teknisk rådgivning till projektledning och kund gällande kraftsystemlösningar
* Deltagande i idrifttagning och felsökning av elsystem
* Bidrag till kontinuerlig förbättring av arbetsmetoder och tekniska standarder


 Du arbetar i en dynamisk miljö där du självständigt driver ditt flöde framåt och samtidigt samarbetar med flera gränssnitt inom organisationen.
   

  

**Krav:**

Du blir en nyckelperson som sätter riktning för arkitektur, standarder och best practices inom data\- och AI\-domänen, samtidigt som du är hands\-on i den tekniska leveransen.
   

  

**Ansvarsområden**

title: Applied AI Engineer, Finance
description:
Less than a year out of stealth, Ledgentic is already working with enterprise clients across Europe. We're scaling fast, backed by experienced angel investors who've built and sold several unicorns, and we're only getting started.
 



  





 We started with Accounts Payable. Our LLM\-based engine now automates over 96% of invoices end to end, from line\-item matching to VAT validation and reconciliation. Next up: Expense Management and Accounts Receivable.
 



  





 We've proven that AI can automate a large part of invoice processing. The hard part isn't accessing the best models. It's understanding finance deeply enough to know what to automate, how it should work, and how to make it reliable when real\-world accounting gets complicated.
 



  





 You'll be part of deciding what we build next, working directly with customers and founders, and taking ideas all the way from the first conversation to what's running in production.
 



  





**AI isn't a feature here** 




 AI is embedded throughout our development process, from idea and architecture to code, testing and documentation. We use tools like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor every day.
 



  





 We're not looking for someone who's simply comfortable with that. We're looking for someone who wants to push it further.
 



  





**Our stack** 




 TypeScript, React, NestJS and PostgreSQL, with LLM\-based document understanding using Gemini and OpenAI, deployed on GCP with Terraform and Docker.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Work directly with finance customers to understand where invoice handling, VAT rules and expense flows create problems today.
* Turn those problems into product decisions and build the solutions yourself.
* Build new functionality in our Accounts Payable product, including VAT validation and supplier screening.
* Shape our next module, Expense Management, from the ground up alongside the founders.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* You sit at the intersection of
 *software engineering, finance and AI.*
* Hands\-on understanding of finance and accounting workflows such as AP, AR, reconciliation or expense management.
* At least a couple of years of hands\-on software development experience.
* *You don't just follow what's happening in AI, you use it:* 
 trying new tools, experimenting with new models and building things to see what actually works.
* Comfortable taking initiative, making decisions and moving things forward without waiting for a finished specification.



  





**Life at Ledgentic** 




 We're a team of ten based in central Stockholm, working closely with the founders with short decision paths and plenty of room to influence both product and technology.
 



  





 We like working together in person and expect you to spend a couple of days a week at the office. We're looking for people who want to take real ownership, not just of their code, but of what we build as a company.
 



  





 As an early member of the team, you'll have the opportunity to join our employee stock option program and share in the value you help create.
 



  





**Apply** 




 Don't have a CV? Send us your LinkedIn and answer a couple of questions. We'd much rather understand what you've built, what you know about finance and how you think about AI.

title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
**Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America’s accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 This is an incredibly hard problem to build for. Tax professionals scrutinize technology intensely, and for decades no solution has reached their level of accuracy. Until now.
   

  

 What makes it hard is that tax is filled with subjectivity. General accounting can be binary, where the saying goes that "numbers don't lie". Tax runs on professional judgment. Give two tax professionals the same task and you can get two different results where no one is wrong. Both are correct. Harnessing AI for a world where multiple outcomes are correct in the eyes of the users creates a dimension of challenge few vertical AI companies ever face.
   

  

 In under two years, Filed has become the market leader in the space and is reaching escape velocity. It's now Filed vs. the incumbents.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.
   

  

 Read more → TechCrunch
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

***What we should tell you about the role:***
 We're looking for a Fullstack AI Engineer who moves fast and thrives in high\-velocity environments. You're the kind of person who sees a product gap, understands the root cause quickly, and ships a working feature in hours or days, not weeks. You love turning complex workflows into clean, intuitive interfaces, and you don't wait for a perfect spec to get started.
   

  

 You're a builder who's just as comfortable designing React UIs and TypeScript APIs as you are wiring up Python backends or deploying to Google Cloud or Azure. You sweat the details, but never let them block momentum.
   

  

 At Filed, engineering means more than owning the code. You own the outcome. You ship a feature, watch how CPAs use it, look at the metrics, and decide what the next version should be. Just you and your team, the data, and the user.
   

  

 As one of our core engineering hires, you'll help shape how tax professionals experience AI\-assisted work end to end. You'll work closely with the AI, tax, and product teams \- and most importantly, our users \- to rethink what great AI native software can feel like.
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why this is a terrible job:**
* This is not a job for someone who likes to move slow.
* We operate week to week with ruthless speed. Sometimes we're going in the wrong direction, but more times than not we're going in the right direction.
* If you need a few extra days to polish a component, chances are there's already a handful of team members blocked behind you.
* You'll look at the usage data and figure out what to build next yourself.
* There are no clear answers. Just judgment calls, ambiguity, and constant input from every direction.
* You'll ask yourself, is this really the work? It is. And it's not for everyone.


 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why it’s the best career choice you’ll make:**
* We're building what tax pros call impossible. A product that behaves like a teammate, not just another tool.
* We run reviews every 4 months. We operate with total transparency around pay, performance, and progress.
* You'll be paid above market. You'll earn equity that grows fast. And you'll have full autonomy to make high\-impact decisions.
* You'll ship features because you believe in them, not because they got signed off.
* You'll talk to customer facing teams and will be exposed to customer feedback weekly. You'll drive outcomes end to end.
* We'll tell you what needs to be achieved. How you get there is on you.


 ⸻
   

  

**The teammate we’re looking for:**
* Thrives at solving hard product problems, not just technical ones
* Moves seamlessly between identifying problems, implementing solutions, and iterating quickly
* Excited by ownership \- you want to be the person accountable for how a feature performs
* No lone wolves \- we need a collaborative builder
* Big bonus if you've shipped product at a fast\-moving startup before


 ⸻
   

  

**What you’ll be responsible for:**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next \- without being told
* You want to learn about LLMs and how to make them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


 ⸻
   

  

**Your hard skillset:**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python \- you've built complex, data\-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast\-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


 ⸻
   

  

**Your soft skillset:**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious \- building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail\-oriented but pragmatic \- you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


 ⸻
   

  

**Growth and Levels:**
* We operate on six levels, from Level 1 to Level 6\. Each reflects increasing ownership, impact, and scope with meaningful jumps in salary and equity.
* We review levels every 4 months. Promotions are based on output and ownership, not tenure.
* This isn't a comfortable CRUD role. It's fast, focused, and customer\-obsessed.
* You will launch fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship.


 ⸻
   

  

**The process:**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3\.5 hours, you’ll be wanting early access \- just like the rest of our team \- to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day. Because you’ll see the opportunity to change your career trajectory \- fast.

title: Machine Learning Engineer intern - Part-Time
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 As a Machine Learning Engineer Intern at Voi, you will play a key role in designing and building machine learning models for our edge ML product. You will work across both software engineering and machine learning challenges, contribute to our product rollout, and help enhance the safety and real\-world performance of our vehicles. You will join a high\-impact product team, see your work deployed on Voi vehicles worldwide, and learn how to build ML products end\-to\-end.
 **Please note this role is for 50% (Part\-Time).**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Help build a cutting\-edge machine learning product and see your models deployed on Voi vehicles across multiple markets.
* Build an ML solution end\-to\-end, from dataset creation and PoC model development to edge ML optimisation, deployment and impact measurement.
* Support production\-grade models with a focus on reliability, scalability, and high performance.
* Collaborate with a world\-class, cross\-functional product team, aligning on priorities and outcomes while learning from and supporting your teammates.


**What You Need To Embark**
 You are a curious, hands\-on and analytical problem\-solver with a strong interest in applied machine learning. You enjoy working with real\-world data, building models that ship to production, and collaborating with others to create solutions that make a tangible impact.
   

  

**We Believe You Have**
* Current enrolment in an MSc in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics or a related field, with around one year or less remaining in your studies.
* Strong Python programming skills and experience with Git; experience deploying machine learning models or backend code in production is a plus.
* Solid understanding of common machine learning techniques such as convolutional neural networks, transfer learning and object detection, and hands\-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit\-learn.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, and a proactive communication style in a cross\-functional team environment.


 Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.
   

  

**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s \#1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest growing scale\-ups.
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog\-friendly office.
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.


 If you are eager to apply your machine learning skills to real\-world problems and shape the future of micromobility, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 150,000\+ vehicles in 110\+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8\+ million riders with over 400\+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way \- through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast\-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation \- and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more \- therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform \- designed by clinicians, for clinicians \- is built on deep insight into real\-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-scaling health\-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for an exceptional Senior AI Engineer to join us in building the future of healthcare in Europe.
   

  

 This is not a traditional ML role. We’re looking for someone who has spent the last few years deeply immersed in building real\-world, LLM\-native products \- someone who has moved beyond prototypes and understands what it takes to ship fast, reliable, production\-grade AI systems that users depend on every day.
   

  

 Today, our AI products are already used daily by thousands of healthcare professionals across Europe. Our AI scribe is live in production at significant scale, and we’re now expanding far beyond documentation into a broader suite of AI\-native workflows and products across the healthcare experience.
   

  

 You’ll join a small, highly ambitious team building some of the most advanced applied AI systems in European healthcare. We believe AI will fundamentally reshape healthcare over the coming decade, and we’re building products that meaningfully improve how care is delivered at scale.
   

  

 This role comes with substantial ownership, not only over technical execution, but also over shaping new AI initiatives, product directions, and how AI gets deployed across the company.
   

  

 We’re still early enough that the right person will have enormous impact on both the product and the organization, while working alongside an unusually strong team of engineers, builders, and operators. This role is ideal for someone currently building AI\-heavy products at a startup or fast\-moving tech company, and who wants to work even closer to the frontier of applied AI.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Build and scale deeply integrated LLM\-powered product experiences used daily by healthcare professionals across Europe
* Lead new AI initiatives from concept to production, helping define both technical direction and product strategy
* Design robust systems around prompting, orchestration, evaluation, retrieval, agents, speech, and model infrastructure
* Own projects end\-to\-end \- from early product thinking and architecture decisions to deployment and iteration in production
* Work closely with product, design, and engineering to create AI experiences that feel magical while remaining reliable and practical
* Continuously evaluate and integrate new models, tooling, and infrastructure as the ecosystem evolves
* Improve performance, latency, reliability, and cost\-efficiency across our AI stack
* Help shape how we work with AI across the company as we continue scaling our platform and team


 What You Bring
   

  

* 5\+ years of engineering experience, with at least 2–4 years spent primarily building and shipping LLM\-powered products
* Strong hands\-on experience applying modern LLMs in production environments \- not just experimentation or research
* Experience building agentic workflows or complex multi\-step LLM systems
* Experience leading technical initiatives or owning major AI product areas with high autonomy
* Experience working with evaluation pipelines, model monitoring, or AI reliability systems
* A strong product mindset and intuition for building AI experiences that create real user value
* Experience operating in fast\-moving startup environments with high ownership and ambiguity
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and ability to build high\-quality systems end\-to\-end
* Experience with technologies such as Python, TypeScript, React, Kubernetes, or similar modern tooling
* Deep curiosity about the rapidly evolving AI landscape, and excitement to stay at the frontier of applied AI
* collaborative, low\-ego approach and desire to work with exceptionally talented teammates


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience with speech\-to\-text, voice AI, or multimodal models
* Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries
* Experience with fine\-tuning and training LLMs


 Location
   

  

 We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
   

  

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* Technical interviews with some of our Engineering team
* System Design Interview at our office \- Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a Product focused System Design interview to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
* Follow\-up interview with our CTO \& Co\-Founder


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary \& company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top\-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team\-building activities (off\-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.


*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*
**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high\-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare \- and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites \- blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude \- valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: AI Engineer
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We're looking for AI Engineers who want to build the systems that automate how the world's largest financial institutions do research. You'll work across the full stack of modern AI \- from model training to agentic workflows to large\-scale data pipelines.
   

  

**Why Grasp**
 Grasp is an agentic AI platform for finance. The $1\.4 trillion financial advisory industry relies heavily on costly and scarce cognitive labor. The industry is so inefficient that advisory firms can charge millions of dollars for teams of junior employees, whose work is 90% manual and repetitive. It is clear that AI will automate large parts of this work and provide a massive uplift in productivity.
   

  

 Grasp is used by 250 of the world’s largest finance institutions, including PwC, KPMG, Deloitte, and EY, to automate complex company and market research workflows. We’re growing 4x per year and are backed by globally renowned investors such as Octopus Ventures and Yanno Capital.
   

  

 As part of our core technical team, you will be working on the absolute frontier of AI, building an LLM\-based product with very strong customer traction.
   

  

**Role**
 As an AI Engineer at Grasp, you will develop and ship cutting\-edge AI solutions and iterate them based on feedback from our users. We are currently hiring for varying levels of seniority and are looking for exceptional individuals excited about building the AI\-based professional services systems of the future.
   

  

 The role is based in Stockholm, Sweden. We use an in\-person work model. We offer unlimited Claude Code/Codex/Cursor spend and expect you to use this to the fullest extent.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Product Iteration: Build novel AI\-native workflows end\-to\-end, including training use\-case specific AI models, creating agentic workflows and developing inference and data retrieval pipelines.
* Performance: Architect and implement high performance systems that operate efficiently at scale \- minimizing latency and maximizing throughput across millions of data points.
* Stability: Deeply understand customer needs and identify product improvements, evaluating and improving our systems over time.
* Large Scale Data Processing: Work with a variety of large, unstructured, data sources to develop our product, including Grasp’s proprietary private company datasets and licensed data.
* Evaluation: Design and implement analytics\-driven evaluation systems that enable product growth.


**Skills and requirements**
 For this role you should:
   

  

* Have a strong track\-record of building AI/ML\-based systems or products.
* Have experience in building with LLMs \- both using existing models and training/fine\-tuning custom models.
* Have experience building agentic systems with for example retrieval, tool use, and structured outputs.
* Be comfortable working with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.


 Additionally, we think you will thrive in this role if you:
   

  

* Are excited about building the future of AI systems in knowledge work.
* Like to move fast, with a high sense of urgency in getting things done.
* Are a self\-starter and have a high degree of self\-directedness.
* Have excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.


**What we offer**
* A unique opportunity to join a fast\-growing startup automating workflows in one of the largest sectors of the global economy.
* Opportunity to build vertical AI systems side\-by\-side with in\-house finance domain experts that support you with evals, testing, and customer guidance.
* A great opportunity to learn and develop both on a professional and personal level.
* Lots of responsibility from day one.
* A competitive compensation package, incl. stock options.
