*While our mission is driven by business outcomes, you will lead a team that plays with the industry's best tools to solve the world's most interesting data and AI challenges.*
**Where you'll be:**
 This is a position based at our Global Headquarters in Stockholm (Sweden).
   

  

 We are proud of our culture of inclusivity and diversity. At our Global Headquarters we have 60\+ nationalities working together for our common goals. You will be part of this dynamic international team where English is the natural language.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application!
   

  

 As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: Data Engineer / Data Platform Consultant
description:
Bygg dataplattformar som lägger grunden för analys och AI.
 



  





 Vi söker fler konsulter som vill hjälpa våra kunder att skapa affärsvärde genom ett datadrivet arbetssätt, där teknik och säkerhet går hand i hand.
 



  





 Hos oss arbetar du i en trygg miljö där långsiktighet, kvalitet och samarbete är viktigare än snabba leveranser. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder, i roller där du är med och formar lösningar från behov till färdig implementation och där din erfarenhet bidrar till att skapa långsiktigt värde.
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Som Data Engineer / Data Platform\-konsult hos oss arbetar du med att bygga grunden för våra kunders datadrivna förmåga. Du trivs i uppdrag där du får:
 


* förstå kundens behov på djupet
* omsätta krav och vision till en konkret teknisk lösning
* designa och bygga moderna dataplattformar
* säkerställa att dataflöden är robusta, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara
* arbeta nära både teknik och verksamhet



  





 Du behöver inte vara expert på allt. Vi söker dig som är trygg i din kompetens, nyfiken på helheten och trivs med att ta ansvar i dina uppdrag.
 



  





**Vad du kan arbeta med hos oss** 




 Rollen kan se olika ut beroende på kund, uppdrag och din profil. Till exempel:
 


* Design och implementation av dataplattformar i Microsoft Fabric och Databricks
* Utveckling av data pipelines och ETL/ELT\-flöden
* Datamodellering och semantiska lager
* Integrationer och dataflöden mellan system
* Moderna arbetssätt kring datautveckling, t.ex. CI/CD, automatisering och kvalitetssäkring av dataflöden
* Realtidsdata och eventdriven arkitektur
* Visualisering och analys i Power BI
* AI\- och ML\-relaterade lösningar \- där dataplattformen är grunden



  





 Du kan arbeta kodnära eller mer rådgivande. Många av våra konsulter rör sig obehindrat mellan teknik och affär.
 



  





**Vilka vi tror att du är** 




 Du är en person som:
 


* gillar att samarbeta och skapa förtroende hos kunder och kollegor
* är nyfiken på nya arbetssätt och tekniker
* värderar kvalitet och långsiktighet
* är prestigelös och trivs i team
* vill dela med dig av din kunskap \- precis som vi gör



  





 Vi tror på olika erfarenheter och perspektiv, och på att du utvecklas bäst i en miljö där du får vara dig själv.
 



  





**Vi ser att du har** 



* minst tre års erfarenhet som Data Engineer eller inom dataplattformar
* arbetat i Azure\-, AWS\- eller liknande molnmiljö
* erfarenhet av verktyg som Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake eller liknande dataplattformar
* erfarenhet av SQL och databaser
* programmeringsvana i Python eller motsvarande
* vana av moderna utvecklingsmetoder, exempelvis CI/CD och versionshantering



  





 Det är starkt meriterande om du även har arbetat med BI/visualisering (t.ex. Power BI), eller har arbetat med analys\- eller AI/ML\-relaterade lösningar.
 



  





**Trygga uppdrag där du får utvecklas** 




 Hos oss hamnar du i uppdrag som är:
 


* affärskritiska – där din kompetens behövs på riktigt
* långsiktiga – med tid att göra rätt, inte bara snabbt
* moderna – med teknik och miljöer som utmanar och utvecklar
* stabila – med team som står stadigt och kunder som litar på oss



  





 Vi matchar rätt personer med rätt uppdrag.
 



  





**Vi satsar på dig** 




 Omegapoint är byggt för lärande. Här får du:
 


* gemenskap, kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och kunskapsdelning
* möjlighet att föreläsa, certifiera dig och leda initiativ
* en kultur där vi är både vassa och snälla
* kollegor som gärna delar med sig, stöttar och inspirerar



  





 Tillsammans bygger vi säkra digitala lösningar som skapar långsiktigt värde.
 



  





 💚
 **Om oss** 




 Omegapoint är norra Europas ledande konsultbolag inom säker digital innovation. Vi är över 800 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Örebro, Västerås, Enköping, Uppsala och Umeå.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL
   

  

* You? A collaborative data professional who loves mentoring teams, setting clean architectural standards, and transforming data into highly reliable products.
* Role? A hands\-on Lead Data Engineer with broad organizational scope, bridging the gap between high\-level data strategy and day\-to\-day product engineering.
* Tech stack? Event\-driven architectures (Kafka, CDC), schema management, and modern cloud data platforms like GCP/BigQuery or Snowflake.
* Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA \& Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.
* Location? Join us in our Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen or Krakow office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely.
* Why us? This is your chance to make a profound impact by scaling our Data Mesh strategy across Vend's four core product verticals: Mobility, Real Estate, Jobs, and Recommerce. You will enjoy extensive professional growth, a culture built on mutual trust and psychological safety, and the autonomy to shape data maturity across a major Nordic technology ecosystem.


 Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
   

  

 WHO ARE YOU?
   

  

* You bring deep expertise in event\-driven architecture, including Kafka topic design, Change Data Capture (CDC), schema evolution, and both streaming and batch patterns.
* You have practical experience navigating cloud data platforms (such as GCP/BigQuery or Snowflake) alongside data quality frameworks and observability tools.
* You are a natural educator and coach who enjoys introducing modern data practices to product teams, meeting them where they are with patience and clarity.
* You thrive in a federated data ownership model (like Data Mesh) and feel comfortable guiding, aligning, and influencing cross\-functional peers without needing direct authority.
* You are an effective communicator in English, which is our primary working language, enabling you to clearly translate technical "how\-to" choices into meaningful "why" business value.


**WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?**
 As a Lead Data Engineer, your mission is to bring our data strategy to life within your product organization. You will ensure our data products are architecturally sound, thoroughly documented, and highly usable for downstream consumers, not just technically present.
   

  

 Your Typical Week
   

  

 You will balance your time between deep technical reviews and collaborative human alignment. One day you might be diving into event schemas and Kafka topic designs; the next, you’ll be coaching a product team through their very first data product or collaborating with central platform teams to keep standards uniform.
   

  

 Current Projects \& Focus Areas
   

  

* Championing the Data Operating Model: Serve as the core checkpoint for our Data Operating Model within your vertical, tracking progress against company\-wide data product coverage goals.
* Team Enablement: Guide teams end\-to\-end, from initial event emission through our golden paths to a discoverable product in our data catalog.
* Lifecycle Management: Own the healthy evolution of your organization's data products, smoothly managing versioning, breaking changes, and deprecations.


 Collaboration \& Stakeholders
   

  

 You will report directly to the CTO of your vertical while operating under the CPTO’s overarching data mandate. You will collaborate closely with peer Lead Data Engineers across Vend, our central platform infrastructure teams, and the product managers and engineers within your specific organization.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* After 6 months: You have built trusted relationships across your vertical, assessed current data product gaps, and successfully established initial quality and observability baselines.
* After 1 year: You have proven the success of our data strategy by delivering data products that actively drive revenue, optimize user experiences, or reduce time\-to\-insight across your vertical.


**What this role is NOT (to give you total clarity):**
* Not a platform engineer: You won’t be building Kafka clusters or maintaining Snowflake infrastructure—our dedicated central platform team handles that heavy lifting.
* Not an analytics engineer: You won’t own dbt models or build dashboards. Your focus is ensuring the foundation feeding the analytical layer is rock solid.
* Not a people manager: This is an individual contributor (IC) role focused on broad organizational influence, mentorship, and technical leadership rather than administration.


 Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!
   

  

 GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!
   

  

 Make sure to apply by
 **10th August 2026\.** 
 Please note that due to the summer/holidays, we will process all applications in mid\-August
   

  

 QUESTIONS?
   

  

**David Johansson Rad, Senior Manager, Project Management,** 
 is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. David is best reached via david.johansson.rad@vend.com (Do note he will be on leave, so expect some delays)
   

  

 For questions regarding the recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to our Senior Talent Acquisition Partner,
 **Clayton Don Corda,** 
 at clayton.don.corda@vend.com

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**VNTRS is growing!**
 We are now looking for a Senior Data Engineer who is passionate about innovation \& data. Do you want to be part of a team that uses the latest technologies and grows our business in both Sweden and internationally? Do you have great engineering and analytics skills and would like to work with inspiring people? Then for sure you will enjoy working with us at VNTRS!
   

  

**About VNTRS**
 Creating successful companies together with our clients is at the heart and soul of VNTRS. We believe that too many great ideas fall short due to the wrong reasons – we exist to change that. We are consultants but we don’t consider ourselves as such. We think that we get the best chances to reach success by becoming partners with our clients and working together as one team.
   

  

 We are currently 30\+ coworkers and at VNTRS we like to share risks and have skin in the game. To partner up with promising entrepreneurs/corporations and share the risk and upside together with all our co\-workers is one of the cornerstones of VNTRS.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Working at VNTRS as a Senior Data Engineer you can expect a lot of diversity in your daily tasks (engineering, advising clients, strategic solutions...). You will mostly be working closely with external clients, with some work including startups from our portfolio.
   

  

 We will actively let you work on exciting projects to broaden your skillset. Within the assignments, you will be using a wide range of data engineering technologies, while also being a core part of cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Depending on the assignment, your opinion will have a big impact when it comes to the solution, but also the scoping of the whole process such as prioritisation, techstacks and architecture.

 At least
 **5**

 Bachelors or master’s degree

*Amazing equity \& bonus programme:*
 All co\-workers get the exclusive right to invest in the portfolio of startups that we all work with.
   

  

**Coaching Mindset And Mandate To Make Change**
 We believe in a flat organisation where everybody is shaping VNTRS. You will get real responsibility from day one. Together we create a personal development plan based on your career goals and give you the senior support you need to achieve them.
   

  

*Having fun and work\-life balance!*

Every other Friday we all gather for a social lunch and every other Wednesday breakfast is served \- both of which are on the house. At the end of the week we also have a common after\-work at the office. We also have two yearly conferences!
   

  

**Generous Benefits**
 On top of our amazing equity programme, 5000 kr in wellness grant, educational bonus and parental leave top up during 6 months are some of our hidden perks.
   

  

**Application**
 If you're ready to play a key role in VNTRS's tech revolution, we want to hear from you. Apply now to contribute to the future success of VNTRS and our clients.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About the Role
   

  

  

  

 We are looking for an Business Data Analyst to support complex data and regulatory reporting initiatives. The role combines business analysis, data management, financial data expertise, and stakeholder engagement to ensure high\-quality reporting and data governance across multiple systems.
   

  

  

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Collect, analyze, harmonize, and validate large datasets from multiple source systems.
* Design, document, and maintain data models, mappings, and ETL processes.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and compliance with reporting requirements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, clarify, and document requirements, ensuring appropriate governance and formal sign\-off.
* Analyze financial and accounting data, including balance sheet structures and financial instruments.
* Create and maintain metadata documentation, including data lineage, source definitions, assumptions, and reporting obligations.
* Support the functional design of end\-to\-end data and reporting solutions, including controls, reconciliations, and reporting processes.
* Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL and modern database technologies such as Snowflake, Oracle, and MS SQL Server.
* Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, automate processes, and identify innovative use cases.
* Work within Agile delivery teams and manage tasks using Jira.


  

  

 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 5–10 years of relevant in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, or Data Management roles.
* Strong working with large and complex datasets.
* Advanced SQL skills and hands\-on with databases such as Snowflake, Oracle, and MS SQL Server.
* Proven ability to define and document data structures, mappings, and ETL flows across multiple applications and systems.
* Solid understanding of accounting principles, balance sheet structures, and financial instruments.
* documenting metadata, data lineage, assumptions, and reporting requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive discussions, clarify requirements, and facilitate formal sign\-off processes.
* Practical using AI tools to enhance productivity and support innovation initiatives.
* Working proficiency with Jira and Agile ways of working.


  

  

 Preferred Qualifications

title: Data Engineer
description:
**For a Sustainable Future Together**
 Coop is Sweden's largest cooperative and a leading player in the grocery retail sector, with over 4 million members. We focus heavily on sustainability and work to create a greener and more just future by offering sustainable products and services.
   

  

 We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to creating a more inclusive and successful workplace. Therefore, we welcome everyone, regardless of gender, age, background, or ethnic origin.
   

  

**Coop Sverige – Together we make food\-Sweden sustainable**
 At Coop we are building the data backbone of a truly data\-driven company. We run stores for our 4\.2 million members, and our motto is “Relevance in every touchpoint.” Understanding our customers’ needs and behaviours is what fuels our innovation – from purchasing and logistics to personalised customer experiences.
   

  

 We are now strengthening our Data Platform team with a skilled Data Engineer to help us build scalable, cloud\-native data solutions on Azure.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will be part of our Data Platform team, which sits within Coop’s AI \& Business Intelligence organisation – the team building the data foundation that powers analytics, reporting, operational intelligence and AI across the company.
   

  

 In this role you will design, build and optimise enterprise\-grade data platforms using Azure Data Services, Databricks, modern Data Lakehouse architectures, real\-time streaming and DevOps automation. You’ll turn data from across the business into trusted, high\-quality data products that the whole organisation can rely on.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design and implement scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines using Azure\-native technologies.
* Build and maintain robust data ingestion frameworks from multiple source systems, APIs and event streams.
* Develop and manage Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) within the enterprise Data Lake.
* Implement streaming solutions with Kafka, Event Hub and Service Bus for event\-driven processing.
* Develop transformation frameworks using Databricks, PySpark and Delta Lake.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data analysts and data scientists to deliver trusted, high\-quality data products.
* Enable CI/CD pipelines and automate deployments using Azure DevOps best practices.
* Drive platform optimization focused on performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, security, monitoring and operational excellence standards.


***Who are you?***
 To succeed in this role, we believe you have a genuine passion for getting value from massive datasets and love working with state\-of\-the\-art technologies that make completely new data\-driven solutions possible. You enjoy working with different tasks and stakeholders, you are result\-oriented, and you spark when given room to take initiative and create solutions. As a team, we believe in supporting and challenging each other and growing a positive, learning culture.
   

  

**We believe that you**
* Have strong hands\-on experience with the Azure data platform – Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS), Azure Functions, Event Hub and Service Bus.
* Are highly skilled in Databricks and the Lakehouse – PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, Unity Catalog and performance tuning, applying Medallion and Lakehouse architecture in practice.
* Are strong in data architecture and modelling – Lakehouse and Medallion design, ETL/ELT frameworks, and data quality \& validation frameworks.
* Have experience with streaming and integration – Apache Kafka, event\-driven architecture, Service Bus, batch ingestion / Autoloader and REST APIs.
* Are a confident programmer in Python, PySpark and SQL.
* Work the DevOps way – Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipeline development and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).
* Are comfortable with monitoring and operations – Log Analytics, Application Insights, and performance tuning \& troubleshooting.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical specialists and non\-technical stakeholders.


**It’s meritorious if you**
* Have 5\+ years of experience in data engineering.
* Have built enterprise\-scale Azure data platforms hands\-on.
* Have worked with retail, logistics or large\-scale operational data environments.
* Have supported machine learning and advanced analytics workloads.
* Have a strong understanding of distributed data processing and streaming architectures.


**About Us**
 The grocery trade is a stable, long\-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4\.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.
   

  

 If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Jakob Liljedahl (jakob.liljedahl@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)
   

  

*Welcome with your application!*

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Junior Data Analyst to assist our team in evaluating the commercial assumptions and financial datasets underlying a large scale project for a Swedish infrastructure group. This is a permanent, full time position that functions entirely within a remote environment, focusing on building the models and analysis needed to support high stakes advisory work.
   

  

**About Blue Oak Consulting**
 Blue Oak Consulting provides independent advisory on pricing, portfolio economics, capital allocation, and acquisition assumptions. We are not a traditional firm focused on broad transformation programs or high level strategy decks. Instead, we interrogate specific commercial decisions where the financial stakes are high and the existing narrative is not sufficient. Our team looks past corporate language and P\&L complexity to identify where value is leaking or capital is trapped. We work across sectors like software, manufacturing, and healthcare to test whether the assumptions behind a growth plan or an acquisition actually hold under pressure. We are a small, principal led firm where the people who do the work are the ones accountable for the results. We do not take transaction contingent fees, which allows us to be completely honest about whether the economics of a decision make sense. Our goal is to provide clarity through financial discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism. We stay through the execution phase because decisions that look sound in theory often fail when they meet real world friction.
   

  

**The Role**
 Working as a Junior Data Analyst at Blue Oak Consulting means looking under the hood of complex businesses to find the logic (or lack thereof) in their financial cases. You will work closely with our principals to analyze the commercial data of our clients, including a current focus on a Swedish infrastructure group. Because we are a small firm, you will not be buried in a massive hierarchy: your work is seen and utilized by the people making final recommendations. The position is fully remote, requiring a professional who is disciplined enough to manage their work and communication without the guardrails of a traditional office. You will be tasked with identifying inconsistencies, testing the sensitivity of financial models, and ensuring that our conclusions are based on hard data rather than optimistic narratives.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing** 
* Gathering raw financial and operational data from client systems and cleaning it for use in analysis.
* Building and maintaining Excel models to test various pricing scenarios and capital allocation strategies.
* Comparing historical performance data against future forecasts to find gaps in logic.
* Assisting in the analysis of asset values and maintenance costs for a Swedish infrastructure group engagement.
* Investigating anomalies in large datasets to identify areas where costs might be hidden or rising.
* Documenting the methodology used in your calculations to ensure every result is reproducible and transparent.
* Supporting principals in preparing data visualizations and summary tables that clarify complex financial points.
* Tracking the performance of specific assets and projects against the assumptions made during the planning phase.
  

  


**What You Bring** 
* A degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a similar field that requires quantitative analysis.
* Comfort working with large spreadsheets and a high level of proficiency in Excel, including nested formulas and data organization.
* A skeptical mindset that instinctively asks where a number comes from and what it actually represents.
* The ability to follow complex instructions and pay close attention to detail when dealing with sensitive information.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain data findings in plain, non technical language.
* An interest in the practical side of business economics: how companies actually make and lose money.
* The self discipline to work independently in a remote setting while staying highly responsive to the team.
* Basic familiarity with accounting principles and how those translate into financial statements.
  

  


**What We Offer** 
* A fully remote working arrangement that allows for professional autonomy.
* Direct access to and mentorship from firm principals on every project.
* The opportunity to work on significant commercial decisions with tangible real world consequences.
* A professional environment free from unnecessary corporate jargon and internal politics.
* The position is paid and the compensation is competitive for the role and current market.
* Practical training in financial forensic analysis and commercial skepticism.
* Exposure to diverse industries including international infrastructure and software.
  

  


 At Blue Oak Consulting, we value clear thinking over polished presentations. We believe that the best advice comes from a thorough understanding of the numbers and a willingness to confront uncomfortable facts. Our work is about providing the clarity that leaders need to make informed decisions in high stakes environments. We look for people who are more interested in finding the truth within a dataset than in following a standard corporate script. If you enjoy the process of dissecting a financial model to see if it holds up under pressure, you will find our approach rewarding and intellectually demanding.

title: Entry-Level Data Analyst
description:
We are adding an Entry\-Level Data Analyst to our team to support a Swedish financial technology group as it expands its operations. This role is focused on verifying the financial assumptions that drive growth and ensuring the data reflects the reality of the business.
   

  

**About Blue Oak Consulting**
 Blue Oak Consulting provides independent advisory on pricing, portfolio economics, capital allocation, and acquisition assumptions. We are not a traditional consulting firm focused on broad transformation programs or high level strategy decks. Instead, we interrogate specific commercial decisions where the financial stakes are high and the existing narrative is not sufficient. Our team looks past corporate language and P\&L complexity to identify where value is leaking or capital is trapped. We work across sectors like software, manufacturing, and healthcare to test whether the assumptions behind a growth plan or an acquisition actually hold under pressure. We are a small, principal led firm where the people who do the work are the ones accountable for the results. We do not take transaction contingent fees, which allows us to be completely honest about whether the economics of a decision make sense. Our goal is to provide clarity through financial discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism. We stay through the execution phase because decisions that look sound in theory often fail when they meet real world friction.
   

  

**The Role**
 In this role, you will be part of a distributed team working directly with senior advisors to analyze customer data and financial models. Since we operate as a fully remote firm, you will have the autonomy to manage your tasks while checking in regularly for feedback. The work is not about creating pretty slides: it is about getting the numbers right and questioning the logic that leads to a particular investment or pricing decision. You will spend your time digging through transaction records and cohort data to see if the Swedish fintech group expansion plans are supported by the actual behavior of their users.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing** 
* Extracting and cleaning data from various financial systems to prepare it for analysis.
* Building simple financial models to test how changes in pricing or customer churn affect the bottom line.
* Reviewing historical data to identify trends that might contradict the current management narrative.
* Participating in internal calls to discuss findings and refine hypotheses about the business.
* Organizing large datasets into clear, logical structures that senior principals can use for their advisory work.
* Monitoring key performance indicators for the Swedish fintech group as their new services go live.
* Documentation of the logic used in our models to ensure that our conclusions are defensible and transparent.
* Assisting with the preparation of internal reports that highlight financial discrepancies or risks.
  

  


**What You Bring** 
* A university degree in finance, economics, mathematics, or a related field with a strong quantitative component.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to use lookups, pivot tables, and logical functions.
* A natural curiosity and a willingness to ask questions when the data does not seem to make sense.
* Strong attention to detail, as small errors in a data set can lead to incorrect conclusions.
* The ability to communicate findings clearly in writing without relying on unnecessary jargon.
* Comfort working in a fully remote environment where proactive communication is necessary.
* Basic familiarity with data visualization tools or a willingness to learn how to represent data visually.
* A disciplined approach to problem solving and the ability to stay focused on complex tasks.
  

  


**What We Offer** 
* A fully remote work arrangement that provides flexibility in how you manage your day.
* Direct mentorship from senior principals who have extensive experience in financial advisory.
* Exposure to real world commercial problems that go beyond what is taught in a classroom.
* A culture that values evidence and logic over hierarchy or office politics.
* Competitive pay that is attractive for an entry level professional in the current market.
* Regular opportunities to review your work with experts and improve your analytical skills.
* The chance to contribute to high stakes projects for an expanding international fintech group.
  

  


 Working at Blue Oak Consulting means being part of a team that cares more about the truth of a financial case than keeping a client comfortable. We believe that clarity is the most valuable thing we can provide, and that clarity starts with disciplined data work. You will see how your analysis directly informs the advice we give and how that advice changes the way companies operate. It is a demanding environment because we hold ourselves to high standards, but it is also one where early career professionals can skip the busywork and focus on meaningful financial analysis.

**What we offer**

* A great opportunity to learn and develop both on a professional and personal level.

* A competitive compensation package, incl. stock options.

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)| Legal AI Tech Scale-Up | Full Remote
description:
**Your team**
 As a Data Engineer (f/d/m), you will play a key role in our Data Expansion Squad, which is responsible for integrating and operationalizing legal data from multiple jurisdictions. The team transforms heterogeneous source data into a unified, high\-quality foundation that powers search, retrieval, and AI\-supported workflows across our products.
   

  

 Felix, our VP AI \& Data Engineering, will guide you through your journey at Noxtua. With deep expertise in AI systems, Felix leads with a passion for innovation and a collaborative approach, ensuring every team member thrives.
   

  

 You will work closely with AI, engineering, and legal domain experts to adapt and extend existing data workflows for new customer datasets and source formats. Your work will focus on understanding source structures, defining robust mappings, standardizing and enriching content, and ensuring that data is integrated in a way that is reliable, scalable, and easy to use in downstream systems. Our Tech Team of around 32 people, including UI Engineers, UI Designers, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, as well as Fullstack, Backend, and DevOps Engineers. Within that team, the Data Expansion Team provides the data foundation, structure, and metadata needed for our agent\-based systems to retrieve relevant legal information efficiently and reliably across jurisdictions.
   

  

**About You**
* Experience: at least 2 years of professional experience in data engineering, and being involved in successfully deployed projects
* Programming: Strong Python skills with experience in designing robust data pipelines
* Technical Expertise: Experience in building and maintaining reliable ET and RAG pipelines and a solid understanding of data modeling, quality, filtering, validation, and consistency
* Infrastructure: Familiarity with containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git)
* Fundamentals: Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, system design principles, and software engineering best practices
* Expertise in working with graph databases and familiarity with developing and deploying NLP models is a bonus
* Language: English proficiency at the C2 level


**Your Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and optimize end\-to\-end ETL pipelines for legal data from multiple jurisdictions, including cleaning, transformation, chunking, validation, embedding, and ingestion into vector databases
* Work extensively with XML\-based legal data feeds: parse, validate, normalize, and transform XML structures into scalable internal schemas and unified document formats
* Develop and maintain data models and storage schemas that support continuously updated datasets while ensuring consistency, scalability, and accuracy across diverse datasets and large amounts of data
* Coordinate data handover and integration from multiple internal and external data providers, including official sources, APIs, and web scraping pipelines, ensuring reliable and timely updates
* Implement and continuously refine metadata enrichment strategies to maximize searchability, ranking quality, and relevance of legal information in vector databases.
* Build and maintain a high\-performance search and retrieval infrastructure enabling agent\-based systems to call search functions and retrieve the most relevant legal information efficiently
* Collaborate with product, AI, and legal domain experts to deliver high\-quality, reliable data solutions
* Own the data integration of one jurisdiction end\-to\-end


**Our offer to you**
 Building
 **Europe's sovereign Legal AI** 
 is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real\-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work from wherever you are.
   

  

* Remote: 100% remote work possible (given a German residence), other countries upon request
* Working hours: Flexible working hours
* Vacation: 26 days \+ December 24th \& 31st off, \+ 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days)
* Discounts: e.g., Urban Sports Club Membership, depending on location
* Equipment: Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus €1,000 net home office setup budget (paid with your first salary)


**Mid\-Level Salary Ranges gross per year:**
* Germany: €58k – €72k EUR
* France: €48k – €59k EUR
* Switzerland: 77k – 96k CHF (≈ €75k – €93k EUR)
* Sweden: 667k – 828k SEK (≈ €58k – €72k EUR)
* Austria: €57k – €71k EUR
* Italy: €46k – €58k EUR
* Poland: 168k – 209k PLN (≈ €39k – €48k EUR)
* Croatia: €35k – €43k EUR
* Slovakia: €34k – €42k EUR


 The actual offer within the range depends on your relevant experience, demonstrated impact, and interview outcome — not on negotiation skill or gender. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are happy to discuss the criteria for placement within the range during the interview process.
   

  

 For other countries you will get the information within your invitation to a potential interview.
   

  

**About Us**
 Noxtua is Europe’s sovereign Legal AI. This legally competent AI covers the entire spectrum of legal text work – from information gathering (
 *research* 
 ) and analysis of complex issues (
 *understanding* 
 ) to document creation (
 *drafting* 
 ). The legally compliant AI meets the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements for lawyers (e.g. Section 203 German Criminal Code, Section 43e German Federal Code for Lawyers), is certified according to BSI C5, TISAX, ISO 27001, 9001, 27018, 27017, and 42001\. The tech company Noxtua has formed exclusive partnerships with leading European publishing houses from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia for the Legal AI Workspaces Beck\-Noxtua, MANZ\-Noxtua, Swiss\-Noxtua, Beck\-Noxtua Poland, Beck\-Noxtua Czech Republic and Beck\-Noxtua Slovakia.
   

  

 Founded in 2017 in the German capital as a result of a research project by Dr. Leif\-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the European legal tech company has many years of experience in developing GDPR\-compliant AI solutions and now has offices in Paris, Berlin, Zagreb, and Munich. Strategic partners including Germany’s leading legal publisher C.H.BECK as well as the leading law firms CMS and Dentons have invested around 81 million EURO in the European scaleup as part of its Series B.
   

  

**We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.**

title: AI & Data Engineer
description:
Du ser mönster i det komplexa, drivs av att hitta nya lösningar och är tillräckligt nyfiken för att ifrågasätta dina egna svar. Med några års relevant erfarenhet inom teknik, data, systemutveckling, analys eller integration kan du här ta nästa steg som Data Engineer. I rollen hjälper du etablerade företag att förstå, strukturera och använda sin data för att fatta bättre beslut. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan teknik, data, AI och affär på ett expansivt specialistbolag där du får utvecklas nära seniora kollegor, med möjlighet till delägarskap på sikt.
 



  





**Om tjänsten:** 




 Som Data Engineer hjälper du några av Sveriges mest datadrivna företag att fatta bättre beslut. Du arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan data, teknik, AI och affär, där fokus ligger på att göra information tillgänglig, tillförlitlig och användbar för verksamheten.
 



  





 Vi söker dig som tidigare arbetat nära data, system eller informationsflöden och där du ställt dig frågan:
 *"Hur kan den här datan användas på ett bättre sätt?"* 




  





 Din arbetsgivare är ett specialistkonsultbolag inom Data Analytics, Data Engineering och AI. De hjälper sina kunder att bygga moderna dataplattformar, utveckla analysförmåga och skapa bättre beslutsunderlag med hjälp av data.
 



  





 Bolaget är i stark tillväxt, har stabil lönsamhet och en tydlig plan framåt. De är fortfarande tillräckligt små för att varje person ska kunna påverka, men tillräckligt etablerade för att arbeta med stora och spännande kunder. Möjlighet till delägarskap finns.
 



  





 Kulturen präglas av hög kompetens, nyfikenhet och kunskapsdelning. Här arbetar du nära seniora kollegor som är starka problemlösare och som gärna delar med sig av sin erfarenhet.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter:** 




 Du arbetar nära kunder för att förstå deras verksamhet, utmaningar och målbild. Rollen passar dig som är analytisk, kommunikativ och affärsmässig, och som drivs av att lösa komplexa problem med hjälp av modern teknik och AI\-stödda arbetssätt. Uppdragen varierar i både omfattning och innehåll.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
 


* Kartlägga data, system och informationsflöden
* Strukturera och konsolidera data från flera källor
* Designa och vidareutveckla moderna dataplattformar
* Arbeta med datamodellering och datapipelines
* Integrera data mellan olika system
* Använda AI\-stödda arbetssätt och moderna verktyg
* Översätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar



  





**Vem vi söker:** 



* Relevant civilingenjörsexamen, exempelvis inom datateknik, industriell ekonomi, teknisk fysik, systemvetenskap, matematik, maskinteknik, elektro eller liknande
* Cirka 3–7 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet där du kommit i kontakt med data, system, integrationer, analys eller informationsflöden
* Förmåga att förstå hur data kan användas som beslutsunderlag
* God kommunikativ förmåga och trygghet i dialog med kunder eller andra intressenter
* Nyfikenhet på AI, moderna utvecklingsverktyg och nya arbetssätt
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska



  





 Har du byggt något på fritiden, testat AI\-verktyg, automatiserat en process, skapat en app, analyserat data eller fördjupat dig i teknik av eget intresse? Då är det starkt meriterande. Som person söker vi dig med rätt grundförmågor: skärpa, nyfikenhet, konsultmässighet och förmåga att lära sig snabbt.
 



  





 Moderna verktyg och AI förändrar hur tekniska lösningar byggs. Därför är det viktigare att du kan förstå problemet, välja angreppssätt, använda rätt stöd och kvalitetssäkra resultatet än att du redan har arbetat med exakt samma teknik i tidigare roller.
 



  





 Du tycker om att möta kunder, förstå deras verklighet och hjälpa dem framåt. Du kan förklara komplexa saker på ett enkelt sätt och bygga förtroende i dialog med både tekniska och icke\-tekniska personer.
 



  





 Samtidigt gillar du problemlösning. Du är inte rädd för otydliga frågor, komplexa system eller data som inte är perfekt från början. Du tycker snarare att det är intressant att reda ut, strukturera och hitta vägen framåt.
 



  





**Om anställningen:** 




 Detta är en rekrytering där du kommer bli anställd direkt hos kundföretaget. Friday ansvarar för rekryteringsprocessen och alla frågor hänvisas till Friday.
 



  





**Övrig info:** 



* Omfattning: Heltid
* Start: Enligt överenskommelse
* Placering: Stockholm
* Rekryteringsansvarig: Anna Persson, anna.persson@friday.se
* Lön: Fast månadslön samt bonusmodeller



  





 Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.
 



  





**Om Friday:** 




*På Friday hjälper vi Tech\-talanger att hitta roller där de trivs, utvecklas och gör skillnad. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.*

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Är du en erfaren Data Engineer som gillar att leda och agera mentor för andra Data Engineers i projekt? Designar du end\-to\-end arkitektur och vill arbeta med modern teknik för att lösa komplexa problem tillsammans med ett nätverk av skickliga Data\- och Analysexperter? Då kan du vara den vi söker!"
 



  





 Våra närmare 100 dataexperter i Sverige jobbar med datalösningar inom nästan alla teknologier. Ett vanligt projekt varierar i längd från en månad till några år, och situationen kan justeras baserat på dina önskemål. Våra kunder finns inom alla branscher, allt från produktutveckling, hälsa, industri och försäkring till kommunikation, bank och elförsörjning.
 



  





**Möt en av våra Data Engineers:** 
 Clara Lundström arbetar i ett projekt för ett globalt företag inom facility service, det största i Norden. Tillsammans med sitt team illustrerar hon datalandskapet och använder data från olika källor för att skapa visualiseringar. Clara beskriver arbetet på Solita som varierat och utvecklande, med tillgång till ett stort nätverk av experter inom många olika områden.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder:** 



* En företagskultur som präglas av autonomi, stöd och gemensam tillväxt.
* Spännande kundprojekt och erfarna kollegor som är omtänksamma och passionerade.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med en stor bredd av projekt och branscher.
* Partnerskap med ledande tech\-företag som GCP, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Dbt, Databricks, Fabric mfl.



  





**Känner du igen dig i följande?** 




 Som Senior Data Engineer på Solita jobbar du brett; end\-to\-end från ingestion hela vägen till visualisering. Du leder andra Data Engineers i projekt och har erfarenhet av att sätta upp arkitektur. Du driver kvalitet, effektivitet och innovation inom data platformar samt säkerställer att strategi sammanfaller med kundens mål.
 



  





 Det är bra om du har erfarenhet inom; pipelines, ingestion, datawarehousing, modellering, analys och visualisering. Exempel på tekniker vi arbetar med är Snowflake, Dbt, Databricks, Fabric, Data factory, BigQuery mfl.
 



  





 Som konsult på Solita är det viktigt att du kan kommunicera tekniska lösningar till kunder och hantera deras behov och problem. Du behärskar även svenska och engelska flytande.
 



  





**Dina ansvarsområden i rollen:** 



* Självständigt leverera komplexa uppdrag inom ditt expertområde och planera de bästa åtgärderna för att nå önskade resultat.
* Utveckla arbetsmetoder och processer samt vägleda och agera mentor till andra.
* Analysera nya problem, bedöma teknisk information och andra källor, samt utveckla nya lösningar.
* Optimera befintliga processer och delta i utvecklingen av nya processer av avdelningsövergripande betydelse.
* Leverera lösningar till kunder och samarbeta nära med dem för att förstå och möta deras behov.
* Sammarbeta med arkitekter och rådgivare inom data för framtidssäkra lösningar
* Du bidrar inom pre\-sale och Solitas offering



  





 Det viktigaste för oss är ändå att du delar våra värderingar, du är omtänksam mot andra och delar gärna din kunskap och vågar stå för det du tror på. Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss, och vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete, och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech\-bloggar.
 



  





**Våra förmåner** 




 Hos oss får du inte bara trevliga kollegor utan du får även ta del av ett brett förmånspaket. Här är några utav våra förmåner:
 



 💰 Fast lön, oberoende av beläggningsgrad
 



 🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
 



 ⚖️ Interna mentorskapsprogram
 



 🛋️ Möjligheter till flex för en god work\-life\-balance
 



 🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
 



 🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
 



 🥐 Fredagsfrukost
 



  





**Intresserad?** 




 Vid frågor; kontakta maja.oderstedt(at)solita.se eller jacob.beck(at)solita.se alternativt ansök här.
 



 Vi är nyfikna på att höra mer om din motivation och hur du ser din tillväxt framför dig. Dela ditt CV nedan så återkommer vi så fort vi kan. Under semestertider har vi längre svarstider, vi är tillbaka i Augusti.

title: Senior AI Engineer - B2B SaaS startup
description:

title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
**Do you want to join the technological revolution? Tendium is looking for a Fullstack AI Engineer to join our team.**
**About Tendium**
 Tendium is the global pioneer in AI\-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI\-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R\&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
   

  

 If you’re ready to make an impact and grow with us, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 As a fullstack engineer, you are comfortable working across the whole stack, building intuitive user experiences as well as backend services and some dev\-ops. You will build state\-of\-the\-art solutions using modern LLMs and agentic technologies, applying them directly to real product challenges. You’ll take ownership from understanding the problem to deploying and refining features that create meaningful value for users.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to shape what we build. This includes rapid prototyping, exploring current LLM and agentic methods, and turning them into reliable, production\-ready systems, both in backend and frontend.
   

  

 We release early and iterate based on real usage. This role suits someone who enjoys combining strong engineering skills with modern AI methods and who wants to push the boundaries of what our software can do.
   

  

**You Will**
* Work across the tech stack together with your team mates. You are probably more passionate about either frontend or backend but comfortable working in both.
* Deeply understand our users and the challenges of navigating complex procurement data.
* Design, build, and refine AI systems, from prompt\-driven models to multi\-step agent flows.
* Own features end to end: discovery, modeling, evaluation, deployment, and iteration.
* Integrate AI outputs into product features that users trust and rely on.
* Collaborate with product and design to explore what AI should accomplish for procurement teams.
* Balance rapid experimentation with building scalable, maintainable AI systems.


**What You'll Bring**
* A product mindset and the ability to choose the right approach by understanding the problem first.
* Strong engineering fundamentals, with the ability to work effortlessly across the stack.
* Experience or very eager to learn how to design agentic workflows, retrieval\-augmented systems, or evaluation pipelines.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and the ability to turn fuzzy problems into clear, workable solutions.
* Based in Stockholm, within commuting distance from our office in central Stockholm.
* Fluent in English.


**Our Tech Stack**
* TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python GraphQL
* PostgreSQL, Opensearch, Athena
* AWS
* Microservice Architecture: Fargate, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, GraphQL, OpenAPI
* AI Tooling: Claude Code, Internal MCP Server


 How we Work
   

  

 We’re agile but not dogmatic. We ship minimum viable products, iterate based on real feedback, and aim for quality without overengineering. Great ideas come from anywhere, and you’ll influence not just what we build, but how we work.
   

  

**Culture at Tendium**
 We move fast, stay curious, and take ownership. We’re a tight\-knit team with a shared drive to fix how public procurement works, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and learning. You’ll have real responsibility from day one, supported by teammates who challenge you, help you grow, and want to build something meaningful together.
   

  

 We’re Stockholm\-based with a hybrid setup, and we make time to connect through regular afterworks, team activities, and the kind of informal conversations that make work feel human.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude. Different perspectives make the product better, and we’re building a team that reflects that.
   

  

 If you want to build products that actually matter to the people who use them, let’s talk.
   

  

 Application
   

  

**We will be on vacations in July and will get back to you in August.** 
 We look forward to your application.
   

  

 Please note:
 **At the moment we are not able to sponsor VISA applications, so you need to have the right to work in Sweden.**
 To make this process even more efficient, feel free to sign in to your Connect profile and add your references at any stage.
   

  

 Please find additional information on our recruitment process
 *here.*
 If you want to know more about our culture and what you can expect when working at Tendium you can read more about it
 *here.*
**Equality and inclusion statement**
 At Tendium, we don’t just value diversity, we celebrate it. We’re building a workplace where everyone should feel that they belong, where your voice is heard, and your experiences are respected. Different perspectives fuel our creativity and drive innovation, and we’re always looking for people who can bring something new to the team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s shape the future together.
   

  

 At Tendium we’re using data to transform public procurement, giving our clients better access to public tenders and helping governments to curb waste and enhance transparency.
   

  

 For more information contact career@tendium.com

title: Interim Supply Chain Business Analyst
description:
Du är personen som får varuflöden, processer och system att fungera tillsammans. Du har troligen en bakgrund inom Supply Chain, varuförsörjning, inköp, retail eller e\-handel, men har rört dig allt närmare system, kravställning och verksamhetsutveckling. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT, där du fångar upp behov, översätter dem till tydliga krav och säkerställer att lösningarna fungerar i praktiken. Nu söker vi en konsult till ett spännande interimsuppdrag hos en ledande retailaktör, med möjlighet att på sikt ta klivet in i en permanent roll som Supply Chain Development Manager.
 



  





**Uppdraget** 




 Rollen är placerad inom Supply Chain Management hos en av Sveriges ledande retailaktörer. Du blir en viktig länk mellan verksamheten och IT och får en central roll i utvecklingen av affärskritiska system och processer kopplade till Supply Chain, Commerce och produktdata.
 



  





 Uppdraget uppstår i samband med en omorganisation och medan företaget rekryterar sin framtida Supply Chain Development Manager. Det innebär att uppdraget initialt löper från augusti till slutet av februari, men för rätt person finns möjlighet att även vara aktuell för den permanenta rollen framåt.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




 Uppdraget handlar om att förstå verksamheten och översätta den förståelsen till tydliga krav, smarta lösningar och lyckade implementationer.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:
 


* Kravinsamling tillsammans med verksamheten
* Kravställning mot interna och externa utvecklingsteam
* Testplanering, test och kvalitetssäkring
* Processutveckling och förbättringsarbete
* Analys av affärsprocesser och systemflöden

title: Data Analyst
description:
*Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact – and your part matters.*
 Your role
   

  

 Operational Development within Procurement, SAAB Surveillance, is in a strong transformation phase where data, analytics, and digital tools are key enablers to improve efficiency, quality, and performance across procurement operations. We are now looking for a Data Analyst, who will be part of the Operational Development team supporting Procurement in Surveillance.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with procurement operations, strategic buyers, and operational procurement teams, as well as cross\-functional stakeholders, to transform data into actionable insights that drive operational improvements, process efficiency, and better decision\-making. You will collect, structure, analyze, and interpret data from ERP and procurement\-related systems to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, trends, and improvement opportunities across procurement processes, supplier interactions, and operational workflows. You will also develop and maintain analytical solutions using SQL and BI tools such as QlikSense or similar platforms, enabling transparency and supporting fact\-based decision\-making. The role combines hands\-on analytics with strong collaboration in a highly operational environment. You will be part of a team where collaboration, curiosity, and delivery focus are central. We value openness, continuous learning, and a strong delivery mindset, where everyone contributes to driving real operational change.
   

  

 This position can be based in Solna or Gothenburg.
   

  

 Main responsibilities:
   

  

* Drive data\-driven operational improvement initiatives within Procurement Operations, SAAB Surveillance
* Analyze operational procurement data to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, trends, and improvement opportunities
* Work closely with procurement operations teams to understand processes, performance, and daily challenges
* Support operational development initiatives through data analysis and insight generation
* Build dashboards and reporting solutions using QlikSense or similar BI tools
* Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, primarily from ERP systems
* Develop KPIs and performance metrics to support operational excellence in procurement
* Communicate insights, findings, and recommendations to operational and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Contribute to digitalization, automation, and process improvement initiatives within procurement operations
* Continuously identify best practices and translate them into practical operational improvements


 Your profile
   

  

 We're looking for a structured, analytical, and hands\-on individual who thrives in an operational environment. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by improving how things actually work in practice, not only in theory. You have a strong "do\-it attitude" and enjoy solving real operational problems through data. With solid technical skills and strategic thinking, you're comfortable diving into complex challenges and translating them into clear, actionable insights. You take initiative without waiting for direction, and you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done. You work naturally close to the business, engaging with stakeholders across functions and turning technical knowledge into practical solutions. You're collaborative, communicative, and able to navigate a dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly. You enjoy change and actively contribute to improving processes, tools, and ways of working, combining your technical expertise with strategic perspective to drive real impact.
   

  

 Qualifications:
   

  

* Master of Science (MSc) in Industrial Engineering, Industrial Economics, Mechanical Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or similar
* Experience from manufacturing, industrial operations, procurement operations, or supply chain environments
* Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data analysis
* Experience with BI tools such as QlikSense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar
* Good understanding of operational procurement processes and supply chain workflows
* Experience working with ERP systems (preferably IFS)
* Ability to handle, structure, and analyze large and complex datasets
* Strong communication skills in both English and Swedish
* Several years of relevant experience within manufacturing, procurement, or supply chain is required


 Meriting experience:
   

  

* Experience with operational excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies
* Experience with process automation tools
* Experience with AI tools and business adoption in industrial settings
* Data modeling or advanced analytics experience in operational contexts


 This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
   

  

 What you will be part of
   

  

 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
   

  

 Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: AI Data engineer
description:
At Etteplan, we help our customers transform data into insights, innovation, and business value. As AI continues to reshape industries, the importance of high\-quality data, scalable platforms, and reliable architectures has never been greater. To strengthen our Platform \& Software Solutions teams, we are now looking for AI Data Engineers who want to play a key role in building the data foundations that power tomorrow's digital solutions.
   

  

 You'll work closely with customers across industries such as automotive, industrial technology, and advanced product development, helping them design and develop modern data platforms, integrations, and cloud\-based solutions. Together with colleagues within software engineering, cloud, and AI, you'll contribute to projects where reliable data is essential for creating smarter products, better services, and informed business decisions.
   

  

 At Etteplan, you'll become part of a collaborative and knowledge\-sharing culture where curiosity, technical excellence, and continuous learning are highly valued. We offer varied assignments, opportunities to develop your expertise, and the chance to work with technologies that are shaping the future.
   

  

**Your mission**
 As an AI Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and improving data foundations that support both business\-critical systems and AI\-driven solutions.
   

  

 Your responsibilities may include:
   

  

* Designing and maintaining scalable data models
* Building and maintaining ingestion pipelines, integrations, and data flows
* Establishing reliable data pipelines, data contracts, and quality controls
* Integrating external systems and data sources
* Improving data quality, traceability, and observability
* Contributing to backend and cloud infrastructure, including databases, monitoring, and scaling
* Collaborating with architects, developers, product teams, and customers
* Supporting engineering best practices, documentation, and CI/CD ways of working
* Supporting data governance and responsible AI initiatives where relevant


**Who are you?**
 Whether you are early in your career or an experienced specialist, you have a strong interest in data engineering and enjoy building reliable, scalable solutions that create value through data. You are curious about new technologies, keep up to date with developments within AI and data engineering, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues and customers to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 You are a person who enjoys taking initiative, sharing knowledge, and working collaboratively to create solutions that make a real difference for customers. Depending on your experience level, there will be opportunities to grow into technical leadership, architecture, and governance roles while continuing to develop your expertise within data and AI.
   

  

**To succeed in this role, we believe you have:**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Strong experience with SQL and relational data modelling
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines
* Experience working with APIs and integrations
* Experience from at least one cloud environment, preferably AWS
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts and a genuine interest in following state\-of\-the\-art developments in AI and data engineering
* Fluent communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken


**It is considered a plus if you also have experience with:**
* PostgreSQL
* Python
* Node.js / TypeScript
* Snowflake and the modern data stack
* Data governance, AI governance, or AI solution architecture
* Architectural ownership within data, backend, or platform engineering
* Implementing or working with the EU Data Act and EU AI Act
* Marketplace, multi\-stakeholder, startup, or other fast\-moving product environments


**What We Offer**
 At Etteplan, you'll have the opportunity to work with a wide range of customers and projects – from established industrial leaders to innovative technology companies. Our assignments span multiple industries, giving you the chance to broaden your experience, build deep technical expertise, and continuously challenge yourself in new environments.
   

  

 You'll be part of a collaborative team that combines expertise in software development, cloud, AI, and data engineering. Knowledge sharing is a natural part of our culture, and you'll have colleagues who are eager to support, challenge, and learn from each other.
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* Varied and technically challenging assignments across multiple industries
* The opportunity to work with modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and AI solutions
* A collaborative culture built on knowledge sharing and teamwork
* Continuous learning and professional development through projects, training, and experienced colleagues
* Opportunities to grow into architecture, technical leadership, or specialist roles
* Flexible ways of working that support a healthy work\-life balance
* Competitive benefits, including wellness allowance, occupational pension, and other local employee benefits


 At Etteplan, you are never limited to a single project, technology, or industry. Whether you want to deepen your expertise within data engineering, explore new technologies, or take on greater technical responsibility, you'll find opportunities to grow and shape your career with us.
   

  

**Application and Next Steps**
 You apply by uploading your CV and answering a few short questions related to the position. Selection and interviews are conducted continuously, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. The recruitment process begins with a phone interview and is followed by meetings with the responsible consulting manager and, if needed, additional colleagues. Our goal is to keep the process smooth so that together we can take the next step forward.
   

  

**Let's build the data foundations behind the next generation of AI\-powered solutions.**
*The summer period is here, and we have several open positions available during the holiday season. This typically means that we receive more applications than usual. As the selection process will take place during the first weeks of August, it may take a bit longer for us to get back to you regarding your status in the recruitment process.*
