 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Flera års erfarenhet av dataanalys, gärna inom CRM, marknad, medlemsorganisation eller liknande verksamhet
* Goda kunskaper i SQL
* Erfarenhet av Python, R eller motsvarande programmeringsspråk, alternativt ett stort intresse av att utvecklas vidare inom området
* Erfarenhet av prediktiva modeller, maskininlärning och AI\-driven analys
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av att bygga dashboards och rapporter i Power BI
* Erfarenhet av att formulera och testa hypoteser samt omsätta resultat till verksamhetsnytta


**Som person**
 Vi tror att du är en analytisk och nyfiken person som gillar att utforska data och hitta nya möjligheter. Du arbetar strukturerat och lösningsorienterat och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten. Du är kommunikativ och tycker om att göra komplex information enkel att förstå. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, engagerad och motiveras av att utveckla både arbetssätt och människor omkring dig.
   

  

**Övrig Information**
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering på Lindhagensgatan 126 i Stockholm.
* Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.
* Vi värdesätter det personliga mötet och arbetar gärna från kontoret. Samtidigt erbjuder vi möjlighet till hybridarbete, med hemarbete ett par dagar i veckan när verksamheten tillåter.


**Så här får vi kontakt**
 I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig konsult\- och rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn\-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: Data Scientist till Savings Performance
description:
**Har du en passion för att omvandla data till insikter som påverkar riktiga affärsbeslut? Vill du arbeta nära affären och bidra till att utveckla våra sparaprodukter och kundupplevelser genom datadriven analys?**
**Vi söker nu en Data Scientist till vårt Savings Performance\-team inom Investment Center. Här får du en central roll i att analysera och utveckla Sparaaffären genom att kombinera datamodellering, analys och tydlig kommunikation av insikter.**
 Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:
   

  

* Arbeta end\-to\-end med data – från behovsidentifiering och datainsamling till modellering, analys och visualisering.
* Analysera och följa upp Sparaaffären ur ett produkt\-, kund\- och organisationsperspektiv.
* Identifiera mönster i data och omsätta dessa till konkreta, affärsnära rekommendationer.
* Ta fram beslutsunderlag och presentera insikter till management och andra seniora stakeholders.
* Bidra till och vidareutveckla datamodeller som möjliggör bättre uppföljning och styrning av affären.
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla dashboards och applikationer i Power BI och Qlik som stödjer analys och beslutsfattande.
* Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med olika team för att driva datadrivna initiativ.


 I denna roll behöver du:
   

  

*Grundläggande krav:*
* 2–4 års erfarenhet av att arbeta som Data Scientist, analytiker eller liknande, med fokus på att ta fram insikter från data.
* Stark erfarenhet av SQL och att arbeta med större datamängder.
* Erfarenhet av Python eller motsvarande verktyg för dataanalys.
* Erfarenhet av datamodellering och visualisering i BI\-verktyg (t.ex. Power BI eller Qlik).
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med hela analysprocessen – från data till insikt och presentation.
* God förmåga att kommunicera komplexa samband på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt.
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* Bosatt i Sverige, med placering i Stockholm med omnejd.
* Relevant akademisk utbildning (t.ex. statistik, ekonomi, datavetenskap eller matematik.


*Meriterande kvalifikationer:*
* Erfarenhet från arbete inom bank eller finansiella tjänster.
* Kunskap om sparande, pension eller försäkring.
* Förmåga att dela kunskap och bidra till teamets kompetensutveckling.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta affärsnära och omsätta analys till konkreta rekommendationer.


 Hos oss kan du uppleva:
   

  

* Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
* Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.
* En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.
* En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.
* Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.


 "Bli en del av vårt team och...
   

  

 Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt dynamiska och ambitiösa analysteam. Tillsammans hjälper vi Swedbank att bli mer datadrivna och stärker vår position inom Sparaområdet.''
 **Elias Jakobson, din framtida chef.**
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026\-08\-31\.
   

  

**Placeringsort:** 
 Sundbyberg
   

  

**Rekryterande chef:** 
 Elias Jakobson
   

  

 Vänligen observera att rekryteringsarbetet kan ta lite längre tid än normalt då det är sommarsemester.
   

  

 Vi vill göra dig uppmärksam på att bakgrundskontroll och drogtest kan komma att genomföras för denna roll om du går vidare i processen.
   

  

*Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster.*
**Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning \- alla är välkomna.**

title: Data Analyst, Controlling
description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team in Packaging Solutions’ BU Northern Europe Controlling team. This role is part of our ambition to build a modern, AI\-enabled analytics capability where data analysts act as proactive partners in business decision\-making.
   

  

 Hybrid role, with location in Jönköping, Stockholm, Lahti, Helsinki, or Riga.
   

  

**Your role**
 As a Data Analyst, you focus on turning data into profitability\-improving actions. You work closely with controllers and business stakeholders to analyze performance, identify improvement opportunities, and support decisions related to pricing, cost optimization, and resource allocation.
   

  

 This is not a back\-office reporting role. You are expected to actively engage with stakeholders, ask the right questions, and continuously improve how data and analysis are used to support profitable business outcomes.
   

  

 The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Controlling, BU Northern Europe, Packaging Solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyst is expected to design structured datasets and models together with IT, not just use them
* Analyze financial and business data to identify trends, drivers, and deviations
* Explore and apply AI and advanced analytics tools to improve efficiency, quality, and insight
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and “single source of truth” across reports and forward looking analyses
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve reports and dashboards for decision\-making
* Combine and structure data from multiple systems and sources
* Collaborate closely with controllers and business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into meaningful analysis
* Support controllers with deeper analysis, scenario modelling, and ad hoc business questions
* Communicate insights clearly and confidently to non\-financial stakeholders
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring analyses and reporting


**What You Bring**
* Relevant academic background (e.g. finance, economics, data, engineering, or similar)
* Initial experience and/or strong interest in data analysis, reporting, or finance, with practical experience or curiosity towards modern AI tools
* Experience with BI tools (e.g. Power BI), Excel, and data handling
* Competence in AI\-assisted analytics and vibe coding, enabling fast experimentation, insight generation, and data tool development, with a strong foundation in SQL and Python
* Ability to interact confidently with controllers and business stakeholders, and explain data\-driven insights in a clear and structured way
* Capability and proof of use\-cases with AI, automation, and new analytical tools
* Analytical mindset with a willingness to challenge numbers and ask “why”
* Structured, proactive, and collaborative way of working
* Fluency in English


**What We Offer**
 You will be part of our diverse working culture which supports you in exploring new perspectives and developing professionally. You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that anything made from fossil\-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow. Sustainability and innovation are at the core of our strategy. To keep you going safely, we support your physical and mental wellbeing.
   

  

**How can you apply for this role?**
 You can only submit your application via our recruitment tool. We hope to hear from you as soon as possible, but no later than
 **17 of August, 2026** 
 and please send your application in English. Depending on the role, we might invite you to a video interview and/or aptitude tests.
   

  

 If you have questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager Sami Muhonen, sami.muhonen@storaenso.com and questions about the recruitment process can be directed to our Talent Acquisition Partner Veera Kaislasalo at veera.kaislasalo@storaenso.com.
   

  

 As it’s the holiday season, our process may be a bit slower than usual. We’ll make sure to get back to you with your questions by August at the latest.
   

  

**Welcome to the The renewable materials company!**
 Stora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus on packaging. Our purpose is to replace non\-renewable materials with renewable solutions. Together with our customers, we design and deliver competitive, high\-quality packaging materials and solutions, made from fresh and recycled fibers, accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and our sales in 2025 were EUR 9\.3 billion.
   

  

 We believe that diversity strengthens our competitiveness and leads to better decision‑making. Diverse teams with different backgrounds help us explore new perspectives and challenge our ways of thinking. We actively work to increase diversity in the workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Stora Enso is an equal opportunity employer that follows non‑discriminatory practices.
   

  

 Learn more about working in Stora Enso: Working at Stora Enso – Career for a better climate. Every day. \- YouTube

title: Senior Data Analyst - DRM & Music
description:
**Join our global force of 400\+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking** 
 —
 **from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We're an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Come create with us, and let the world feel your work.**
 As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join an embedded, AI\-native analytics team that sits inside the commercial and product domains driving our growth. You'll work closely with DRM and Music leadership — and the product team — as we grow our Music \& DRM business. On the DRM side, you'll validate the metrics that matter, build business cases that motivate product investment, and back our position in platform negotiations. On the Music side, you'll help leadership make better decisions faster: shaping how we think about capex and acquisition tradeoffs, making our biggest financial decisions more data\-driven, and building a clear picture of how music moves across our platform and out into the world. You'll have a dedicated mandate spanning both DRM and Music while drawing on the shared infrastructure, engineering support, and peers of our central Data \& Analytics team.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Be a trusted thought partner to Music and DRM leadership. Bring structured thinking to high\-stakes questions, sanity\-check what we measure, and proactively raise the questions stakeholders haven't thought to ask.
* Build the business cases that move decisions forward. Turn platform data into the commercial case for what we should build next, and put hard numbers behind contract terms, rate changes, and revenue\-share positions where the stakes are real money.
* See around corners. Bring data\-driven insights around our music investments, and build a deep understanding of how different customer segments use our music — so we can anticipate where demand is heading before it shows up in the numbers.
* Connect what happens on our platform with how music performs in the world. Run deep\-dives that combine internal and external data to explain why a metric moved, where value is being left on the table, and where the growth opportunities are.
* Make our data trustworthy for agentic analytics — enrich context and metadata, and use AI coding tools to ship instrumentation and data\-quality fixes directly so both people and AI tools can rely on it.
* Uphold analytical rigour as self\-serve expands. Push back on false precision in revenue and accrual estimates, set the bar for what good analysis looks like, and resist unnecessary complexity where a simpler approach serves the decision better.


 What you'll bring
   

  

* Senior\-level influence. You've driven real business impact by shaping decisions at the leadership level and moving revenue outcomes.
* High agency. Habit of driving decisions through tailored communication and data storytelling.
* Sharp analytical instincts. You scope vague questions with vetted frameworks, state hypotheses up front, and reason to a defensible answer even with imperfect data.
* Sound judgement about data. A solid grasp of statistics and the discernment to know when past data predicts the future and when to override it for where the business is heading.
* Technical versatility. Proficiency across SQL and Python (notebooks in Hex), dbt (on BigQuery), plus experience with AI coding tools and techniques including context engineering and evals.
* Platform curiosity. You don't need prior rights\-management experience, but you're genuinely curious to learn how the music platforms actually work, and how that connects to our business.


 Music to our ears
   

  

* Experience combining data across platforms — e.g. joining first\-party product data with external platform data — to explain shifts in user behaviour.
* Data modelling know\-how and experience with semantic layers.
* A track record of validating and refining metrics in a data\-mature environment, and of building business cases that turned into real product investment.


 What we'll offer
   

  

* A fast\-paced environment with real room for personal growth and tangible impact on the business.
* The chance to help write the new playbook for running Analytics in the AI era, combining timeless principles with fresh learnings from emerging tooling.
* A diverse, collaborative team of Analysts and Engineers building together.


 Equal opportunity employer
   

  

 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
   

  

 Application
   

  

 Ready to make the world feel your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Senior Data Scientist – Forecasting, Solna
description:
Forecasting sits at the heart of how PostNord runs \- every volume we plan for, every route we optimize, every shift we staff starts with a forecast. We're now strengthening our Forecasting team and looking for a Senior Data Scientist to be a central pillar in building something stronger.
   

  

 This is a senior individual\-contributor role. The team already has a Tech Lead and a Product Owner, so you won't be carrying out the roadmap or line management. Instead, your seniority shows up in the quality of your models, the judgement behind your decisions, and your ability to lift the people around you.
   

  

**Join us**
 The Technology Acceleration area within Group IT is responsible for establishing the future IT landscape \- the foundation for PostNord's continued AI\- and data\-driven journey. In the Forecasting team you'll combine deep machine learning craft with real business understanding to deliver forecasts that operations actually trust and act on, across the logistics domain.
   

  

 You won't just build models. You'll help decide where forecasting creates the most value, what's worth improving, and what's better rebuilt from scratch.
   

  

**Job Duties**
* Develop, improve, and maintain forecasting models for core logistics use cases \- volumes, routes, staffing, and beyond.
* Evaluate what we already run and make pragmatic calls: optimize, replace, or redesign from the ground up.
* Get close to the operation \- translate messy operational reality and business challenges into robust, scalable forecasting solutions.
* Ensure that the forecast holds up in production: data quality, feature engineering, and reconciling planning horizons and cadences.
* Collaborate with data engineers, domain teams, and the wider analytics community on our Databricks platform.
* Raise the bar around you \- share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and help establish forecasting and model\-lifecycle best practices.
* Communicate insight, trade\-offs, and uncertainty clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Extensive experience as a Data Scientist with a strong focus on machine learning and forecasting, and a track record of models running in production.
* Strong grounding in time\-series modelling, statistical methods, and modern ML approaches.
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
* Experience with modern data platforms \- Databricks is highly relevant.
* A genuine ability to connect technical solutions to business impact, and the maturity to work hands\-on while helping shape technical direction alongside the Tech Lead and Product Owner.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.


**Meritorious Experience**
* Experience in logistics, supply chain, or other operational forecasting domains \- though we equally value strong forecasting craft brought in from any data\-heavy domain.
* Probabilistic forecasting, hierarchical forecasting, or optimization.
* MLOps practices and model lifecycle management.
* Scaling models in cloud environments, preferably Azure.
* Experimentation frameworks and model evaluation techniques.
* Mentoring or informally leading other data scientists.
* Comfort working in an engineering organization that leans heavily on AI tooling to move faster.


**Language requirement**
 Fluent English in speech and writing. Proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language is meritorious.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 Better forecasts mean better decisions \- fewer surprises in the network, smarter staffing, and capacity planned where it's needed. As a senior member of the team, you'll be a key reason our forecasting capability gets stronger, faster, and more trusted across the business.
   

  

**Your profile**
 You're a senior, mature data scientist who pairs technical excellence with a strong business mindset. You're pragmatic \- able to improve what exists and know when to start over. You're comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders, and you instinctively lift the people around you without needing a title to do it.
   

  

 Most of all, you want to help build something stronger: a high\-performing forecasting team that delivers real operational impact at scale.
   

  

**We offer**
* A cutting\-edge analytics environment built on Databricks and Azure
* A central role in accelerating PostNord's AI\- and data\-driven journey
* The freedom to shape how forecasting is done at scale in a leading logistics company


**Apply**
 Welcome with your application! We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis. Please note that due to the summer holiday period, the earliest feedback will be provided in mid\-August.

title: Strategisk Dataanalytiker till Svenska Röda Korset
description:
**Vill du använda data för att skapa verklig samhällsnytta?**
 På Svenska Röda Korset arbetar vi varje dag för att hjälpa människor före, under och efter kriser – i Sverige och världen. För att fatta bättre beslut, förstå människors engagemang och utveckla våra insatser behöver vi bli ännu mer datadrivna. Nu söker vi en Strategisk Dataanalytiker som vill ta en nyckelroll i att utveckla vårt analysarbete och omsätta data till insikter som stärker arbetet med givare, medlemmar och volontärer. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera avancerad analys med verksamhetsutveckling i en organisation där dina insikter bidrar till att göra verklig skillnad.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Hos Svenska Röda Korset blir du en del av en organisation med ett starkt humanitärt uppdrag och en tydlig ambition att utveckla våra arbetssätt genom data och digitalisering.
   

  

**Hos Oss Får Du Bland Annat**
* En strategisk nyckelroll där du får utveckla avdelningens analysförmåga
* Möjlighet att påverka hur data används för att stärka engagemang, insamling och verksamhetsutveckling
* Arbeta nära verksamheten, IT och digital utveckling i en organisation med stort samhällsfokus
* Vara med och utveckla analysstrategier, KPI:er och framtidens datadrivna arbetssätt
* Möjlighet att arbeta med AI, prediktiv analys och moderna analysmetoder
* En värderingsstyrd organisation där samarbete, utveckling och människors lika värde står i centrum


**Det här gör du hos oss**
**Det här gör du hos oss**
 Som Strategisk Dataanalytiker ansvarar du för att etablera och driva en sammanhållen analysstrategi kopplad till engagemang. Du säkerställer att avdelningen arbetar datadrivet genom relevanta KPI:er, prioriterade analyser och tydliga beslutsunderlag som stärker effekten av vårt arbete.
   

  

 Du fungerar som navet för analysarbetet och bidrar till att utveckla avdelningens analytiska mognad genom att omsätta data till konkreta rekommendationer och affärsnytta.
   

  

**I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att**
* Leda och samordna analysarbetet inom avdelningen Engagemang och Insamling
* Definiera, utveckla och följa upp KPI:er kopplade till engagemang
* Analysera beteenden och utveckling hos givare, medlemmar och volontärer
* Driva hypotesbaserade analyser för att identifiera utvecklingsmöjligheter
* Ta fram dashboards, rapporter och beslutsunderlag
* Visualisera och kommunicera analyser på ett pedagogiskt sätt
* Ge datadrivna rekommendationer kring målgrupper, aktiviteter och prioriteringar
* Bidra till utvecklingen av prediktiva modeller och AI\-baserade analysmetoder
* Säkerställa datakvalitet samt bidra till utvecklingen av datamodeller, nyckeltal och rapportering
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten, IT och Innovation för att utveckla organisationens analysförmåga


**Ditt team och arbetsplats**
 Du blir en del av avdelningen Engagemang och Insamling, inom enheten Stöd/Engagemangscentrum, och tillhör teamet DAP (Data, Analys \& Plattform).
   

  

 Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med stora delar av verksamheten, där du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor inom Engagemang och Insamling, IT samt Innovation och Digital utveckling. Du blir en viktig partner i arbetet med att utveckla avdelningens datadrivna arbetssätt.
   

  

**Mer om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för analys, data och verksamhetsutveckling och som motiveras av att omsätta komplex information till tydliga insikter som leder till bättre beslut.
   

  

 Du är analytisk, nyfiken och trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt i nära samarbete med verksamheten.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Relevant utbildning inom området eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Flera års erfarenhet av dataanalys, gärna inom CRM, marknad, medlemsorganisation eller liknande verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla analysstrategier och ta fram övergripande KPI:er
* God förståelse för datamodeller, datalager och ETL\-flöden
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta hypotesdrivet och omsätta analyser till konkreta rekommendationer


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av Python, R eller motsvarande programmeringsspråk, alternativt ett stort intresse av att utvecklas inom området
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram dashboards, rapporter och beslutsunderlag
* Goda kunskaper i SQL


**Övrig Information**
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering på Lindhagensgatan 126 i Stockholm.
* Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.
* Vi värdesätter det personliga mötet och arbetar gärna från kontoret. Samtidigt erbjuder vi möjlighet till hybridarbete, med hemarbete ett par dagar i veckan när verksamheten tillåter.


**Som person**
 Vi tror att du är en analytisk och nyfiken person som drivs av att skapa värde genom data. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och trivs med att ta ett helhetsansvar samtidigt som du uppskattar samarbete och kunskapsdelning.
   

  

 Du har lätt för att kommunicera komplex information på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt och bygger förtroende genom ett prestigelöst och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt.
   

  

**Så här får vi kontakt**
 I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig konsult\- och rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn\-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: Staff AI Product Analyst, Product Management | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000\+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600\+ team members across 40\+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity.
   

  

**This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Germany, Sweden or Spain.**
**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Staff Product Analyst** 
 to join our growing Product Analytics team and serve as a strategic partner to Grafana’s
 **AI organization** 
 . This role will support the teams building
 **Grafana Assistant** 
 , our synchronous chat experience;
 **Investigations** 
 , our asynchronous AI workflow for incident analysis; and
 **AI observability solutions** 
 , including
 **Sigil** 
 .
   

  

 You will shape how the AI team measures success by defining KPIs, improving measurement practices, guiding experiment design and evaluation, and translating data into recommendations that influence product decisions.
   

  

 This is a highly cross\-functional role. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data partners, with a primary focus on supporting the AI team, and report to the Product Analytics Manager
   

  

 If you’re excited about building strong product analytics capabilities and using data to shape the future of
 **AI\-powered experiences at Grafana** 
 , we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**You Will**
* Partner cross functionally across Product to establish top\-level KPIs, dashboards, and product roadmap planning
* Define how success is measured for AI\-powered product experiences, including adoption, engagement, quality, retention, and user outcomes
* Guide the instrumentation of product data in collaboration with our Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering teams to enable reliable analysis of AI features and workflows.
* Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments to assess the impact of new AI capabilities and inform product decisions.
* Develop dbt models to transform and test our user behavior data in partnership with our Analytics Engineering team
* Influence best practices for Product Analytics across teams and help define standards as the company scales
* Contribute to defining the long\-term vision and strategy for Product Analytics, balancing near\-term needs with scalable, durable solutions.


**You have**
* Experience partnering across product and engineering organizations, and familiarity with typical product KPIs and frameworks (e.g., DAU/MAU, funnels, A/B testing)
* Experience defining and tracking success metrics for complex product areas, ideally including AI\-powered features or workflows.
* SQL: writing complex yet efficient SQL is a daily habit for you
* Data Visualization: experience with any of the following tools: Tableau, Looker, Omni, Hex, or of course, Grafana!
* Experience writing dbt models, implementing Product Analytics tooling (e.g., Heap, Pendo, Amplitude, FullStory), and code version control (git)
* Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.
* Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical topics to non\-technical audiences, and maintain many of the essential cross\-team and cross\-functional relationships necessary for the team’s success


**A plus if you have**
* Knowledge about observability
* Familiarity with Airflow or Prefect \- generating ad hoc ETL jobs


 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 775,444 \- 930,533\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.
* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture \- As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates.
* Innovation\-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In\-Person onboarding \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**Join us to deliver a smoke\- free future as Senior Business Analyst for Commercial Operations!**
 We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future with one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke\-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.
   

  

 In the Nordic region, we are 1,600 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke\-free Nordics.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst to transform business needs into impactful data products and analytics solutions. In this role, you translate business needs into actionable analytics solutions, partnering closely with various stakeholders to deliver measurable impact.
   

  

**Your Day To Day**
* Translate business needs into analytics solutions by converting commercial questions into scalable analytics deliverables such as dashboards, reports, or predictive models.
* Analyse data and generate insights by connecting various data sources to measure the impact and performance of commercial initiatives against KPIs with recommendation of corrective actions.
* Drive data governance and compliance by ensuring data quality and alignment to governance standards.
* Be a standout team player and collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Commercial Operations, Channel owners, Data Scientists, etc) to understand business needs and ensure relevancy of solutions \& insights generated.


**What You Bring**
* Storytelling and the ability to understand the data to make informed business decisions and tell compelling data stories.
* Deep understanding of data, and how data drives decision making in resource allocation.
* Design of analytics solutions that enable data\-driven decisions across Commercial teams.
* Strategic mindset, with a demonstrable record of shaping business, marketing and commercial data analytics.


**Your Experience**
* Degree in Business Management / Data Engineering / Technology or Finance.
* Minimum of 2\-5 years of experience in Finance / Data Analytics (preferably in FMCG) with business modelling tools and analytics platforms.
* Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or PMI\-PBA (PMI Professional in Business Analysis) are a plus.


 To be successful in this role, you should be adept at building and maintaining business models to support diverse scenarios, with strong analytical skills to investigate issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend improvements. Familiarity with LeanIX and proficiency in BI tools would be an advantage, along with experience in data visualization and solving complex business challenges. You’ll need to demonstrate curiosity, problem\-solving capabilities and collaborate confidently across multi\-functional teams and stakeholders.
   

  

 Please note that relocation support is not available for this role.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:
   

  

* Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.
* Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.
* Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working \- split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.
* Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.
* Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke\-free future.


 \#SWMA
   

  

**30047**

title: Senior Data Scientist - Scania Asset Management
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck \& Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Ventures and New Business at Scania have a key role in contributing to this vision. We drive the industry transformation: At Ventures and New Business we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

 Scania is looking for a
 **Senior Data Scientist** 
 to help shape how we understand, value, price, and manage electric vehicle assets over time.
   

  

 This role is for someone who wants to own complex analytical problems, not only build models. You will work with imperfect operational data, commercial tradeoffs, and decisions that matter: residual value, pricing, lifecycle planning, asset risk, and long\-term value creation.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 You will join a small team with broad responsibilities and close contact with business, finance, product, engineering, and data colleagues. Your work will connect data science with real asset decisions, from assumptions and analysis to model services and recommendations that others can rely on.
   

  

 Prior experience with electric vehicles, batteries, finance, fintech, pricing, risk, or asset valuation is valuable, but not required. We are looking primarily for seniority in judgement, ownership, and the ability to create clarity in complex problem areas.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop models for battery\-electric vehicle usage, remaining useful life, residual value, pricing, lifecycle forecasting, and portfolio risk.
* Turn data such as mileage, energy usage, battery health, charging behavior, and asset value into clear decision support.
* Define, test, and document assumptions around lifetime, degradation, refurbishment, second\-life value, pricing, and risk exposure.
* Improve, maintain, and operate deployed models and decision\-support services used in real business decisions, including APIs, scheduled jobs, tests, monitoring, and versioning.
* Communicate technical and financial reasoning clearly across technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Who You Are**
 You likely have:
   

  

  

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience working across modelling, analysis, data quality, and production\-quality code.
* Experience building models that support business decisions, for example in pricing, risk, forecasting, asset valuation, lifecycle economics, finance, fintech, or portfolio analytics.
* Cloud experience, including deploying or operating data products, APIs, scheduled jobs, model services, or similar workloads.
* Demonstrated ownership from unclear business problem to model, data pipeline, deployment, adoption, and maintenance.
* Strong self\-leadership: you structure ambiguous work, make sound tradeoffs, challenge weak assumptions, and help raise the quality around you.
* A Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, economics, or a related discipline.


**This Is Us**
 Everyone working at Scania is united by a common purpose: Driving the shift towards a sustainable transport system. We know that the transport industry must change, and it’s a change we want to lead. At Ventures and New business, we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments that can accelerate us in driving the shift.People are core to our business. By joining our journey towards a sustainable transport system, you are contributing to the future of transport. You are part of a team that can create real change. At Ventures and New Business, we want to engage and inspire our full organization to create results together with us. Collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit is part of our culture and what makes us successful. By joining us you will be a part of driving meaningful growth in new ways!
   

  

**Scania Offers**
 We offer you the chance to be part of an organization that is focused on reaching Scania’s targets and to truly drive the industry transformation. People who work here have the motivation and desire to constantly make things better.
   

  

 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026\-08\-31\. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
   

  

 Aleksandra Kulpa, Talent Acquisition Specialist, aleksandra.x.kulpa@scania.com

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**What will you do?** 




 As a Machine Learning Engineer at Rebtel you will define how AI is done at Rebtel. What tooling we standardise on, how we evaluate models we put in front of real users, what "good" looks like for our prompts and our pipelines. AI is going from a side project to the core of how Rebtel operates and what we ship to our users. We're hiring the second engineer on our ML/AI subteam to help build it classical ML for the business, LLM\-powered systems for the product, and a clear production mindset on both.
 



  





 You'll sit inside the Data team, report to our Head of Data, and partner with one other ML/AI engineer to shape this capability from the ground up.
 



  





**Areas Of Ownership** 




 You'll own work across two complementary tracks, and you'll ship in both.
 



  





 Classical ML, in production, for operational leverage
 


* Risk and fraud models across payments, top\-ups, and account behaviour
* Churn prediction and retention modelling on a user base of a million\-plus
* Forecasting, pricing, segmentation, and the next batch of operational problems we haven't tackled yet
* Owning models end\-to\-end scoping with stakeholders, building, deploying, monitoring, retraining



  





 LLMs and AI agents, from internal automation to in\-product features
 


* Start with our customer support agents and automations: RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, tool\-use, evaluation harnesses
* Move LLM capability into the product as user\-facing features
* Help guide the company on where AI actually creates leverage, what to build, what to buy, what to ignore and turn the good ideas into shipped systems



**Requirements** 



* You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office
* 4\+ years of hands\-on ML engineering in Python, with real production ownership not just notebooks
* Strong fundamentals in classical ML: feature engineering, model selection, validation, and the unglamorous parts of keeping a model healthy in prod
* A genuine production mindset: monitoring, retraining, eval harnesses, CI/CD for models, and the instinct to debug when something drifts at 2am
* Comfort working the whole loop: stakeholder scoping → data → model → deployment → measurement → iteration
* Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to translate between business problems and ML ones
* Hands\-on experience with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalents
* Built RAG systems, agentic workflows, or LLM\-backed products that real users (or real internal teams) actually used
* Comfortable with vector databases, embeddings, prompt evaluation, and measuring LLM systems with something more rigorous than vibes
* Obsession with staying up\-to\-date on developments in the AI space
* Experience with a major cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure), containers, and a modern data stack
* Experience in MLOps tooling: MLflow, Airflow, Kubernetes and feature stores is a plus
* Background in fintech, payments, telecom, or other regulated / operational domains is a plus



  





**Why Rebtel?** 




 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
 



 This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow\-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
 



  





**Benefits** 




 At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well\-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:
 


* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.



*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom var och en av oss. Genom vår gemensamma passion för teknologi, AI\-drivna ansats, start\-up\-kultur och fokus på kontinuerligt lärande, ger vi dig förutsättningarna att nå din fulla potential och skapa värde för våra kunder. Med en stark drivkraft för kvalitet och agilitet stöttar vi dig genom hela din karriär så att du kan göra allt större avtryck och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som ML Engineer hos Sogeti blir du en del av vårt lokala team inom Data \& AI. I rollen arbetar du med att utveckla, produktionssätta och vidareutveckla AI\- och machine learning\-lösningar i moderna molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS.
   

  

 Du hjälper våra kunder att gå från idé, data och experiment till robusta lösningar som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Rollen kan omfatta allt från modellutveckling och MLOps till generativ AI, RAG\-lösningar, AI\-agenter och integration av AI\-funktionalitet i befintliga system.
   

  

*I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:*
* Utveckling, träning, utvärdering och optimering av machine learning\-modeller.
* Produktionssättning av AI\- och ML\-lösningar som API:er, batchflöden eller integrerade delar av kundens system.
* Arbete med MLOps, modellversionering, deployment, monitorering och retraining.
* Utveckling av data\- och feature pipelines tillsammans med Data Engineers.
* Användning av teknologier som Python, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, Docker, CI/CD och moderna molnplattformar.
* Utforskande av generativ AI, LLM:er, RAG, embeddings, vektordatabaser och AI\-agenter.


**Din profil**
* Flerårig erfarenhet av Python\-programmering och machine learning.
* Erfarenhet av modellutveckling, modellutvärdering, feature engineering och produktionssättning av ML\- eller AI\-lösningar.
* God förståelse för MLOps och modellens livscykel från träning till produktion.
* Erfarenhet av Git, CI/CD, Docker, SQL och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
* Erfarenhet av molnbaserade AI\-, ML\- eller datalösningar i Azure och/eller AWS.
* Förmåga att samarbeta med Data Scientists, Data Engineers, utvecklare, arkitekter och verksamhet.
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift samt god professionell kunskap i engelska.


**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas** 
 .
   

  

* En kultur som präglas av närhet, samarbete och ett genuint kunskapsutbyte mellan kollegor
* Möjlighet att utvecklas inom data, AI och moderna dataplattformar – i uppdrag och genom tillgång till både lokala och globala kompetensnätverk
* Ett team där du får arbeta nära andra specialister inom data, analys och AI, i uppdrag som gör verklig skillnad för kund och samhälle


**Ansökan**
*Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID\-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov. Just nu har vi semesterperiod och hoppas att även du njuter av en fin sommar. Vi ser framemot att läsa igenom din ansökan när vi är tillbaka från semester och förväntar oss att kunna återkoppla dig i augusti när vi är åter! Stort tack för ditt tålamod!*
**Om Sogeti**
 Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Vi är specialiserade på AI\-drivna lösningar inom quality engineering \& testing, data och cloud och förvandlar snabbt idéer till handling. Sogeti levererar konkreta resultat, hjälper organisationer att innovera med självförtroende och skapar värde från dag ett. Vi är agila, snabbrörliga och drar nytta av starka partnerskap. Våra lokala team arbetar sida vid sida med våra kunder och bygger nära relationer genom att förstå deras verklighet. Tillsammans med Capgemini\-koncernens globala styrka och branschexpertis skapar vi skalbara resultat.
   

  

***Right here. Right now.***
 \| www.sogeti.se

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!** 




  





 Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
 


* We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190\+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 450\+ employees from 45\+ nationalities



  





 We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
 



  





**The role:** 




 As a Senior ML Engineer, you will be working hands\-on to optimise the training and deployment of ML models to be quick and cost\-efficient. You will also be at the forefront of putting our ML models on mobile devices to enhance data privacy and customer experience. To achieve this, you will need to collaborate with teams across Truecaller to establish best practices and tools for efficient ML model development and deployment, particularly on mobile platforms. You will be expected to help Truecaller reach and remain at the cutting edge of ML training and deployment, and to explore new frontiers such as federated learning.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Understand the current and future needs of developers and the organisation, and create a roadmap with your manager for meeting those needs.
* Work with teams across Truecaller, enabling them to deploy models to production quickly and cost\-effectively.
* Work hands\-on with teams throughout Truecaller to optimise ML models for mobile devices.
* Be the go\-to expert for developing models for mobile devices as well as deploying them.
* Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in ML Engineering, especially ML on mobile phones, and driving continuous innovation throughout Truecaller.



  





**What you bring in** 



* Degree in computer science or equivalent
* 5\+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on deploying ML models in production environments.
* A strong understanding and experience to optimise feature engineering, model training, and model deployment.
* Hands\-on experience deploying ML models on mobile devices (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, ONNX Runtime Mobile).
* Strong understanding of machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX) and their deployment on mobile platforms.
* Understanding of both Android and iOS development and how that impacts ML model deployment and usage.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams and disciplines.
* A customer\-focused mindset.
* Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English.



 .
 



**What we offer:** 




 We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands\-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:
 








* **A comprehensive compensation package:** 
 We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top\-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
* **Modern tools to do your best work:** 
 Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
* **A people\-focused office culture:** 
 We value in\-person collaboration and follow an office\-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well\-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
* **Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination:** 
 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.



  





**Come as you are:** 




 Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.
 




  





 Check out Life at Truecaller \- Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/
 



  





**Sounds like a great opportunity?** 




  





 We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
 



  





**We only accept applications in English.**

title: AI Engineer till Sveaskog
description:
*Den här rekryteringen genomförs av Forefront Amplify på uppdrag av Sveaskog.* 




  





**Välkommen till en grön värld av möjligheter hos Sveaskog! Vi erbjuder dig skogen – en vacker arbetsplats och framför allt ett av våra viktigaste bidrag för att klara utmaningar kopplade till klimatförändringar och framtidens råvaruförsörjning. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med oss på vår digitala resa framåt.** 




  





**Vi erbjuder** 




 Att arbeta på Sveaskog innebär stor frihet samtidigt som du förväntas ta ansvar, visa mod och vara nyfiken. I allas uppdrag ingår att ta ansvar för sin egen och verksamhetens utveckling samt att vara teamorienterad och en bra kollega. Vi kallar det aktivt medarbetarskap. Vi erbjuder dig attraktiva förmåner och en arbetsplats som kännetecknas av en vilja att du ska lyckas, där jämställdhet och hållbart arbetsliv står högt på agendan. Sveaskog eftersträvar mångfald och en jämn könsfördelning inom alla yrken i företaget.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Sveaskog befinner sig på en spännande digitaliseringsresa och vi söker nu en AI Engineer som vill vara med och bygga upp Sveaskogs AI\-förmåga från grunden och skapa tekniska lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för verksamheten.
 



  





 Hos oss får du arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan modern AI\-utveckling, produktutveckling och verksamhetsnära innovation. Du blir en del av vår strategiska satsning på att etablera ett AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) och skapa fundamentet för framtidens AI\-drivna organisation.
 



 I rollen som AI Engineer kommer du att bidra till att AI blir en naturlig del av Sveaskogs utvecklingsförmåga och digitala transformation.
 



  





 Du arbetar både hands\-on i utvecklingen och som en drivande kraft i hur AI används, standardiseras och skalas inom organisationen.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Aktivt delta i programutveckling med AI\-engineering som kärnkompetens
* Driva AI\-driven utvecklarupplevelse (DevEx) genom att utforska, testa och sätta standarder för AI\-engineering i Sveaskogs produkt\- och plattformsteam
* Bygga och driftsätta AI\-lösningar, agenter, MCP\-servrar och automatiseringar som effektiviserar interna arbetsflöden
* Utveckla och förvalta Sveaskogs AI\-plattform i molnmiljö, inklusive teknisk grund för AI\-baserade funktioner i verksamhetens produkter
* Arbeta med LLM\-integrationer, prompt engineering och agentbaserade lösningar
* Bidra till utvecklingen av Sveaskogs ramverk för AI\-driven systemutveckling
* Samarbeta nära andra team för att sprida kunskap och driva användningen av AI i organisationen
* Vara en ambassadör för AI\-förflyttningen och bidra till att stärka organisationens AI\-mognad
* Säkerställa att utveckling sker enligt relevanta riktlinjer kring säkerhet, governance och compliance



  





 Rollen kombinerar strategi och genomförande – du förväntas både kunna sätta riktning och själv bidra operativt i utvecklingen.
 



  





 Stationering sker på ett lämpligt Sveaskogkontor med goda förutsättningar för resor inom Sverige.
 



  





**Om dig** 




 Vi söker dig som är både strategisk och hands\-on. Du trivs i miljöer där mycket är under uppbyggnad och där du får möjlighet att påverka riktning, arbetssätt och teknikval.
 



 Du fungerar som en naturlig brygga mellan verksamhet och teknik och känner dig bekväm i både strategiska diskussioner och operativt arbete. Som person är du nyfiken, prestigelös och har ett genuint intresse för att hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra.
 



  





 Vi ser gärna att du har:
 


* Akademisk examen inom IT eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Flerårig erfarenhet av systemutveckling med stark arkitektonisk förståelse
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av AI\-engineering och praktiskt arbete med moderna AI\-lösningar
* Erfarenhet av LLM\-integrationer, prompt engineering och agentutveckling
* Erfarenhet av molnplattformar, gärna Azure, och molnbaserad AI\-infrastruktur
* God förståelse för modern AI\-driven utveckling och DevOps\-principer
* Erfarenhet av agilt arbete, gärna inom SAFe
* Kunskap om eller intresse för AI\-agenter, context engineering och MCP\-servrar
* Förmåga att kommunicera komplex teknik på ett pedagogiskt sätt till icke\-tekniska kollegor
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift



  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
 


* AI governance och riskbedömning kopplat till AI och data
* Plattformstänk och utveckling av gemensamma AI\-komponenter
* Produktutveckling i större organisationer eller komplexa verksamhetsmiljöer



  





**Vill du växa med oss?** 




 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
 



  





 Fackliga kontaktpersoner är för Ledarna Thomas Esbjörnsson, tel 070\-5508235, för Akademikerföreningen Carl Abrahamsson, tel 072\-2037903 och för Unionen Johan Bergström 072\-2079619\.
 



  





 Vill du vara med och forma framtidens AI\-förmåga på Sveaskog? Välkommen med din ansökan!
 



  





**Om Sveaskog** 




 Sveaskog är Sveriges största skogsägare och ägs av svenska staten. Bolaget äger 14 procent av Sveriges skogsmarker och har cirka 800 medarbetare runt om i landet. Våra kontor finns från Tärendö i norr till Osby i söder.

title: Rapid Engineer – AI Engineer
description:
**Rapid Engineer – AI Engineer** 




**Location:** 
 Stockholm
 



  





**About Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** 




  





 With more than 600,000 employees globally, we work with leading companies across industries helping them achieve their business goals and lead their digital transformation. TCS ranks amongst global top 3 technology consulting companies across multiple parameters: revenues, employees, market valuation and brand value.
 



 In Sweden we work with more than 50 companies who are leaders in their own space. With them we have long term and trustful relationships. TCS in Sweden and Nordics has been ranked as a Top Employer for 12 consecutive years that reflects the organization’s commitment to an inclusive, empowered and entrepreneurial work culture.
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 Do you want to turn AI ideas into working, scalable solutions?
 



 We are looking for an AI Engineer who enjoys building, testing, and deploying intelligent systems in fast‑moving environments. In this role, you will work hands‑on with data, models, and platforms to deliver AI solutions that are production‑ready and demonstrable working closely with architects, customers, and rapid engineering teams.
 



 If you are passionate about engineering AI systems that actually work in real‑world settings, we invite you to join us.
 



  





**Your Role \& Impact**




  





 Are you an engineer who thrives on turning concepts into working AI solutions? Do you enjoy rapid experimentation, customer‑facing demos, and collaborating with architects and partners?
 



 As an AI / ML Engineer, you will focus on the engineering and implementation of AI/ML solutions. You will help design and build end‑to‑end AI components, develop models and pipelines, and bring architectures to life through rapid demos and proofs of value. Your work will directly influence solution quality, performance, and delivery speed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





 In this role, you will:
 


* Build and implement end‑to‑end AI/ML solutions, translating architectural designs into working systems
* Develop, train, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for real‑world use cases
* Support and participate in customer presentations and demos, explaining technical choices and outcomes
* Explore and apply new AI/ML solution paradigms from the market, including emerging tools and frameworks
* Collaborate with strategic partners to integrate platforms, APIs, and services into AI solutions
* Drive rapid demos and proofs of value together with the Rapid Engineering team.
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, code quality, and reproducibility of AI solutions



  





**What Makes You the Ideal Candidate**




  





 You combine solid software engineering skills with hands‑on experience in AI/ML. You enjoy learning new technologies and are comfortable working in environments where speed, quality, and collaboration matter.
 



 In addition, you bring:
 


* Experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions in practical environments
* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, data pipelines, and model lifecycle
* Hands‑on programming skills and the ability to work with modern AI frameworks including Vibe Coding tools.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with architects, engineers, and customers
* A proactive mindset with a focus on learning and continuous improvement
* Technology Stack:
 
 You do not need experience with all technologies listed below. A broad understanding of below technologies with deeper expertise in few areas will be ideal.
* Programming \& Frameworks: Python, ML libraries, deep learning frameworks
* AI / ML Platforms: Managed ML services, generative AI platforms, open‑source model ecosystems
* Data \& Pipelines: Feature engineering tools, data processing frameworks, batch and streaming pipelines
* MLOps: Model training, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and experimentation tooling
* RAG \& Agentic Components: Vector databases, embeddings, orchestration frameworks
* Cloud \& Runtime: Cloud‑native deployments, containers, scalable inference services
* DevOps \& Engineering: CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing
* Vibe Coding Platforms and Tools. E.g. Google AI Studio, Anti Gravity, etc.



  





**What We Offer**




  





 We offer you the opportunity to join an environment where excellence in AI engineering and continual innovation are valued and encouraged. You'll be part of small, specialized teams dedicated to pushing the boundaries of advanced AI technologies and solutions.
 



 As a member of our team, you will have the autonomy and support to establish yourself as a technical authority in AI.
 



 You will work with stateoftheart AI technologies and frameworks, gaining handson experience with the latest tools and methodologies in the field.
 



 We provide competitive compensation and highly attractive employment conditions designed to recognize your contributions and support your professional growth.
 



 You will enjoy flexible work arrangements, including the possibility to work from Stockholm or Amsterdam, and be part of a vibrant, international team that values diverse perspectives.
 



  





**Ready to Build and Ship AI?**




  





 If you are motivated to engineer AI solutions, experiment rapidly, and see your work used in real environments, we invite you to apply and grow with us.

**https://ibegin.tcs.com/iBegin/privacy\-notice**

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**What will you do?** 




 As a Senior Data Engineer at Rebtel, you will do more than build pipelines; you'll help shape the future of our data platform and influence how data is used across the company. At Rebtel, data sits at the heart of how we build products, understand customers, optimize growth, and make decisions.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll work across our modern data stack, build scalable data products, and help define the architecture that supports analytics, automation, and future AI initiatives.
 



 If you're excited by clean architecture, modern data engineering practices, and solving meaningful business problems at scale; if you care about data quality and believe trust in data is built through engineering discipline; if you enjoy solving complex problems and turning ambiguity into practical solutions; and if you're excited to experiment with new technologies and approaches, we'd love to talk.
 



  





**Areas Of Ownership** 



* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that power our Snowflake data platform
* Integrate data from a wide range of business and product systems
* Enable data activation across customer\-facing and operational platforms, including CRM, customer support, and marketing tools
* Develop robust monitoring, alerting, and observability practices to ensure platform reliability
* Troubleshoot, optimize, and continuously improve data workflows and platform performance
* Design and implement scalable ELT workflows using modern data engineering practices
* Build well\-structured dimensional models (facts and dimensions) that enable self\-service analytics and reporting
* Implement automated testing and quality controls throughout the data lifecycle
* Ensure data is accurate, accessible, and trusted across the organization
* Work closely with analysts, product managers, engineers, marketers, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver impactful solutions
* Help translate complex business challenges into scalable data products and datasets
* Support decision\-making by making data easier to discover, understand, and use
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices
* Run proof\-of\-concepts and contribute to strategic technology decisions
* Help define the future architecture of Rebtel's data platform
* Continuously improve engineering standards, tooling, and developer experience



  





**Requirements** 



* You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office
* 3\+ years of experience in Data Engineering or a similar role
* Strong SQL skills and experience building production\-grade data pipelines
* Experience with modern ELT methodologies and data warehousing concepts
* Experience integrating data from multiple systems and sources
* Experience with dbt, Python, AWS, or similar cloud\-based data platforms
* Strong understanding of data modeling and analytics engineering best practices
* Ability to operate independently and take ownership of technical solutions
* Experience working in fast\-growing technology or digital product companies is a plus
* It's a bonus if you've been exposured to customer analytics, marketing analytics, experimentation, or machine learning workflows
* Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI is a plus
* It's a plus with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field



  





**Why Rebtel?** 




 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
 



 This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow\-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
 



  





**Benefits** 




 At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well\-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:
 


* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.



  





*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Head of Data Engineering and Architecture
description:
**Join our team** 
 and help build production\-grade AI and data solutions at global scale. We’re a fast\-moving AI \& Data hub focused on real impact — driving innovation, enabling the business, and solving meaningful challenges together.
   

  

 Play a key role in our global data transformation by shaping modern data engineering and architecture — building the foundations for AI, analytics, and scalable business value.
   

  

**Your mission**
 We are looking for a hands\-on data engineering leader who sets direction and architectural standards while actively contributing in code. You will play a central role in our data transformation by building secure, production\-ready data pipelines and products that enable analytics and AI at scale. This is not just an administrative role. You lead by example in engineering, design, and delivery.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Lead a global team of data engineers and architects.
* Design and deliver scalable, governed data products and pipelines.
* Define and enforce engineering best practices (Git, CI/CD, testing, deployment).
* Provide architectural oversight to ensure secure, robust, future\-proof solutions.
* Collaborate across functions to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Balance strategic direction with hands\-on technical depth.


**Leadership expectations**
 At Epiroc, we expect our leaders to be inspirers, accelerators, and new thinkers who lead by example and have the courage to challenge the status quo. Safety and sustainability are our top priorities, and we expect our leaders to actively promote safety, inclusion, and diversity, while also prioritizing the well\-being and continuous development of our employees. We are looking for you who have the courage to believe in new ideas and see opportunities where others see challenges.
   

  

**Other Requirements**
* 5\+ years in data engineering and architecture with recent hands\-on coding (Python preferred).
* Experience delivering data products in distributed or multinational environments.
* Experience applying data mesh principles in practice.
* Strong communication skills and business\-technical translation ability.
* Databricks experience is a plus


**Why Epiroc**
 Join a global industrial leader driving innovation in mining and infrastructure. You will contribute directly to enabling data and AI capabilities that support safer, more efficient, and sustainable operations worldwide.
   

  

 We offer competitive total rewards, global career opportunities, learning programs, bonus scheme, flexible work culture, and strong parental leave policies.
   

  

**Location and travel**
 The role can be based in Epiroc offices in Czech Republic, Serbia or Poland. Occasional travel required.
   

  

**Application and contact information**
 Applications are reviewed continuously. Apply via our recruitment system no later than 31/07/2026\.
   

  

 We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.
   

  

 For questions about the recruitment process, please contact:
   

  

 Recruitment Specialist Zuzana Kalivodova, zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com
   

  

**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
   

  

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com
