title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest\-growing fintech companies \- bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders \- thanks to the 500\+ amazing people who work here.**
 We’re hiring a senior individual contributor in AI engineering to take end‑to‑end ownership of our GenAI/LLM architecture and help us scale AI across Sambla Group.
   

  

 You’ll sit at the intersection of Product \& Tech and Data Science, working closely with our AI PM, DS/ML, MLOps, security and backend teams. Your focus is to turn AI ideas into robust, safe and cost‑efficient products – and to put in place the patterns, tooling and guardrails that let other teams do the same.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

**Own our GenAI / LLM foundations**
 You design and evolve the architecture for LLM‑based products (chatbots, copilots, automation, retrieval) on AWS, integrating into our Python/TypeScript backend landscape. You define patterns for RAG, prompts, agents and evaluation that other teams can reuse.
   

  

**Make AI safe, reliable and cost‑efficient**
 You work with Security and Legal on data privacy, access control and provider/model choices. You build protections against prompt injection and unsafe outputs, integrate AI services with our monitoring/alerting, and optimise prompts, caching and model selection to balance quality, latency and cost.
   

  

**Build and evolve the internal AI platform**
 You create and maintain SDKs, libraries, templates and reference services so Data Science and product teams can ship GenAI features faster and more consistently. Together with MLOps you align ML and LLM pipelines instead of letting them drift apart.
   

  

**Ship and own key AI features**
 Together with data science, product \& tech you take end‑to‑end technical ownership of a few high‑impact AI initiatives (for example an in‑app chatbot or internal copilots) – from spike and design to implementation, rollout and continuous improvement. You turn ideas into clear technical plans and de‑risk new approaches through prototypes.
   

  

**Guide our AI roadmap**
 You advise CCDO, AI Adoption Lead, AI PM and tech leadership on AI/LLM roadmap, capability gaps and investment priorities. You bring in best practices from more AI‑mature organisations and mentor DS, MLOps and engineers on GenAI engineering patterns and system design.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

**We Believe You Have**
* 7\+ years in software and/or ML engineering, including at least 2–3 years working with LLM/GenAI systems in production.
* Proven track record of shipping AI/ML/LLM‑powered features to end users and operating them in production (monitoring, debugging, iterating).


**With Technical Skills Such As**
* Strong backend engineering skills in TypeScript and/or Python.
* Comfortable with cloud‑native architecture on AWS (containers/serverless, networking, IAM, logging/monitoring), ideally including Bedrock.
* Deep practical experience with LLM ecosystems:
* Hosted and/or self‑hosted models.
* RAG pipelines, prompt patterns and guardrails.
* Evaluating and improving LLM outputs.
* Familiar with MLOps/LLMOps concepts and tooling: CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, monitoring (latency, error rates, quality metrics) and data pipelines.
* Strong system‑design skills for services/APIs, data flows and integrations in a microservice/product architecture.


**As Well As You Are**
* Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor: setting technical direction, influencing without line authority and mentoring others.
* Used to working closely with product managers, data scientists and engineers, and explaining complex trade‑offs in a clear, structured way.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience from an AI‑mature, product‑led company using AI/LLMs at scale.
* Exposure to data/knowledge‑management for LLMs (enterprise search, ingestion pipelines, knowledge graphs, ontology/tagging).
* Data science / ML background strong enough to discuss when to use classic ML vs LLMs vs rules.
* Experience with security and compliance for AI in regulated or semi‑regulated environments (e.g. financial services).
* Previous tech‑lead or staff‑level role in an AI/ML team (without formal people management).


 Our Operating Rythmn
   

  

**We might be a little different from most companies. Instead of defining personal values, we’ve built a shared way of working \- a rhythm that guides how we collaborate, support our customers, and move forward together.** 
**We call it Drive \& Jive \- a shared rhythm that creates momentum through direction, collaboration, and human connection.**
**Please note that our recruitment process will take a short summer break during July.** 
 We’ll start reviewing applications and scheduling interviews again in the first week of August – we’re really looking forward to hearing from you!
   

  

 Sambla Group is the new generation of brokers. Our ambition has always been the same \- to challenge the banks’ offers so that our customers, regardless of the conditions, should always have the same opportunity to obtain the best possible loan solution. Sambla Group has grown to over 500 employees, established itself in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark with offices in all markets.

title: Data Scientist
description:
You know that bit where every company says they’re
 *“changing the world”* 
 ? Yeah, it can feel a little forced. But we like to think our story actually has some realness to it.
 



  





 Our story begins with
 **Shadi Bitar** 
 and
 **Ninos Malki** 
 , who came to Sweden from Syria as kids and discovered that books could be a bridge \- helping them learn the language, understand the culture, and explore new worlds.
 



  





 A thought emerged,
 *what if everyone could have that?* 
 And just like that, Nextory was born \- your all\-access pass to read, listen, and discover new perspectives without limits. And now, we're on a quest to find a
 **Data Scientist.** 




  





**Let us tell you about the role 📖** 




 As a Data Scientist at Nextory, you will be part of our centralized data team, supporting our Business value stream with an analytical mindset and tech\-savvy approach to drive sustainable subscriber growth. You will work closely with stakeholders across Business, Marketing, and Product to create data\-driven insights and models that improve decision\-making and business performance.
 



  





 Some examples of what you might be spending your time on:
 


* Owning projections and forecasts related to activations and new paying subscribers
* Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc business analysis with actionable insights
* Building and improving Nextory’s central data capabilities and ways of working
* Supporting the Performance Marketing team with MMM, attribution models, and other analytical frameworks to improve marketing efficiency
* Drive data\-informed growth by analyzing user behavior, optimizing funnels, and running A/B tests to improve acquisition and conversion.
* Build dashboards, reporting tools, and measurement frameworks in collaboration with Product and Business to provide clear performance insights and support Nextory’s growth strategy.



  





**The main character we’re looking for 👀** 




 We believe that you are currently working in a similar role at a fast\-moving, product\-focused company. You enjoy solving complex business challenges through data and are confident working with multiple stakeholders and know how to balance business needs with analytical rigor.
 



  





 Furthermore, we believe you have:
 


* Several years of experience working as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst
* Strong knowledge of SQL and Python
* Experience working with performance marketing, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or related analytical methods
* Good understanding of digital marketing channels such as Google Ads, Meta, SEO, and online customer acquisition
* Experience building dashboards or working with BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, or similar)



  





**The Nextory way of working 🏠** 




 At Nextory, we believe a strong and inclusive culture is key to our success \- and that culture flourishes when we meet and collaborate in person as much as possible. That’s why we spend the majority of the working time at our beautiful office!
 



  





 We are based in Stockholm, Sweden, with offices in Paris and Bangalore. Our hybrid work policy includes four days in the office and Wednesdays as a work\-from\-home day.
 



  





**Your next story starts here 💫** 




 We look forward to your application. Applications are reviewed continuously, if you have any questions about the role, please contact Erika Thorslund, Talent Acquisition Partner, erika.thorslund@nextory.com
 



  





*Please note that we do not offer relocation and that a six\-month probationary period applies.*

title: Business Analyst | Stockholm
description:
**Vill du vara med och forma framtidens arbetssätt?**
 Grant Thornton är ett av Sveriges ledande revisions\- och rådgivningsföretag med en stark entreprenörsanda och ett tydligt fokus på utveckling. Varje dag hjälper vi företag att fatta bättre beslut, växa hållbart och navigera i en föränderlig omvärld.
   

  

 För att fortsätta ligga i framkant investerar vi stort i digitalisering, moderna plattformar och nya arbetssätt. Vi utvecklar egna lösningar, implementerar SaaS\-tjänster och utforskar hur AI kan skapa ännu större värde för verksamheten och våra kunder.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en Business Analyst som vill vara med och driva den utvecklingen framåt och spela en nyckelroll i hur framtidens Grant Thornton formas.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Business Analyst blir du länken mellan verksamhet och teknik. Du hjälper organisationen att förstå sina behov, skapa struktur och omsätta idéer till lösningar som skapar verkligt värde.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära verksamheten, produktägare, projektledare, utvecklare, testledare och arkitekter i en varierad vardag där du växlar mellan olika typer av uppgifter. Ena dagen faciliterar du en workshop, nästa dag visualiserar du en lösning eller diskuterar tekniska beroenden med utvecklingsteamet för att skapa samsyn och framdrift.
   

  

 Rollen handlar lika mycket om människor som om processer och teknik. Du lyssnar, utmanar och driver arbetet framåt på ett pragmatiskt sätt, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att påverka hur vi arbetar med analys, kravhantering, produktutveckling och AI framåt.
   

  

 Arbetsuppgifter
   

  

* Driva analys\- och kravarbete i projekt och förändringsinitiativ

title: Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
description:
Join the Data \& AI journey at Schibsted Media
   

  

 Data and AI are becoming increasingly important in how we build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across Schibsted Media. We are looking for a Data Engineer who wants to help build reliable, scalable, and well\-governed data products used across our media brands.
   

  

 In this role, you will work at the intersection of data engineering, analytics engineering, and platform thinking. You will help us build trusted data models, improve data pipelines, and collaborate closely with stakeholders across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other Data \& AI teams.
   

  

 You will join the Data \& AI organization in the Data Product Engineering team, where we build data capabilities that help teams across Schibsted Media make better decisions, create trusted data products, and enable future AI use cases.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for someone who enjoys building solid data solutions and working closely with others to turn business needs into useful, maintainable data products.
   

  

 You do not need to have all the answers, but you should be curious, structured, and willing to take ownership of your work. You will contribute to how we build data as a product, including creating data models that are reliable, well\-documented, and designed for real use cases, not just pipelines that move data.
   

  

 As part of a newly formed team of Data / Analytics Engineers, you will work with fellow data engineers, collaborate with adjacent teams, and help improve our engineering practices over time. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we work, shape our engineering culture, and make a real impact from day one. We're now looking for 2–3 more engineers to join us on the journey.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand needs, clarify requirements, and deliver pragmatic data solutions
* Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, and Airflow
* Develop maintainable data models that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases
* Contribute to good practices for data modeling, transformation, testing, documentation, and governance
* Work with other Data \& AI teams to align on platform capabilities, standards, and shared ways of working
* Help improve reliability, performance, cost\-efficiency, and scalability of our data solutions
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement of our ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of ownership, learning, and collaboration


 What we are looking for
   

  

 Must have
   

  

* 3\+ years experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or similar role
* Strong SQL skills and good understanding of data warehousing concepts
* Experience building data pipelines or data models for analytics, reporting, or product use cases
* Experience with modern data transformation or orchestration tools, such as dbt, Airflow, or similar
* Ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver maintainable solutions
* Good communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. English is our main working language.
* Collaborative mindset and willingness to learn from and contribute to the team


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience with Python or scripting for data engineering workflows
* Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or similar tools
* Experience with CI/CD, version control, and engineering best practices
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Interest in data quality, observability, governance, or access control
* Experience working in a cross\-functional or product\-oriented environment


 Why join us?
   

  

* Opportunity to build trusted data products with real impact across Schibsted Media
* A role with ownership, learning opportunities, and support from experienced colleagues
* Flexible working hours and hybrid work options with strong trust and autonomy
* International environment with offices in Oslo, Stockholm, and Krakow
* Strong learning culture with learning budget and active engineering \& AI communities
* Access to Schibsted’s media products, including premium news and podcasts


**About You**
 You enjoy turning messy problems into clear, maintainable solutions. You care about technical quality, but you also understand that good engineering is about tradeoffs, communication, and delivering value.
   

  

 You are comfortable asking questions, learning from others, and taking responsibility for your work. You like collaborating with stakeholders and teammates, and you want to grow as an engineer while contributing to data products that are useful, trusted, and impactful.
   

  

 When you apply, we'd love to get to know the real you. We value authentic applications and are much more interested in your own thoughts, experiences, and motivations than polished AI\-generated content.
   

  

 If you want to help build trusted data products that enable better decisions and future AI capabilities across Schibsted Media, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build out our data platform from the ground up. You'll join a small, focused Platform Team and take ownership of our data infrastructure as we set up a self\-service analytics capability for the entire business.
 



 The operational foundation is already in place: a serverless architecture on AWS, domain services with their own databases, and solid observability through Datadog. You'll spend your initial time at Zendr building the analytical layer \- a separated data platform that decouples analytical workloads from operational databases and gives business stakeholders direct access to the metrics and data they need without filing tickets to engineering.
 



 The initial architecture direction is being defined and foundational decisions are still being shaped. You'll have real influence on technology choices, architecture patterns, and how data flows through the organization.
 



 You won't inherit a mature data stack and maintain it. You'll help design and build one.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Design and build data pipelines that move data from operational databases into a dedicated analytical data store
* Own the data platform end\-to\-end: ingestion, transformation, storage, and the query layer that business users interact with
* Set up and maintain self\-service BI tooling so non\-technical stakeholders can explore data independently
* Define a semantic or metrics layer that gives the business consistent, trustworthy definitions of core concepts (revenue, delivery performance, customer metrics etc.)
* Help make data accessible to AI workflows through connectors and integrations, with clear governance over what data is exposed and how
* Integrate third\-party data sources into the platform where needed
* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting
* Collaborate with domain teams to understand their data, shape what gets promoted to the analytical layer, and ensure pipeline contracts are solid
* Own data governance, retention, access control, and compliance practices across the platform
* Co\-decide on tooling and architecture with the CTO and Platform Lead as the platform evolves



  





**About you** 




 You're an experienced data engineer who likes to build and then live with what you've built. You're pragmatic, take ownership end\-to\-end, and move comfortably between deep technical work and a clear conversation with business stakeholders without hiding behind jargon. You think of yourself as an engineer first, you make smart trade\-offs rather than reaching for the heaviest tool, and you care about getting things right in production — not just on a whiteboard.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 



* At least 5 years of data engineering experience, having both built and maintained data infrastructure in production
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS data services such as S3, Athena, Glue, Lambda, or Step Functions
* Experience designing layered data architectures where raw data becomes trusted, queryable business data
* Solid pipeline engineering skills across both streaming and batch
* You've lived with systems you built, handled the edge cases, and evolved the architecture as requirements changed
* Python proficiency for data engineering work
* Comfort working with MongoDB or other document databases as a data source
* Experience setting up BI or analytics tooling for non\-technical users
* You've worked in a context where you built things end\-to\-end rather than owning one narrow slice
* Good instincts for analytical data modelling
* You use AI tooling to move faster, but you know what good code looks like and can tell when an AI agent is producing something that doesn't meet the bar



  





**High value if you also bring** 



* MongoDB Atlas and Change Streams experience
* TypeScript and/or Go (our engineering stack)
* Infrastructure as Code with Pulumi
* Serverless architecture experience
* Event\-driven data processing patterns
* Datadog for monitoring and observability
* Experience with making data available to LLMs or building data connectors for AI workflows
* Logistics or supply chain domain knowledge



  





**About Zendr** 




 Zendr is a fast\-growing SaaS company developing cloud\-based solutions for B2B freight. We take pride in our innovative platform and the passionate team that contributes to our success every day. At Zendr, collaboration and well\-being are key – we offer a workplace where you can truly make an impact. We're proud of what we do and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. We believe it's important that you feel valued, engaged, and empowered to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly – both professionally and personally – while being part of building something meaningful.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* A data platform being built from scratch, not inherited
* Direct architectural influence alongside the CTO and Platform Lead
* A modern serverless stack on AWS with MongoDB
* A 70\+ person company where your work is visible and matters
* Interesting data problems in the logistics domain
* A team that values pragmatism over theoretical purity
* A competitive salary in the range of 50'–70' SEK per month, tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well\-being and growth



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable. The process may look roughly like this:
 


* Application review – We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
* First conversation – An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
* Coding assignment – A task you'll be handed at this step to better understand your technical expertise.
* Technical interview – A meeting discussing the assignment to better understand your reasoning and decision making.
* Final meeting – Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.



 Exact steps may vary slightly depending on the role and timing, but from first contact to final decision you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time – because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.
 



  





**Additional information** 




 We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly – please note that we're currently in the summer holiday period, which may mean slightly longer response times than usual. We'll be in touch as soon as we can.
 



  





**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible
 



**Scope:** 
 Full\-time, permanent position
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm or Jönköping

title: Senior Data Analyst (Stockholm)
description:
**Why Here?**
 Xebia is a global AI\-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, the company helps organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data\-driven solutions. In the CEE region, nearly 1,000 experts deliver modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as McLaren, Aviva, Deloitte, Spotify, Disney, ING, UPS, Tesco, Truecaller, AllSaints, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, Allegro, and InPost. This role focuses on recommendation systems within that ecosystem.
   

  

**What Will You Do?**
 As a Senior Data Analyst at Xebia, you will own the measurement of recommendation experiments by designing A/B tests, defining success metrics, and delivering readouts that explain not just whether something worked but why. You will investigate model and system behavior, including ranking quality, retrieval coverage, exposure and feedback effects, and the gaps between offline metrics and online outcomes. Additionally, you will build the dashboards, data models, and self\-service tooling the team relies on to monitor recommendation health, while leaving them in a state the team can maintain after the engagement.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Data Engineer** 




  





 We're partnered with a well\-established Nordic financial services organisation that's investing heavily in its modern data platform. Combining the stability of a long\-standing business with the agility of a much smaller organisation, they're looking for a Data Engineer to help shape the next generation of their cloud\-based data landscape.
 



  





 Data is becoming increasingly central to how the business makes decisions, delivers services and develops new capabilities. As part of a collaborative Data \& Analytics team, you'll play a key role in building the platforms and pipelines that make this possible.
 



  





*About the role:* 




 This is an opportunity to join a business where engineering quality, collaboration and long\-term thinking are genuinely valued.
 



  





 Working with Microsoft Azure and Snowflake, you'll help design, develop and maintain modern data solutions that enable analytics, reporting and future AI initiatives across the organisation.
 



  





 Rather than simply maintaining existing infrastructure, you'll have the opportunity to influence how the platform evolves, working alongside data professionals, architects and business stakeholders to build reliable, scalable and well\-governed data products.
 



  





*What you'll do:* 



* Design, build and optimise data pipelines using modern cloud technologies.
* Develop and maintain scalable data solutions across Azure and Snowflake.
* Improve the reliability, performance and quality of the organisation's data platform.
* Collaborate with analysts, data specialists and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver practical solutions.
* Support data modelling, transformation and integration across multiple business domains.
* Contribute to platform improvements, automation and engineering best practices.
* Help ensure data is secure, trusted and governed within a regulated environment.



  





*About you:* 




 You'll enjoy solving technical problems but also understand the importance of building data platforms that deliver value for the wider business.
 



  





*You'll likely have:* 



* Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data platform role.
* Strong experience working with Microsoft Azure data services.
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake.
* Good SQL skills and experience building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms and modern engineering practices.
* An understanding of data modelling, performance optimisation and data quality.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to work closely with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





 Experience within financial services or other regulated industries would be beneficial but isn't essential.
 



  





*Why join?* 




 This is a rare opportunity to join an organisation that combines the security and stability of an established financial institution with the culture and accessibility of a much smaller business.
 



  





 You'll work in an environment where decisions are made quickly, ideas are listened to, and engineers have genuine influence over both technology and direction. The team values collaboration over hierarchy, encouraging knowledge sharing, continuous learning and long\-term career development.
 



  





 The organisation is investing significantly in its cloud data platform, meaning you'll be joining at an exciting stage where you'll help shape the future rather than simply inherit the past.
 



  





 Alongside modern technologies including Microsoft Azure and Snowflake, you'll benefit from a supportive team, flexible hybrid working, excellent employee benefits and a culture built around trust, responsibility and sustainable growth.
 



  





 If you're looking for a Data Engineering role where you'll have real ownership, work with modern cloud technologies and build solutions that make a genuine impact across the business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Pophouse** 




 Pophouse is a pioneering entertainment and investment company focused on iconic music catalogues and artist legacies – behind names like ABBA, Avicii, Swedish House Mafia, and KISS. By combining data‑driven insights with cutting‑edge technology, we unlock long‑term value in some of the world’s most beloved music IP.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As our investment portfolio continues to grow, so does our ambition. We’re building a world‑class data engineering capability to power how we evaluate catalogues, understand music consumption at scale, and make even smarter, faster, more informed investment decisions.
 



 We’re now looking for a Data Engineer to build Pophouse’s intelligence platform – the layer where information is filtered, connected, and turned into investment‑ready intelligence. This is an opportunity to build the foundation that enables smarter investment decisions from the ground up.
 



  





 You will design and engineer the intelligence platform that powers our deal teams by turning fragmented signals from across the music ecosystem into clear, actionable insight.
 



 Working closely with our investment team, you have a deep understanding of what truly drives value in music investments, from streaming dynamics and platform behaviour to emerging signals that others haven’t yet spotted. Your mission is to create systems that surface the right information at the right moment, while continuously evolving the underlying technology, data sources, and approaches as the landscape changes.
 



  





 You will also work closely with our Catalog team, extending your impact beyond the investment decision itself and into the data that matters once an investment has been made – helping ensure the same intelligence\-driven approach carries through into how our catalogues are managed and developed over time.
 



  





 This role is for someone who is technically strong, commercially curious, and genuinely excited by building from scratch. You’re comfortable operating in fast‑moving environments, happy to challenge existing approaches, and not afraid to change tools or start again when better solutions emerge.
 



  





 If you’re driven by building intelligence, passionate about music and technology, and motivated by creating something foundational in an ever‑evolving tech landscape, this is your opportunity to shape how Pophouse makes data‑driven investment decisions.
 



  





**More about Pophouse** 




 At Pophouse, data is not a support function, it’s a strategic capability. You’ll be joining a company that combines storytelling, technology, and investment expertise to shape the future of music IP. This is an opportunity to build and influence a modern analytics capability from the ground up, working closely with decision\-makers and contributing directly to high\-value investments in globally recognized catalogues and artist legacies.
 



  





 If you’re excited about building world\-class data infrastructure at the heart of music, culture, and investment, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





*In this recruitment process, we are collaborating with Safemind, and all applications will be handled through the application link.*

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest\-growing fintech companies \- bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders \- thanks to the 500\+ amazing people who work here.**
 As a Data Engineer at Sambla Group you will play a key role in building and maintaining the systems that power data\-driven decision making across the company. You'll join a central Data Platform team, and work closely with an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager, contributing to everything from reliable data pipelines to enabling self\-serve analytics and putting data to work in our operational tools.
   

  

 We're building a modern, AI\-native data platform, and we're looking for someone who doesn't just adapt to new tooling but actively drives how we adopt it. That means using AI\-assisted development in your day\-to\-day work, exploring where LLMs and intelligent automation can make our platform smarter, and helping set the standard for how the team works with these tools going forward.
   

  

 You will work with modern cloud\-native technologies on GCP \- including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Build and Artifact Registry \- alongside tools like DBT, Prefect and Terraform.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Design, build and maintain data pipelines and integrations (streaming, batch, API\-based) that feed our data products
* Develop and maintain our Data Warehouse and contribute to data platform improvements
* Ensure data quality, data governance and GDPR compliance
* Architect scalable and secure solutions in GCP and BigQuery
* Use AI tooling to accelerate development and explore where it can add value across our data work
* Collaborate with stakeholders across technical and non\-technical teams


**Must Have**
* At least 3 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role
* Strong Python skills (e.g. Polars, Flask/FastAPI or similar)
* Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex joins
* Hands\-on experience with GCP or AWS, preferably GCP
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
* Ability to manage and communicate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with dbt and data modelling concepts (dimensional modelling, SCD etc.)
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI or similar)
* Experience with observability, monitoring and alerting for data systems
* Background in fintech or financial data
* Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues


**We might be a little different from most companies. Instead of defining personal values, we’ve built a shared way of working \- a rhythm that guides how we collaborate, support our customers, and move forward together.** 
**We call it Drive \& Jive \- a shared rhythm that creates momentum through direction, collaboration, and human connection.**
**Please note that our recruitment process will take a short summer break during July.** 
 We’ll start reviewing applications and scheduling interviews again in the first week of August – we’re really looking forward to hearing from you!
   

  

***Applicants must already have the legal right to work in***
***Sweden***
***, as we do not provide visa sponsorship or relocation assistance for this position.***
 Sambla Group is the new generation of brokers. Our ambition has always been the same \- to challenge the banks’ offers so that our customers, regardless of the conditions, should always have the same opportunity to obtain the best possible loan solution. Sambla Group has grown to over 500 employees, established itself in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark with offices in all markets.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Data Scientist** 




  





 We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision\-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
 



  





 As the company continues to invest in its Data \& ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
 



  





*About the role:* 




 This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data\-driven solutions that create measurable value.
 



  





 The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business\-critical initiatives.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
 



  





*What you'll do:* 



* Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.
* Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.
* Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.
* Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.



  





*About you:* 




 We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real\-world business challenges.
 



  





 You'll likely have:
 


* 3\+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.
* A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.
* Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.
* Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.
* Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.
* Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.



  





 Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
 



  





*Why join?* 




 This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
 



  





 You'll be joining a collaborative Data \& ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision\-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
 



  





 The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
 



  





 If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving \- and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact \- we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer inom Data Engineering & Analytics till Axfood IT, Stockholm
description:
**Samtliga ansökningar behandlas under augusti 2026, i samband med rekryteringsprocessens start.**
 Välkommen till Axfood IT, en av matbranschens största IT\-avdelningar med nästan 400 medarbetare. Det är vi som ser till att Axfood, och alla våra kedjor, kan ligga i framkant vad gäller digital utveckling. Vi jobbar med att utveckla och förbättra allt ifrån e\-handel till logistiklösningar och AI.
   

  

 Hos Axfood IT blir du del av ett sammanhang som utmanar och levererar lösningar som gör skillnad, både för våra kollegor och våra kunder. Här finns det alltid möjlighet att lära sig om ny teknik och växa, både som individ och tillsammans med kollegorna.
   

  

**Ditt nya team**
 Du blir en del av avdelningen Business Analytics på Axfood IT, som ansvarar för data, rapportering och analyslösningar för hela Axfoodkoncernen. Avdelningen arbetar nära både verksamheten och andra teknikteam och ansvarar för lösningar som används för att fatta viktiga affärsbeslut inom koncernen.
   

  

 Rollen har fokus på back\-end utveckling och du arbetar med data pipelines, dataplattformar och integrationer i en miljö där många olika datakällor och verksamhetsbehov möts. Teamet arbetar både med vidareutveckling, förvaltning och projekt i varierande omfattning.
   

  

 Du samarbetar nära utvecklare, arkitekter och verksamheten, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett område där AI, data och modern analys utvecklas snabbt.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Software Engineer kommer du att arbeta med allt ifrån att ta emot verksamhetskrav till att leverera hållbara tekniska lösningar i vår dataplattform. Du arbetar med krav från både verksamheten och projekt, samtidigt som du är delaktig i förvaltning och löpande förbättringar av befintliga lösningar. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med andra i teamet så som andra delar av organisationen.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att inkludera:**
* Delta i refinement och tekniska dialoger för att omsätta verksamhetskrav till välgenomtänkta lösningsförslag
* Hämta och integrera data från källsystem via vår AWS\-baserade dataplattform
* Transformera data till strukturerade analytiska modeller i dbt
* Utveckla lösningar i SQL och Python, med fokus på datastrukturering, modellering och prestanda
* Skapa och förvalta datapipelines i Apache Airflow
* Peer\-reviewa och testa kod från andra teammedlemmar innan leverans
* Använda Git och Bitbucket för versionshantering och samarbete, samt bidra till att underhålla CI/CD\-pipelines
* Lösa incidenter och arbeta med förvaltning av befintliga lösningar
* Samarbeta nära arkitekter, andra utvecklare och verksamhet


**Stämmer detta in på dig?**
 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har mångårig erfarenhet av back\-end utveckling i ett Business Intelligence eller Business Analytics relaterat team och är van att arbeta med dataintensiva lösningar.
   

  

**Vi tror också att du har:**
* Erfarenhet av back\-end utveckling inom SQL och Python
* Erfarenhet av AWS, Airflow och dbt
* Erfarenhet av Git, Bitbucket och CI/CD\-pipelines
* Erfarenhet av data pipelines och dataplattformar
* Erfarenhet av stora datamängder
* Förståelse för semantiska lager, datastrukturering och datamodellering
* Kunskap om data governance och vikten av datakvalitet
* Erfarenhet av att samarbeta nära både verksamhet och i tekniska sammanhang
* Meriterande om du har erfarenhet från detaljhandeln
* Gillar att jobba i team
* Mycket god kommunikativ och analytisk förmåga, på både svenska och engelska


 Stämmer du inte in på varje punkt? Sök ändå! Vi vet att potential ofta är viktigare än erfarenhet och går igenom alla ansökningar.
   

  

**Ansökningsprocessen**
**Ansökan till denna roll ligger ute över sommaren, men ansökningar kommer bahandlas först i augusti. Du är välkommen med din ansökan redan nu!**
 Vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att söka jobb hos oss. Om du inte har ett CV redo räcker det med att du länkar en väl ifylld LinkedIn\-profil. I din ansökan får du svara på de frågor vi behöver svar på i den här delen av processen, och personligt brev är därför inte obligatoriskt. Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID\-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank\-id eller scanna någon QR\-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.
   

  

 Vid frågor om rekrytering på Axfood, kontakta Medarbetarsupporten eller läs mer: Så går det till när du söker jobb inom Axfood. Om du har frågor om tjänsten, kontakta elisabeth.wehlin@axfood.se. Av GDPR\-skäl behandlar vi inga ansökningar eller annan personlig information via mail.
   

  

 Läs mer och se filmer om Axfood som arbetsgivare här: Din karriärväg hos Axfood \| Utveckling och möjligheter \| Axfood

title: Business Analyst - Digital Franchise (11 months temporary contract)
description:
**Job Description**

 As a Business Analyst within Digital Franchise, you will play a key role in driving data\-informed decision making and supporting the digital growth of our franchise business. You will bridge business needs with data and insights, helping stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.
   

  





 This is a broad business facing role that offers the opportunity to develop a wide range of skills across commercial analysis, stakeholder management, digital performance, process improvement and Franchise partner relations. Rather than building deep expertise within a specific analytics discipline, you will gain exposure to multiple areas of the business and develop a holistic understanding of how digital franchise operations drive growth and profitability.
   

  





 You will be an integral part of the Global Franchise Digital team, collaborating closely with Controlling, Merchandising, Marketing, and other Franchise functions, as well as Franchise partners across multiple markets. As our digital Franchise business continues to expand, you will contribute to shaping future reporting, business processes, and analytical capabilities while supporting digital growth across existing and new markets.
   

  





 The global Franchise team is highly diverse, representing many nationalities and working with partners across Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and South America. This role offers unique exposure to international markets and includes opportunities to travel to Franchise partners, strengthening collaboration, supporting business growth, and gaining insights into local market needs.
   

  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



* Analyze digital business performance across .com and app, including traffic, customer behavior, conversion, sales performance, and commercial KPIs.
* Support data quality activities by assisting with the validation of datasets and ensuring consistency across multiple data sources.
* Translate business challenges and strategic questions into structured analyses, recommendations, and action plans.
* Build business cases to support investments, initiatives, and digital growth opportunities.
* Conduct gap analyses to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement across franchise markets.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and Franchise partners to improve performance and establish data driven ways of working.
* Coach and upskill Franchise partners in e\-commerce analysis, enabling them to better understand performance drivers, reporting, and digital commercial excellence.
* Support core Controlling processes, including monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery of ad hoc financial insights



**WHO YOU ARE**




*We are looking for people with:*



* A bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Marketing, Statistics, Analytics, or a related field.
* Experience in business analysis, commercial analysis, e\-commerce, digital business, consulting, or a similar area.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proficiency in SQL, GCP, Google Analytics, Power BI, and Looker Studio.



 More than deep technical expertise, we believe success in this role is driven by an analytical mindset, curiosity, strong business acumen, and the ability to connect insights with business actions.
   

  





*And people who are:*



* Curious about how digital businesses operate and grow.
* Comfortable working with data, while equally interested in understanding the broader business context.
* A self\-starter who takes ownership, works independently, and proactively drives initiative forward.
* A structured problem solver who enjoys turning insights into action.
* Collaborative and effective in building relationships across functions, markets, and cultures.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting to change in a fast\-paced business environment.
* An excellent communicator who can simplify complex topics for different audiences.



 JOIN US
   

  





 This is a temporary contract for 11 months, based at our office in Stockholm, Sweden.  Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible but latest by July 2nd,  2026\. This role will be reporting to the Head of Digital Franchise in the Commercial function.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**WHO WE ARE** 
 ​
   

  





 H\&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
   

  





 ​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
   

  





**​WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE** 
 ​
   

  





 We offer all our employees at H\&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H\&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H\&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H\&M HOME, \& Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H\&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H\&M Incentive Program here.
   

  





 In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.
   

  





**JOIN US​** 
  

  





 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
   

  





 ​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
You know that bit where every company says they’re
 *“changing the world”* 
 ? Yeah, it can feel a little forced. But we like to think our story actually has some realness to it.
 



  





 Our story begins with
 **Shadi Bitar** 
 and
 **Ninos Malki** 
 , who came to Sweden from Syria as kids and discovered that books could be a bridge \- helping them learn the language, understand the culture, and explore new worlds.
 



  





 A thought emerged,
 *what if everyone could have that?* 
 And just like that, Nextory was born \- your all\-access pass to read, listen, and discover new perspectives without limits. And now, we're on a quest to find a
 **Machine Learning Engineer.** 




  





**Let us tell you about the role 📖** 




 As a Machine Learning Engineer at Nextory, you'll build the systems that power how users discover, understand, and engage with books. You'll work across AI agents, search, recommendations, retrieval, and product experiences, turning advances in AI into features that users interact with every day.
 



  





 Some examples of what you'll be doing:
 


* Build intelligent recommendation, search, and discovery systems that help users find their next favorite book and connect with the right content faster.
* Use AI, user behavior, and content understanding to continuously improve relevance, engagement, and user experience.
* Design, build, and operate scalable machine learning systems using LLMs, retrieval, recommendation, and agent technologies.
* Collaborate across product and engineering teams to deliver reliable AI\-powered features with measurable user impact.



  





**Your story so far 👀** 




 We believe you're an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and turning emerging technology into products that people love using. You are comfortable moving between product thinking and technical implementation, and you thrive in environments where experimentation, ownership, and fast iteration are part of everyday work.
 



  





 We also believe that you have:
 


* BSc in Computer Science or another relevant field, or equivalent work experience.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Data Engineer** 




 Build the future of data, not just the pipelines.
 



  





 Most data engineering roles are centred around moving data from A to B.
 



  





 This isn't one of them.
 



  





 We're working with one of the Nordics' most exciting technology businesses as they continue to invest heavily in their data platform, AI capabilities and engineering function. They're looking for a Data Engineer who enjoys building complete solutions \- someone equally comfortable modelling data, building APIs, automating workflows and solving business problems with technology.
 



  





 The data is already flowing. The challenge now is deciding what to build with it.
 



  





 You'll join a small, highly collaborative team where you'll have genuine ownership over the direction of the platform. Rather than sitting behind tickets all day, you'll work closely with stakeholders across the business to understand problems, design scalable solutions and build the tools that allow the company to make smarter decisions every day.
 



  





 If you've ever found yourself wanting to build
 *more* 
 than pipelines, this is the role you've been looking for.
 



  





**The Opportunity:** 




 The business has spent the last few years modernising its data platform, creating a cloud\-native data warehouse and establishing strong engineering foundations.
 



  





 Now comes the exciting part.
 



  





 The focus has shifted from simply collecting data to building intelligent services around it.
 



  





 You'll help design scalable data models that become the foundation for reporting, analytics and AI initiatives. You'll build lightweight applications that allow business users to interact with data. You'll expose datasets through APIs, automate repetitive processes and help create the infrastructure that powers a growing number of AI\-driven workflows.
 



  





 Because the team is small, you'll see the direct impact of everything you build.
 



  





 Ideas don't spend months in approval chains. Engineers are trusted to identify problems, propose solutions and own them from design through to production.
 



  





**What you'll be working on:** 




 Your work will span far more than traditional data engineering.
 



  





 You'll be involved in:
 


* Designing scalable, well\-structured data models using SQL and dbt
* Building Python services that automate business processes
* Creating APIs that expose trusted data to internal applications and AI services
* Developing custom integrations where off\-the\-shelf tooling isn't enough
* Building cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
* Improving data quality, testing and platform reliability
* Working closely with commercial teams to understand how data can solve real business challenges
* Helping shape the next generation of AI\-enabled products and internal tooling



  





 The engineering philosophy is simple:
 



  





 Solve business problems with technology.
 



  





*Sometimes that's a data model.* 




*Sometimes it's an API.* 




*Sometimes it's a small application.* 




  





 Whatever creates the most value.
 



  





**What they're looking for:** 




 This role would suit someone who's naturally curious and enjoys solving problems.
 



 You're probably someone who starts with
 *"What are we trying to achieve?"* 
 rather than
 *"Which technology are we using?"* 




  





**You'll bring:** 




 Strong Data Engineering Fundamentals
 


* Excellent SQL skills
* Strong experience with dbt
* Solid Python development experience
* Experience working with cloud data platforms
* An understanding of modern data architecture and best practices



  





 Broader Engineering Experience
 



 The ideal person isn't purely a pipeline engineer.
 



 You've probably built some combination of:
 


* REST APIs
* Internal tooling
* Automation services
* Backend applications
* Infrastructure with Terraform or similar
* Data integrations



  





 You don't need to be an expert software engineer.
 



 You simply enjoy building whatever is needed to solve the problem.
 



  





 Mindset matters more than tools!
 



 The hiring manager is far more interested in engineers who can learn than people who've memorised a specific technology stack.
 



  





 Whether you've worked with Google Cloud, Azure or AWS isn't particularly important. What matters is that you've worked in environments where you've had to think for yourself, adapt quickly and wear multiple hats. Experience in start\-ups, scale\-ups or fast\-moving product businesses will be highly valued.
 



  





 Likewise, engineers who understand both the technical and commercial side of data tend to thrive here.
 



  





 If you've spent time working closely with stakeholders, translating business questions into technical solutions and making data genuinely useful, you'll fit right in.
 



  





**Tech Stack:** 




 Current technologies include:
 


* Python
* SQL
* dbt
* BigQuery
* Google Cloud Platform
* Docker
* Terraform
* Airbyte



 Experience with every tool isn't expected.
 



 Strong engineering principles and a willingness to learn are far more important than matching every technology.
 



  





**Why this role?** 




 This is an opportunity to join a company at exactly the right stage.
 



  





 The foundations have been built.
 



  





 Now the team is focused on creating a truly modern data platform \- one that enables self\-service analytics, intelligent automation and AI\-driven products across the business
 



  





 You'll join a highly visible team where your work is used daily by stakeholders throughout the organisation.
 



  





 There are no endless approval processes.
 



 No rigid role boundaries.
 



 No spending months maintaining legacy pipelines.
 



  





 Instead you'll work alongside ambitious engineers and business stakeholders who genuinely care about building great products and using data to drive better decisions.
 



  





 It's the kind of environment where people who enjoy ownership, autonomy and variety do their best work.
 



  





**Salary \& Benefits** 



* 55,000–70,000 SEK per month (Dependent on experience)
* Hybrid working (Tuesday–Thursday in the Stockholm office)
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Permanent position



  





 Interview Process
 


* Initial conversation with the Hiring Manager
* Technical reasoning and problem\-solving case study (discussion\-based, no live coding)
* Final technical and cultural interview

title: Dataanalytiker till Arbetsmiljöverket
description:
På Arbetsmiljöverket jobbar vi tillsammans för att ingen ska bli sjuk, skadas eller dö av jobbet. Därför hjälper vi arbetsgivare att uppfylla de krav som finns och informerar om hur arbetsmiljöarbetet blir en naturlig del av vardagen. Med arbetsmiljölagen som grund tar vi fram regler, inspekterar arbetsplatser och sprider kunskap om arbetsmiljöfrågor. Uppdraget är allvarligt men vår vardag präglas av arbetsglädje och vi är omtänksamma och hjälpsamma kollegor.
   

  

****Ditt nya jobb****
 Vi söker nu en dataanalytiker för ett vikariat på ett år till enheten för statistik. I rollen kommer du att bidra till myndighetens utveckling mot ett mer datadrivet, riskbaserat och kunskapsbaserat arbetssätt.
   

  

 Detta innefattar bland annat att:
   

  

* Identifiera och integrera externa datakällor
* Genomföra kvantitativa analyser av större datamängder
* Utveckla indikatorer och på sikt prediktionsmodeller
* Kvalitetssäkra data och analys
* Bidra med ett kvantitativt perspektiv i tvärfunktionella samarbeten


 En viktig del av arbetet är även att säkerställa god dokumentation av data, kod, analyser och processer, så att arbetet blir reproducerbart, spårbart och möjligt att vidareutveckla.
   

  

 Då arbetet till stor del kommer innebära att delta i utvecklingen av myndighetens arbetssätt söker vi dig som vill vara med och skapa nytt. Som tycker om att arbeta självständigt och som trivs i föränderliga miljöer som är under utveckling. Arbetet kommer att kräva samarbete med olika delar av myndighetens verksamhet och du bör trivas med att skapa nya kontakter för att utföra ditt uppdrag.
   

  

 Rollen är både strategisk och operativ och innefattar även arbete kopplat till myndighetens officiella statistik.
   

  

 Enheten för statistik består av 12 medarbetare som har i uppdrag att skapa officiell statistik över arbetsskador och arbetsmiljö och ansvarar också för att ta fram olika former av analyser och beslutsunderlag. Vi arbetar även med verksamhetsdata för myndighetens behov samt är statistiskt och dataanalytiskt stöd till myndighetens verksamhet.
   

  

****Din bakgrund****
 Rollen kräver att du har:
   

  

* Högskoleexamen inom exempelvis statistik, datavetenskap, matematik, nationalekonomi eller annat område relevant för tjänsten. Alternativt annan eftergymnasial utbildning tillsammans med mångårig relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* Flerårig aktuell erfarenhet av kvantitativ analys av större datamängder
* Aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta med data i hela kedjan (identifiera möjliga datakällor, bearbetning, analys, dokumentation)
* Erfarenhet av programmering för dataanalys (t.ex. SQL, Python, R eller motsvarande)
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift
* Goda kunskaper i engelska


 Det är meriterande om du även har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av arbete i statistikverktyget SAS
* Erfarenhet av statistisk modellering eller maskininlärning
* Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat vid en statlig myndighet


 Som person ser vi att du kommer att trivas och lyckas i rollen om du har mycket god förmåga att självständigt lösa problem och att skapa struktur i ditt arbete. Du kan med lugn och tilltro till din egen förmåga driva arbetet framåt även när ramarna inte alltid är helt givna eller förutsägbara. Du kan snabbt anpassa dig efter nya omständigheter och förändra beslut och prioriteringar när det krävs. Vidare har du god förmåga att analysera och tolka kvantitativ data, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data samt förstå vilken information som kan förädlas till data.
   

  

 Då arbetet kommer att bedrivas i tvärfunktionella samarbeten ser vi vidare att du har god samarbetsförmåga och utbyter information och kunskaper i syfte att uppnå gemensamma mål.
   

  

 Vid urvalet kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära att befattningen placeras i säkerhetsklass. Säkerhetsprövning med eller utan registerkontroll kan därför komma att göras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning genomförs enligt Säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585\).
   

  

****Vad vi erbjuder dig****
 Arbetsmiljöverket är en trygg och stabil arbetsgivare och en myndighet som hela tiden förändras med samhället vi verkar. Vi är stolta över att få använda vår kunskap och vårt förtroende i vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag. Tillsammans skapar vi en inkluderande kultur, som rymmer hjärta, mod och hjärna. Hos oss blir hela du en viktig del i något större.
   

  

 Anställningen är ett vikariat på ett år, på heltid och är för närvarande placerad på vårt kontor i Solna. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och provanställning på sex månader.
   

  

 Vi strävar efter att alla medarbetare ska ha en hållbar arbetsmiljö och en balans mellan jobb och fritid. Därför har vi flexibla arbetstider eller tillämpar förtroendearbetstid och ger möjlighet till distansarbete där verksamheten så tillåter.
   

  

 Om oss och våra förmåner och villkor
   

  

****Så rekryterar vi****
 Vi använder kompetensbaserad rekrytering, både för att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringen och för att motverka diskriminering. Vi ber dig därför att endast bifoga ett CV, och svara på några frågor istället för ett personligt brev när du registrerar din ansökan. Vi pratar svenska på myndigheten, därför ber vi dig att skicka din ansökan på svenska. Vi använder arbetspsykologiska tester i den här rekryteringen. Planen är att intervjuer sker omkring V. 35 \- 36\. Rekryterande chef och HR\-partner återkommer från semester för att kunna svara på frågor från och med 1 augusti.
   

  

 Du har också tillgång till vanliga frågor och svar: Om att jobba hos oss
   

  

 Vi tycker att det är viktigt att även du får göra din bedömning av oss. Därför välkomnar vi frågor före såväl som under rekryteringsprocessen. Fackliga kontaktpersoner är Adam Jansson för Saco, Mats Johansson för ST samt Jenny Bengtsson för Seko. Samtliga nås via Arbetsmiljöverkets växel: 010\-730 90 00\.
   

  

**Vill du jobba tillsammans med oss för att ingen ska bli sjuk, skadas eller dö av jobbet?**
**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 5 augusti 2026!**
 Rekryteringen sköts av Arbetsmiljöverkets rekryteringsfunktion varför vi undanber oss säljsamtal från rekryteringsföretag eller annonssäljare.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO

 Vi driftar vårt eget GPU\-kluster on\-prem, utan beroende av externa molntjänster. Det är en konsekvens av vad vi gör.  Vi har flera AI\-produkter under utveckling, bland annat en transkriberingslösning. Du kommer att jobba med flera av dem parallellt.
   

  

****Vi tror du har****
* Teknisk högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.

* Konkret erfarenhet av att bygga något icke\-trivialt med LLM:er, exempelvis RAG eller agentbaserade system.
* Vana av API\-utveckling och containermiljöer.
* Förståelse för säkerhets\- och integritetsfrågor i AI\-system.


****Bonus om du också har****
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsklassad eller annan reglerad miljö.

* Svenska i tal och skrift.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Join the Data \& AI journey at Schibsted Media**
**Data and AI are becoming increasingly important in how we build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across Schibsted Media.**
**We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Infrastructure team and help build the shared data platform that powers analytics and AI across Schibsted Media. Our team enables data teams to build trusted, scalable, and well\-governed data products.**
**In this role, you will work at the intersection of data engineering and platform engineering. You'll help improve our data platform while also contributing to trusted data models, modern data pipelines, and engineering practices used across the organization. You will join the Data \& AI organization, where we build data capabilities that help teams across Schibsted Media make better decisions, create trusted data products, and enable future AI use cases.**
**About The Role**
**We're looking for someone with 4\+ years of experience who enjoys building solid data solutions while improving the shared data platform that enables teams across Schibsted Media.**
**You'll work with technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python to develop shared tooling, maintain platform capabilities, and contribute to modern data engineering practices.**
**You'll also help deploy and manage cloud infrastructure, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve the reliability and scalability of our platform. While prior infrastructure experience is a plus, we're looking for someone who is eager to learn and grow in this area.**
**What You'll Do**
* Collaborate with Data \& AI teams to understand platform needs and deliver scalable data solutions
* Design, build, and improve shared data platform capabilities, developer tooling, data pipelines, and automation using technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python
* Support and evolve our Privacy Compliance Platform, helping enable secure, compliant, and governed access to data across Schibsted Media
* Deploy, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and modern automation practices
* Improve reliability, observability, performance, cost\-efficiency, and scalability of our data platform
* Develop reusable templates, tooling, and documentation that enable self\-service across Data \& AI teams
* Develop maintainable data models that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases
* Contribute to good practices for data modeling, transformation, testing, documentation, and governance
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement of our ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of ownership, learning, and collaboration


**What We're Looking For**
**Must have**
* 4\+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role
* Strong SQL skills and a good understanding of modern data warehousing concepts
* Experience building data pipelines and working with orchestration tools such as Airflow or similar
* Hands\-on experience with dbt and modern data transformation practices
* Experience with Python for data engineering or automation
* Experience with Git and modern software engineering practices
* Ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver maintainable solutions
* Good communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. English is our main working language.
* Collaborative mindset and willingness to learn from and contribute to the team


**Nice to have**
* Experience with software engineering practices such as automated testing, CI/CD, and code review workflows
* Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Interest in data quality, observability, governance, or platform engineering


**Why join us?**
* Build the platform that enables data and AI across Schibsted Media
* Work with modern technologies and experienced engineers across multiple teams
* Flexible working hours and hybrid work options with strong trust and autonomy
* International environment with offices in Oslo, Stockholm, and Krakow
* Strong learning culture with learning budget and active engineering \& AI communities
* Access to Schibsted's premium media products, including news and podcasts


**About You**
**You enjoy turning technical challenges into simple, maintainable solutions. You're passionate about improving the developer experience and building reusable solutions that help other engineers move faster. You care about building reliable systems, but also understand that great engineering is about collaboration, continuous improvement, and enabling others to succeed.**
**You're curious, take ownership of your work, and enjoy helping build the platform that supports trusted data products across Schibsted Media.**
